1.2 DUAL-MODE ARCHITECTURE:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Burger Factory operates under two complementary execution paradigms:

[MODE 1: INTEGRATED LAN / WI-FI DEVELOPMENT & DEMO SERVER]
- Launcher: `start-burger-factory.bat` or `npx vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000`
- Binding: 0.0.0.0:3000 allows laptops, smartphones, and tablets on the local Wi-Fi
  to interact simultaneously with instant live synchronization.
- Embedded REST Engine: vite.config.js incorporates a lightweight Express-like
  HTTP middleware providing:
    * GET  /api/v1/reservations       -> returns all bookings from data/reservations.json
    * POST /api/v1/reservations       -> creates reservation, commits to disk, broadcasts SSE
    * PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status -> updates status, stamps timestamps, broadcasts SSE
- Embedded Server-Sent Events (SSE): /api/v1/events pushes instant updates to all
  connected browsers (Customer phone and Manager tablet stay in lockstep).
- Persistent Data: Saved to data/reservations.json with seeded Goa reservations.

[MODE 2: PRODUCTION MICROSERVICES & DOCKER COMPOSE]
- Backend: Fastify v4 + TypeScript + Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 + BullMQ
- Located in apps/api: modular routes for auth, availability, floor, menu, reservations.
- Database: PostgreSQL with btree_gist extension for status-aware reservation constraints.
- Reverse Proxy: Caddy v2 (infra/Caddyfile) providing automatic TLS and static asset caching.
- Shared Contracts: packages/shared provides cross-workspace Zod validation schemas.

1.3 RECENT CORE UPGRADES & ENHANCEMENTS:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Authentic Goa Menu & Copy Refinement:
   - Stripped all placeholder/cringe text and removed all emojis across all files.
   - Integrated authentic Goa Burger Factory menu (14 gourmet burgers including Pork
     Belly, Beef & Blue Cheese, Calamari, Jackfruit Carnitas; craft cocktails including
     Kokum Highball, Feni Sour, Tamarind Mezcalita).
2. Hero Joke Rotator:
   - Interactive board joke widget with random, no-repeat shuffle button featuring
     witty burger jokes from Mitch Hedberg, Jim Gaffigan, and Goa chalkboard rules.
3. Mobile Responsive Overhaul (390px iPhone & Android):
   - Added overflow-x: clip and min-width: 0 on all container grids to eliminate horizontal scroll.
   - Replaced dotted-leader menu items with clean responsive card blocks.
   - Added sticky mobile bottom navigation bar (Menu | Book a Table | My Booking).
   - Fixed iOS input auto-zoom by enforcing 16px font-size.
   - Created 4-column compact time slot chip grid for phones.
4. Staff Portal & Passcode Gate:
   - Restricted access to manager dashboard via embedded passcode gate (passcode: "burger123")
     with auto-fill convenience shortcut.
   - Replaced direct /manager.html access from customer site with secure passcode modal.
   - Added in-page session lock/logout and route guard redirection.
5. Active Navbar ScrollSpy (Red Underline):
   - Fixed red underline being stuck on "Home"; dynamic Intersection/scroll tracker
     smoothly underlines the section currently in view (Printed Menu, Kitchen, Outlets, Diners).
6. Hotel-Grade Printable Day Sheet:
   - One-click print button in manager header renders an official, executive 8-column
     manifest optimized for black & white laser/thermal printers with service summary metrics.

1.4 GOVERNANCE & CHAT LOGGING RULES:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- In accordance with RULE[D:\Burger_factory\GEMINI.md], all conversation turns,
  prompts, and AI actions are permanently preserved in PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt.
- Automated lifecycle hooks in .agents/hooks.json execute scripts/sync_chat_log.cjs
  on PostInvocation and Stop triggers.

```markdown
# Continuous Chat History Logging Rule

## Mandate
For every user prompt and assistant response in this project ("The Burger Factory"):
1. The conversation history MUST be logged and preserved in `d:/Burger_factory/PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt`.
2. When answering user requests, ensure that any key decisions, architectural changes, prompts, and outputs are appended to `d:/Burger_factory/PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt`.
3. Never truncate or delete previous conversation entries in `PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt`. Always append new turns in chronological order with turn header, timestamp, user prompt, and assistant response.
```

```plaintext
COPY --from=builder /app/apps/api/dist ./dist
```

```prisma
generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["postgresqlExtensions"]

datasource db {
  provider   = "postgresql"

  extensions = [btree_gist]
}

  ADMIN
  MANAGER
}

  INDOOR
  OUTDOOR
  BEACHSIDE

  PENDING_DEPOSIT
  CONFIRMED
  SEATED
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
  NO_SHOW
}

  ONLINE
  WALK_IN
  PHONE
}

  NOT_REQUIRED
  PENDING
  PAID
  REFUNDED
  FAILED
}

enum Diet {
  VEG
  EGG
  NON_VEG
}

enum MenuBadge {
  POPULAR
  NEW
}

model User {
  id                 String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email              String         @unique
  name               String
  passwordHash       String
  role               Role           @default(MANAGER)
  isActive           Boolean        @default(true)
  createdAt          DateTime       @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt          DateTime       @updatedAt @db.Timestamptz(6)
  locations          UserLocation[]
  refreshTokens      RefreshToken[]
  reservations       Reservation[]
  auditLogs          AuditLog[]
  @@map("users")
}

model UserLocation {
  userId     String   @db.Uuid
  locationId String   @db.Uuid
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  location   Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@id([userId, locationId])
  @@index([locationId])
  @@map("user_locations")
}

  id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid

  expiresAt    DateTime  @db.Timestamptz(6)

  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  user         User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

  id              String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — DATABASE SEED SCRIPT
// Populates 7 Outlets, 104 Tables, Menu, and Staff
// ============================================

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import argon2 from 'argon2';
import { LOCATIONS } from '@burger-factory/shared';
import { locationTables, menuItems } from '../../../src/js/data.js';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

async function main() {
  console.log('🌱 Starting Burger Factory database seeding...');

  // 1. Seed Staff Users
  const passwordHash = await argon2.hash('GoaBurgers2026!');

  const admin = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email: 'admin@burgerfactory.in' },
    update: {},
    create: {
      email: 'admin@burgerfactory.in',
      name: 'Burger Factory Admin',
      passwordHash,
      role: 'ADMIN'
    }
  });

  const manager = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email: 'manager@burgerfactory.in' },
    update: {},
    create: {
      email: 'manager@burgerfactory.in',
      name: 'Anjuna Floor Host',
      passwordHash,
      role: 'MANAGER'
    }
  });

  console.log('✓ Staff users seeded');

  // 2. Seed Locations & Tables
  for (const loc of LOCATIONS) {
    const createdLoc = await prisma.location.upsert({
      where: { slug: loc.slug },
      update: {
        name: loc.name,
        tag: loc.tag,
        area: loc.area,
        address: loc.address,
        phone: loc.phone,
        opensAt: loc.opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt: loc.lastSeatingAt,
        mapUrl: loc.mapUrl,
        image: loc.image,
        vibe: loc.vibe,
        features: [...loc.features]
      },
      create: {
        slug: loc.slug,
        name: loc.name,
        tag: loc.tag,
        area: loc.area,
        address: loc.address,
        phone: loc.phone,
        opensAt: loc.opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt: loc.lastSeatingAt,
        mapUrl: loc.mapUrl,
        image: loc.image,
        vibe: loc.vibe,
        features: [...loc.features]
      }
    });

    // Link manager to Anjuna
    if (loc.slug === 'anjuna') {
      await prisma.userLocation.upsert({
        where: { userId_locationId: { userId: manager.id, locationId: createdLoc.id } },
        update: {},
        create: { userId: manager.id, locationId: createdLoc.id }
      });
    }

    // Seed Tables for this Location
    const tablesMap = (locationTables as any)[loc.slug];
    if (tablesMap) {
      let gridX = 0;
      let gridY = 0;

      for (const [zoneKey, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tablesMap) as any) {
        const zoneEnum = zoneKey.toUpperCase() as 'INDOOR' | 'OUTDOOR' | 'BEACHSIDE';

        for (const t of zoneTables) {
          const isRound = t.type === '2-seater';

          await prisma.diningTable.upsert({
            where: { locationId_label: { locationId: createdLoc.id, label: t.id } },
            update: {
              zone: zoneEnum,
              capacity: t.capacity,
              shape: isRound ? 'round' : 'rect'
            },
            create: {
              locationId: createdLoc.id,
              label: t.id,
              zone: zoneEnum,
              capacity: t.capacity,
              posX: gridX,
              posY: gridY,
              width: isRound ? 2 : (t.capacity >= 6 ? 4 : 2),
              height: 2,
              shape: isRound ? 'round' : 'rect'
            }
          });

          gridX = (gridX + 2) % 12;
          if (gridX === 0) gridY += 2;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  console.log('✓ 7 Locations and 104 Tables seeded');

  // 3. Seed Menu Categories & Items
  const catNames: Record<string, string> = {
    beef: 'Gourmet Beef Burgers',
    chicken: 'Hand-Ground Chicken',
    veg: 'Scratch-Made Vegetarian',
    sides: 'Crispy Sides & Fries',
    shakes: 'Legendary Thick Shakes'
  };

  let sortOrder = 0;
  for (const [slug, name] of Object.entries(catNames)) {
    const category = await prisma.menuCategory.upsert({
      where: { slug },
      update: { name, sortOrder },
      create: { slug, name, sortOrder }
    });
    sortOrder++;

    const items = menuItems.filter(m => m.category === slug);
    for (const item of items) {
      const diet = item.category === 'veg' ? 'VEG' : 'NON_VEG';
      const badge = item.badge === 'popular' ? 'POPULAR' : (item.badge === 'new' ? 'NEW' : null);

      await prisma.menuItem.upsert({
        where: { slug: item.id },
        update: {
          name: item.name,
          description: item.description,
          pricePaise: item.price * 100, // converted to integer paise
          diet,
          badge,
          tags: item.tags,
          image: item.image
        },
        create: {
          categoryId: category.id,
          slug: item.id,
          name: item.name,
          description: item.description,
          pricePaise: item.price * 100,
          diet,
          badge,
          tags: item.tags,
          image: item.image
        }
      });
    }
  }

  console.log('✓ Menu Categories and Items seeded');
  console.log('✨ Database seeding complete!');
}

main()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error('Seed error:', e);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — FASTIFY APP MANIFEST
// ============================================

import fastify from 'fastify';
import cors from '@fastify/cors';
import cookie from '@fastify/cookie';
import jwt from '@fastify/jwt';
import rateLimit from '@fastify/rate-limit';
import { env } from './config/env.js';

import { reservationRoutes } from './modules/reservations/reservation.routes.js';
import { availabilityRoutes } from './modules/availability/availability.routes.js';
import { floorRoutes } from './modules/floor/floor.routes.js';
import { authRoutes } from './modules/auth/auth.routes.js';
import { menuRoutes, locationRoutes } from './modules/menu/menu.routes.js';

export async function buildApp() {
  const app = fastify({
    logger: env.NODE_ENV !== 'test',
    trustProxy: true
  });

  // CORS
  await app.register(cors, {
    origin: [env.CORS_ORIGIN, 'http://localhost:3000', 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'],
    credentials: true
  });

  // Cookies
  await app.register(cookie, {
    secret: env.COOKIE_SECRET
  });

  // JWT
  await app.register(jwt, {
    secret: env.JWT_SECRET,
    cookie: {
      cookieName: 'bf_token',
      signed: false
    }
  });

  // Rate Limiting (Prevents booking spam and ID guessing)
  await app.register(rateLimit, {
    max: 100,
    timeWindow: '1 minute'
  });

  // Health Check
  app.get('/health', async () => ({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    service: 'burger-factory-api'
  }));

  // Register API v1 Routes
  await app.register(async (v1) => {
    v1.register(reservationRoutes, { prefix: '/reservations' });
    v1.register(availabilityRoutes, { prefix: '/availability' });
    v1.register(floorRoutes, { prefix: '/floor' });
    v1.register(authRoutes, { prefix: '/auth' });
    v1.register(menuRoutes, { prefix: '/menu' });
    v1.register(locationRoutes, { prefix: '/locations' });
  }, { prefix: '/api/v1' });

  return app;
}
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — AUTH ROUTES
// Manager & Admin Authentication (Argon2 + JWT Cookie)
// ============================================

import type { FastifyPluginAsync } from 'fastify';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import argon2 from 'argon2';
import { loginSchema } from '@burger-factory/shared';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

export const authRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
  fastify.post('/login', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid login payload' });
    }

    const { email, password } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase() },
      include: { locations: { include: { location: true } } }
    });

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      return reply.status(401).send({ error: 'Invalid email or password' });
    }

    const valid = await argon2.verify(user.passwordHash, password);
    if (!valid) {
      return reply.status(401).send({ error: 'Invalid email or password' });
    }

    // Generate JWT
    const token = fastify.jwt.sign(
      {
        sub: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        name: user.name,
        role: user.role,
        locations: user.locations.map(l => l.location.slug)
      },
      { expiresIn: '7d' }
    );

    // Set HttpOnly Cookie
    reply.setCookie('bf_token', token, {
      path: '/',
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      sameSite: 'lax',
      maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role
      }
    };
  });

  fastify.post('/logout', async (request, reply) => {
    reply.clearCookie('bf_token', { path: '/' });
    return { success: true, message: 'Logged out' };
  });

  fastify.get('/me', async (request, reply) => {
    try {
      await request.jwtVerify();
      return { authenticated: true, user: request.user };
    } catch {
      return reply.status(401).send({ authenticated: false });
    }
  });
};
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — AVAILABILITY ROUTES
// Live Real-Time Slot Grid for Customer UI
// ============================================

import type { FastifyPluginAsync } from 'fastify';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  availabilityQuerySchema,
  TIME_SLOTS,
  TABLE_TURN_MINUTES,
  ZONE_ALIASES
} from '@burger-factory/shared';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

export const availabilityRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
  fastify.get('/', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = availabilityQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid availability query parameters' });
    }

    const { locationId, date, guests, seating } = parsed.data;

    const location = await prisma.location.findFirst({
      where: { OR: [{ id: locationId }, { slug: locationId }] }
    });

    if (!location) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Location not found' });
    }

    const allowedZones = (ZONE_ALIASES[seating || 'any'] || ['indoor', 'outdoor']).map(z => z.toUpperCase());

    // 1. Get all eligible tables for this location and party size
    const candidateTables = await prisma.diningTable.findMany({
      where: {
        locationId: location.id,
        isActive: true,
        capacity: { gte: guests },
        zone: { in: allowedZones as any }
      }
    });

    if (candidateTables.length === 0) {
      return {
        locationId: location.slug,
        date,
        slots: TIME_SLOTS.map(time => ({ time, status: 'full', availableCount: 0 }))
      };
    }

    const dayStart = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00+05:30`);
    const dayEnd = new Date(`${date}T23:59:59+05:30`);

    // 2. Fetch all active reservations for this day
    const dayReservations = await prisma.reservation.findMany({
      where: {
        locationId: location.id,
        status: { notIn: ['CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'] },
        startsAt: { gte: dayStart, lte: dayEnd }
      },
      select: {
        tableId: true,
        startsAt: true,
        endsAt: true
      }
    });

    // 3. Evaluate each time slot
    const slots = TIME_SLOTS.map(time => {
      const slotStart = new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+05:30`);
      const slotEnd = new Date(slotStart.getTime() + TABLE_TURN_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

      let freeCount = 0;

      for (const table of candidateTables) {
        const isBooked = dayReservations.some(r => {
          if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
          return (slotStart < r.endsAt && slotEnd > r.startsAt);
        });

        if (!isBooked) {
          freeCount++;
        }
      }

      let status: 'available' | 'last_tables' | 'full' = 'available';
      if (freeCount === 0) {
        status = 'full';
      } else if (freeCount <= 2) {
        status = 'last_tables';
      }

      return {
        time,
        status,
        availableCount: freeCount
      };
    });

    return {
      locationId: location.slug,
      locationName: location.name,
      date,
      slots
    };
  });
};
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — FLOOR MANAGER ROUTES
// Spatial Floor Canvas, Status Transitions, SSE & CSV
// ============================================

import type { FastifyPluginAsync } from 'fastify';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  walkInReservationSchema,
  updateReservationStatusSchema,
  BOOKING_CODE_CHARS,
  BOOKING_CODE_LENGTH,
  TABLE_TURN_MINUTES
} from '@burger-factory/shared';
import { realtimeHub } from '../../realtime/hub.js';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

function generateCode(): string {
  let code = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < BOOKING_CODE_LENGTH; i++) {
    code += BOOKING_CODE_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CODE_CHARS.length));
  }
  return code;
}

export const floorRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {

  // 1. Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for Floor Managers
  fastify.get('/events', async (request, reply) => {
    const { locationId = 'all' } = request.query as { locationId?: string };

    reply.raw.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
    reply.raw.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
    reply.raw.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
    reply.raw.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');

    const clientId = `client_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
    realtimeHub.addClient(clientId, locationId, reply);

    request.raw.on('close', () => {
      realtimeHub.removeClient(clientId);
    });

    // Keep connection hanging for SSE
    await new Promise(() => {});
  });

  // 2. Get Spatial Floor Canvas Tables & Occupancies
  fastify.get('/manifest', async (request, reply) => {
    const { locationId = 'anjuna', date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] } = request.query as any;

    const location = await prisma.location.findFirst({
      where: { OR: [{ id: locationId }, { slug: locationId }] }
    });

    if (!location) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Location not found' });
    }

    const tables = await prisma.diningTable.findMany({
      where: { locationId: location.id, isActive: true },
      orderBy: [{ zone: 'asc' }, { label: 'asc' }]
    });

    const dayStart = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00+05:30`);
    const dayEnd = new Date(`${date}T23:59:59+05:30`);

    const reservations = await prisma.reservation.findMany({
      where: {
        locationId: location.id,
        status: { notIn: ['CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW'] },
        startsAt: { gte: dayStart, lte: dayEnd }
      }
    });

    const now = new Date();

    const manifestTables = tables.map(t => {
      const activeRes = reservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== t.id) return false;
        if (r.status === 'SEATED') return true;
        return (now >= r.startsAt && now < r.endsAt);
      });

      const upcomingRes = reservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== t.id || r.status !== 'CONFIRMED') return false;
        return r.startsAt > now;
      });

      let status = 'available';
      let currentReservation = undefined;

      if (activeRes && activeRes.status === 'SEATED') {
        status = 'occupied';
        const seatedTime = activeRes.seatedAt || activeRes.startsAt;
        const elapsedMinutes = Math.floor((now.getTime() - new Date(seatedTime).getTime()) / 60000);

        currentReservation = {
          id: activeRes.id,
          code: activeRes.code,
          guestName: activeRes.guestName,
          partySize: activeRes.partySize,
          time: activeRes.startsAt.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
          seatedAt: seatedTime.toISOString(),
          elapsedMinutes
        };
      } else if (activeRes || upcomingRes) {
        status = 'reserved';
        const res = activeRes || upcomingRes!;
        currentReservation = {
          id: res.id,
          code: res.code,
          guestName: res.guestName,
          partySize: res.partySize,
          time: res.startsAt.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
        };
      }

      return {
        id: t.id,
        label: t.label,
        zone: t.zone.toLowerCase(),
        capacity: t.capacity,
        posX: t.posX,
        posY: t.posY,
        width: t.width,
        height: t.height,
        shape: t.shape,
        status,
        currentReservation
      };
    });

    return {
      locationId: location.slug,
      date,
      tables: manifestTables
    };
  });

  // 3. Walk-In Seating directly from Floor Map
  fastify.post('/walkin', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = walkInReservationSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Validation failed', details: parsed.error.format() });
    }

    const { locationId, tableId, guests, name, phone, notes } = parsed.data;

    const location = await prisma.location.findFirst({
      where: { OR: [{ id: locationId }, { slug: locationId }] }
    });

    if (!location) return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Location not found' });

    const table = await prisma.diningTable.findFirst({
      where: {
        locationId: location.id,
        OR: [{ id: tableId }, { label: tableId }]
      }
    });

    if (!table) return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Table not found' });

    const now = new Date();
    const endsAt = new Date(now.getTime() + TABLE_TURN_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);
    const code = generateCode();

    const reservation = await prisma.reservation.create({
      data: {
        code,
        locationId: location.id,
        tableId: table.id,
        guestName: name || 'Walk-in Guest',
        phone: phone || '+910000000000',
        partySize: guests,
        startsAt: now,
        endsAt,
        seatingPref: table.zone,
        status: 'SEATED',
        source: 'WALK_IN',
        seatedAt: now,
        notes: notes || 'Walk-in seated from floor map'
      }
    });

    realtimeHub.broadcast(location.id, 'reservation:seated', {
      tableLabel: table.label,
      guestName: reservation.guestName,
      code: reservation.code
    });

    return reply.status(201).send({
      success: true,
      reservation: {
        code: reservation.code,
        tableLabel: table.label,
        status: 'seated'
      }
    });
  });

  // 4. Update Reservation Status (Seat, Complete, No-Show, Cancel)
  fastify.patch('/reservations/:code/status', async (request, reply) => {
    const { code } = request.params as { code: string };
    const parsed = updateReservationStatusSchema.safeParse(request.body);

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid status' });
    }

    const { status } = parsed.data;
    const now = new Date();

    const existing = await prisma.reservation.findUnique({
      where: { code }
    });

    if (!existing) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Reservation not found' });
    }

    const updateData: any = {
      status: status.toUpperCase()
    };

    if (status === 'seated') updateData.seatedAt = now;
    if (status === 'completed') updateData.completedAt = now;
    if (status === 'no-show') updateData.noShowAt = now;
    if (status === 'cancelled') updateData.cancelledAt = now;

    const updated = await prisma.reservation.update({
      where: { code },
      data: updateData
    });

    realtimeHub.broadcast(existing.locationId, 'reservation:updated', {
      code: updated.code,
      status: updated.status.toLowerCase()
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      code: updated.code,
      status: updated.status.toLowerCase()
    };
  });
};
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — RESERVATION ROUTES
// Public Booking, Secure Lookup & Cancellation
// ============================================

import type { FastifyPluginAsync } from 'fastify';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  createReservationSchema,
  lookupReservationSchema,
  cancelReservationSchema,
  BOOKING_CODE_CHARS,
  BOOKING_CODE_LENGTH,
  TABLE_TURN_MINUTES,
  ZONE_ALIASES
} from '@burger-factory/shared';
import { realtimeHub } from '../../realtime/hub.js';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

function generateCode(): string {
  let code = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < BOOKING_CODE_LENGTH; i++) {
    code += BOOKING_CODE_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CODE_CHARS.length));
  }
  return code;
}

export const reservationRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {

  // 1. Create Public Reservation
  fastify.post('/', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = createReservationSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({
        error: 'Validation failed',
        details: parsed.error.format()
      });
    }

    const { locationId, date, time, guests, seating, name, email, phone, occasion, notes } = parsed.data;

    // Calculate startsAt and endsAt timestamps
    const startsAt = new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+05:30`);
    const endsAt = new Date(startsAt.getTime() + TABLE_TURN_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

    // Look up location
    const location = await prisma.location.findFirst({
      where: { OR: [{ id: locationId }, { slug: locationId }] }
    });

    if (!location) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Location not found' });
    }

    // Determine eligible zones
    const allowedZones = (ZONE_ALIASES[seating] || ['indoor', 'outdoor']).map(z => z.toUpperCase());

    // Best-Fit Table Allocation with Atomic Collision Check
    // We execute inside an interactive transaction to prevent race conditions
    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Find candidate tables
      const candidateTables = await tx.diningTable.findMany({
        where: {
          locationId: location.id,
          isActive: true,
          capacity: { gte: guests },
          zone: { in: allowedZones as any }
        },
        orderBy: { capacity: 'asc' }
      });

      if (candidateTables.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No tables match your party size at this location.');
      }

      // Check collision for each table (overlap: startsAt < existing.endsAt AND endsAt > existing.startsAt)
      let allocatedTable = null;

      for (const table of candidateTables) {
        const collision = await tx.reservation.findFirst({
          where: {
            tableId: table.id,
            status: { notIn: ['CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'] },
            startsAt: { lt: endsAt },
            endsAt: { gt: startsAt }
          }
        });

        if (!collision) {
          allocatedTable = table;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!allocatedTable) {
        throw new Error('All tables are fully booked for this time slot. Please try another time.');
      }

      const code = generateCode();

      const reservation = await tx.reservation.create({
        data: {
          code,
          locationId: location.id,
          tableId: allocatedTable.id,
          guestName: name,
          email: email || null,
          phone,
          partySize: guests,
          startsAt,
          endsAt,
          seatingPref: seating === 'any' ? null : (seating.toUpperCase() as any),
          occasion: occasion || null,
          notes: notes || null,
          status: 'CONFIRMED',
          source: 'ONLINE'
        },
        include: {
          location: true,
          table: true
        }
      });

      return reservation;
    });

    // Broadcast SSE to manager floor canvas
    realtimeHub.broadcast(location.id, 'reservation:created', {
      id: result.id,
      code: result.code,
      guestName: result.guestName,
      partySize: result.partySize,
      time,
      tableLabel: result.table.label,
      tableZone: result.table.zone
    });

    return reply.status(201).send({
      success: true,
      reservation: {
        id: result.id,
        code: result.code,
        name: result.guestName,
        email: result.email,
        phone: result.phone,
        locationId: location.slug,
        locationName: location.name,
        date,
        time,
        guests: result.partySize,
        tableLabel: result.table.label,
        tableZone: result.table.zone.toLowerCase(),
        status: 'confirmed',
        occasion: result.occasion,
        notes: result.notes,
        createdAt: result.createdAt.toISOString()
      }
    });
  });

  // 2. Self-Service Lookup (Protected by phoneLast4 verification)
  fastify.post('/lookup', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = lookupReservationSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid reference or phone digits' });
    }

    const { bookingCode, phoneLast4 } = parsed.data;

    const reservation = await prisma.reservation.findUnique({
      where: { code: bookingCode },
      include: { location: true, table: true }
    });

    if (!reservation) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Reservation not found' });
    }

    // Verify last 4 digits
    const cleanPhone = reservation.phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!cleanPhone.endsWith(phoneLast4)) {
      return reply.status(403).send({ error: 'Phone number verification failed' });
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      reservation: {
        code: reservation.code,
        name: reservation.guestName,
        phone: reservation.phone,
        locationName: reservation.location.name,
        date: reservation.startsAt.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        time: reservation.startsAt.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }),
        guests: reservation.partySize,
        tableLabel: reservation.table.label,
        tableZone: reservation.table.zone.toLowerCase(),
        status: reservation.status.toLowerCase()
      }
    };
  });

  // 3. Self-Service Cancellation (Protected by phoneLast4 verification)
  fastify.post('/cancel', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = cancelReservationSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Invalid cancel request payload' });
    }

    const { bookingCode, phoneLast4, reason } = parsed.data;

    const reservation = await prisma.reservation.findUnique({
      where: { code: bookingCode },
      include: { location: true }
    });

    if (!reservation) {
      return reply.status(404).send({ error: 'Reservation not found' });
    }

    const cleanPhone = reservation.phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!cleanPhone.endsWith(phoneLast4)) {
      return reply.status(403).send({ error: 'Phone verification failed' });
    }

    if (reservation.status === 'CANCELLED') {
      return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'Reservation is already cancelled' });
    }

    const updated = await prisma.reservation.update({
      where: { code: bookingCode },
      data: {
        status: 'CANCELLED',
        cancelledAt: new Date(),
        notes: reason ? `${reservation.notes || ''} [Cancelled: ${reason}]` : reservation.notes
      }
    });

    realtimeHub.broadcast(reservation.locationId, 'reservation:updated', {
      code: updated.code,
      status: 'cancelled'
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Reservation ${bookingCode} cancelled successfully`
    };
  });
};
```

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — REALTIME SSE HUB
// Server-Sent Events for Manager Floor Dashboards
// ============================================

import type { FastifyReply } from 'fastify';

interface ManagerClient {
  id: string;
  locationId: string;
  reply: FastifyReply;
}

class RealtimeHub {
  private clients: Map<string, ManagerClient> = new Map();

  addClient(id: string, locationId: string, reply: FastifyReply) {
    this.clients.set(id, { id, locationId, reply });

    // Send initial handshake
    this.sendToClient(reply, 'connected', { status: 'ok', clientId: id, locationId });
  }

  removeClient(id: string) {
    this.clients.delete(id);
  }

  /**
   * Broadcast an event to all managers of a specific outlet (or all outlets if locationId === 'all')
   */
  broadcast(locationId: string, eventType: string, data: unknown) {
    for (const client of this.clients.values()) {
      if (client.locationId === 'all' || client.locationId === locationId) {
        this.sendToClient(client.reply, eventType, data);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send heartbeat ping every 25 seconds to keep long-lived SSE connections alive across proxies
   */
  startHeartbeat() {
    setInterval(() => {
      const pingData = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      for (const client of this.clients.values()) {
        this.sendToClient(client.reply, 'ping', pingData);
      }
    }, 25000);
  }

  private sendToClient(reply: FastifyReply, eventType: string, data: unknown) {
    try {
      reply.raw.write(`event: ${eventType}\n`);
      reply.raw.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`);
    } catch {
      // client disconnected
    }
  }
}

export const realtimeHub = new RealtimeHub();
realtimeHub.startHeartbeat();
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — SHARED LAN + SSE BOOKING ENGINE
// Synchronizes Customer Portal & Staff Portal across Phone + PC
// ============================================

import { locationTables, locations } from './data.js';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'bf_reservations';
const BOOKING_CHARS = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
const TURN_MINUTES = 90;

const syncChannel = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined'
  ? new BroadcastChannel('bf_reservations_sync')
  : null;

export const TIME_SLOTS = [
  '12:30', '13:00', '13:30', '14:00', '14:30',
  '15:00', '15:30', '16:00', '16:30', '17:00',
  '17:30', '18:00', '18:30', '19:00', '19:30',
  '20:00', '20:30', '21:00', '21:30', '22:00'
];

export function generateBookingCode() {
  let id = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    id += BOOKING_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CHARS.length));
  }
  return id;
}

export function getReservations() {
  try {
    const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveReservationsLocal(reservations) {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(reservations));
}

export async function syncReservationsFromServer() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (Array.isArray(data.reservations)) {
        saveReservationsLocal(data.reservations);
        return data.reservations;
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return getReservations();
}

export function subscribeToLiveUpdates(onUpdate, onConnectionChange = null) {
  try {
    const es = new EventSource('/api/v1/events');
    es.addEventListener('connected', () => {
      if (onConnectionChange) onConnectionChange(true);
    });
    es.addEventListener('reservations:changed', (e) => {
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(e.data);
        if (Array.isArray(payload.reservations)) {
          saveReservationsLocal(payload.reservations);
        }
      } catch {}
      onUpdate();
    });
    es.onerror = () => {
      if (onConnectionChange) onConnectionChange(false);
    };
  } catch {}

  if (syncChannel) {
    syncChannel.onmessage = () => {
      syncReservationsFromServer().then(() => onUpdate());
    };
  }

  window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
    if (e.key === STORAGE_KEY) {
      onUpdate();
    }
  });
}

function notifyPeers() {
  if (syncChannel) {
    try {
      syncChannel.postMessage({ updatedAt: Date.now() });
    } catch {}
  }
}

export function timeToMinutes(time) {
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

export function formatTime(time24) {
  if (!time24) return '';
  const [h, m] = time24.split(':').map(Number);
  const period = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const hour12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return `${hour12}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')} ${period}`;
}

export function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const date = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
}

export function getLocationName(locationId) {
  const loc = locations.find(l => l.id === locationId);
  return loc ? `${loc.name}, ${loc.area}` : locationId;
}

export function checkAvailability(locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref = 'any') {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) {
    return { available: false, table: null, message: 'Location not found' };
  }

  const guestCount = parseInt(guests, 10);
  const reservations = getReservations();

  let allTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const table of zoneTables) {
      allTables.push({ ...table, zone });
    }
  }

  if (seatingPref && seatingPref !== 'any') {
    const prefMap = {
      'indoor': ['indoor'],
      'outdoor': ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
      'beachside': ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
      'rooftop': ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
    };
    const allowedZones = prefMap[seatingPref] || [seatingPref];
    const filtered = allTables.filter(t => allowedZones.includes(t.zone));
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      allTables = filtered;
    }
  }

  allTables = allTables
    .filter(t => t.capacity >= guestCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);

  if (allTables.length === 0) {
    return {
      available: false,
      table: null,
      message: `No single table accommodates ${guestCount} guests at this outlet. Please call the outlet directly.`
    };
  }

  const requestedTimeMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);

  for (const table of allTables) {
    const hasCollision = reservations.some(r => {
      if (r.status === 'cancelled' || r.status === 'no-show' || r.status === 'completed') return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId) return false;
      if (r.date !== date) return false;
      if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;

      const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(requestedTimeMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });

    if (!hasCollision) {
      return {
        available: true,
        table,
        message: `Table ${table.id} (${table.type}, ${table.zone}) is available.`
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    available: false,
    table: null,
    message: 'All suitable tables are booked for this time slot. Please choose another time.'
  };
}

export function getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locationId, date, guests, seatingPref = 'any') {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) return [];

  const guestCount = parseInt(guests, 10) || 2;
  const reservations = getReservations();

  let candidateTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const t of zoneTables) {
      if (seatingPref === 'any' || t.zone === seatingPref || (seatingPref === 'outdoor' && t.zone === 'beachside')) {
        if (t.capacity >= guestCount) {
          candidateTables.push({ ...t, zone });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (candidateTables.length === 0) {
    return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => ({ time, status: 'full', availableCount: 0 }));
  }

  return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => {
    const slotMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);
    let freeCount = 0;

    for (const table of candidateTables) {
      const isOccupied = reservations.some(r => {
        if (r.status === 'cancelled' || r.status === 'no-show' || r.status === 'completed') return false;
        if (r.locationId !== locationId) return false;
        if (r.date !== date) return false;
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;

        const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
        return Math.abs(slotMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
      });

      if (!isOccupied) freeCount++;
    }

    let status = 'available';
    if (freeCount === 0) status = 'full';
    else if (freeCount <= 2) status = 'last_tables';

    return { time, status, availableCount: freeCount };
  });
}

export function getTodayIST() {
  return new Date(Date.now() + 5.5 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

export function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (str == null) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

export async function createReservation(bookingData) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const { locationId, date, time, guests, seating, name, email, phone, occasion, notes } = bookingData;
  const availability = checkAvailability(locationId, date, time, guests, seating);
  if (!availability.available) {
    return { success: false, message: availability.message };
  }

  const unifiedCode = generateBookingCode();

  const candidateReservation = {
    id: unifiedCode,
    code: unifiedCode,
    name: name.trim(),
    email: email ? email.trim() : '',
    phone: phone.trim(),
    locationId,
    locationName: getLocationName(locationId),
    date,
    time,
    guests: parseInt(guests, 10),
    seating: seating || 'any',
    occasion: occasion || '',
    notes: notes || '',
    tableId: availability.table.id,
    tableLabel: availability.table.id,
    tableType: availability.table.type,
    tableZone: availability.table.zone,
    status: 'confirmed',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reservation: candidateReservation })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'All suitable tables are booked for this time slot.' };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const finalReservation = data.reservation || candidateReservation;

    const reservations = getReservations();
    const existingIdx = reservations.findIndex(r => r.code === finalReservation.code || r.id === finalReservation.id);
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      reservations[existingIdx] = finalReservation;
    } else {
      reservations.push(finalReservation);
    }
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: finalReservation };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed. Please try again.' };
  }
}

export async function createWalkInReservation(walkInData) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const { locationId, tableId, tableType, tableZone, guests, name, phone, notes } = walkInData;
  const now = new Date();
  const dateStr = getTodayIST();
  const hh = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const min = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const timeStr = `${hh}:${min}`;

  const unifiedCode = generateBookingCode();

  const candidateReservation = {
    id: unifiedCode,
    code: unifiedCode,
    name: name || 'Walk-in Guest',
    email: '',
    phone: phone || '',
    locationId,
    locationName: getLocationName(locationId),
    date: dateStr,
    time: timeStr,
    guests: parseInt(guests, 10) || 2,
    seating: (tableZone || 'indoor').toLowerCase(),
    occasion: '',
    notes: notes || 'Walk-in seated from floor plan',
    tableId,
    tableLabel: tableId,
    tableType: tableType || 'Table',
    tableZone: tableZone || 'indoor',
    status: 'seated',
    createdAt: now.toISOString(),
    seatedAt: now.toISOString()
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reservation: candidateReservation })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'Walk-in could not be seated on this table' };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const finalReservation = data.reservation || candidateReservation;

    const reservations = getReservations();
    const existingIdx = reservations.findIndex(r => r.code === finalReservation.code || r.id === finalReservation.id);
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      reservations[existingIdx] = finalReservation;
    } else {
      reservations.push(finalReservation);
    }
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: finalReservation };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed. Please try again.' };
  }
}

export async function lookupReservation(bookingCode, phoneLast4) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const cleanCode = bookingCode.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();

  const found = reservations.find(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );
  if (!found) {
    return { success: false, message: `No reservation found with reference ${cleanCode}` };
  }

  const cleanPhone = (found.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const last4 = cleanPhone.slice(-4);

  if (phoneLast4 && last4 && last4 !== phoneLast4.trim()) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Phone verification failed: last 4 digits do not match this booking.'
    };
  }

  return { success: true, reservation: found };
}

export async function cancelReservation(bookingCode, phoneLast4, reason = 'Cancelled by guest') {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const cleanCode = bookingCode.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();
  const idx = reservations.findIndex(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );

  if (idx === -1) {
    return { success: false, message: `Reservation ${cleanCode} not found` };
  }

  const cleanPhone = (reservations[idx].phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const last4 = cleanPhone.slice(-4);

  if (phoneLast4 && last4 && last4 !== phoneLast4.trim()) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Phone verification failed: last 4 digits do not match this booking.'
    };
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: cleanCode, status: 'cancelled', reason })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'Cancellation failed on server' };
    }

    reservations[idx].status = 'cancelled';
    reservations[idx].cancelledAt = new Date().toISOString();
    reservations[idx].cancelReason = reason;
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: reservations[idx] };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed during cancellation' };
  }
}

export async function updateReservationStatus(bookingId, status) {
  const cleanCode = bookingId.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();
  const idx = reservations.findIndex(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );
  if (idx === -1) return false;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: cleanCode, status })
    });

    if (!res.ok) return false;

    reservations[idx].status = status;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (status === 'seated') reservations[idx].seatedAt = now;
    else if (status === 'completed') reservations[idx].completedAt = now;
    else if (status === 'no-show') reservations[idx].noShowAt = now;
    else if (status === 'cancelled') reservations[idx].cancelledAt = now;

    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function getAllReservations() {
  return getReservations();
}

export async function seedDemoReservations() {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — ICS CALENDAR GENERATOR
// ============================================

/**
 * Generates an .ics iCalendar file and triggers instant browser download.
 */
export function downloadCalendarEvent(reservation) {
  const { code, locationName, date, time, guests } = reservation;
  
  // Format date and time for ICS (UTC or local formatted as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS)
  const [year, month, day] = date.split('-');
  const [hour, min] = time.split(':');
  
  const startDate = `${year}${month}${day}T${hour}${min}00`;
  
  // Add 90 minutes for end time
  const startObj = new Date(`${date}T${time}:00`);
  const endObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + 90 * 60 * 1000);
  const endYear = endObj.getFullYear();
  const endMonth = String(endObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const endDay = String(endObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endHour = String(endObj.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endMin = String(endObj.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endDate = `${endYear}${endMonth}${endDay}T${endHour}${endMin}00`;

  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//The Burger Factory//Table Booking//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
    `UID:BF-${code}-${nowStr}@burgerfactory.in`,
    `DTSTAMP:${nowStr}`,
    `DTSTART:${startDate}`,
    `DTEND:${endDate}`,
    `SUMMARY:Burger Factory Booking (${code}) - ${locationName}`,
    `DESCRIPTION:Reservation for ${guests} guests at The Burger Factory (${locationName}).\\nBooking Reference: ${code}\\nPlease arrive 10-15 mins early.`,
    `LOCATION:The Burger Factory, ${locationName}`,
    'STATUS:CONFIRMED',
    'END:VEVENT',
    'END:VCALENDAR'
  ].join('\r\n');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.setAttribute('download', `Burger-Factory-Reservation-${code}.ics`);
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```

```javascript
import { menuItems, locations, reviews, burgerJokes } from './data.js';

export function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
  if (!container) {
    container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'toast-container';
    document.body.appendChild(container);
  }

  const labels = {
    success: 'OK',
    error: 'ERR',
    info: 'INFO',
    warning: 'NOTE'
  };

  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px;">${labels[type] || 'INFO'}</span>
    <span>${message}</span>
  `;

  container.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('toast-show'));

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove('toast-show');
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
  }, 3500);
}

let refreshStripSlotsFn = () => {};

// ---- Burger Jokes Rotator ----
function initRandomBurgerJoke() {
  const headlineEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-headline');
  const punchlineEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-punchline');
  const authorEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-author');
  const shuffleBtn = document.getElementById('btn-shuffle-joke');

  if (!headlineEl || !punchlineEl || !authorEl) return;

  let lastIndex = -1;

  function pickJoke() {
    let idx;
    do {
      idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * burgerJokes.length);
    } while (idx === lastIndex && burgerJokes.length > 1);
    lastIndex = idx;
    return burgerJokes[idx];
  }

  function displayJoke(joke) {
    headlineEl.style.opacity = '0';
    punchlineEl.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      headlineEl.textContent = `"${joke.headline}"`;
      punchlineEl.textContent = joke.punchline;
      authorEl.textContent = `BOARD NOTE · ${joke.author.toUpperCase()}`;
      headlineEl.style.opacity = '1';
      punchlineEl.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 180);
  }

  // Show initial joke
  displayJoke(pickJoke());

  shuffleBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    displayJoke(pickJoke());
  });
}

function initNavbar() {
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
  const mobileClose = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-close');

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    navbar?.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 30);
  }, { passive: true });

  hamburger?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu?.classList.toggle('open');
  });

  mobileClose?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open');
  });

  mobileMenu?.querySelector('.mobile-menu-overlay')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open'));
  });

  // Also close mobile menu when mobile bottom bar links are tapped
  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-bottom-bar a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open'));
  });

  initNavActiveTracking();
}

function initNavActiveTracking() {
  const sectionIds = ['hero', 'about', 'menu', 'locations', 'reviews', 'lookup-section'];
  const sections = sectionIds
    .map(id => ({ id, el: document.getElementById(id) }))
    .filter(s => s.el !== null);

  const desktopLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link[href^="#"]');
  const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link[href^="#"]');

  function setActiveLink(activeId) {
    desktopLinks.forEach(link => {
      const target = link.getAttribute('href')?.replace('#', '');
      link.classList.toggle('active', target === activeId);
    });
    mobileLinks.forEach(link => {
      const target = link.getAttribute('href')?.replace('#', '');
      link.classList.toggle('active', target === activeId);
    });
  }

  let isScrolling = false;
  function handleScroll() {
    const scrollPos = window.scrollY;
    const headerOffset = 160;

    let currentId = 'hero';
    for (const { id, el } of sections) {
      const top = el.offsetTop - headerOffset;
      if (scrollPos >= top) {
        currentId = id;
      }
    }
    setActiveLink(currentId);
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!isScrolling) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        handleScroll();
        isScrolling = false;
      });
      isScrolling = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });
}

function initHeroAvailabilityStrip() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('strip-location');
  const minusBtn = document.getElementById('strip-guest-minus');
  const plusBtn = document.getElementById('strip-guest-plus');
  const guestVal = document.getElementById('strip-guest-val');
  const slotsContainer = document.getElementById('strip-slots-container');

  if (!locSelect || !slotsContainer) return;

  let currentGuests = 2;
  const todayStr = getTodayIST();

  function refreshStripSlots() {
    const locId = locSelect.value;
    const slots = getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locId, todayStr, currentGuests, 'any');
    const displaySlots = slots.slice(0, 8);

    slotsContainer.innerHTML = displaySlots.map(s => `
      <div class="chip-slot ${s.status}" data-time="${s.time}">
        <span class="slot-time">${formatTime(s.time).replace(':00', '')}</span>
        <span class="slot-hint">${s.status === 'full' ? 'Full' : s.status === 'last_tables' ? 'Last 2' : 'Open'}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    slotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot:not(.full)').forEach(chip => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const selectedTime = chip.dataset.time;
        const bookLoc = document.getElementById('book-location');
        if (bookLoc) bookLoc.value = locId;

        setBookingGuests(currentGuests);

        const timeInput = document.getElementById('book-selected-time');
        if (timeInput) timeInput.value = selectedTime;

        const sumOutlet = document.getElementById('sum-outlet');
        if (sumOutlet) sumOutlet.textContent = getLocationName(locId).split(',')[0];
        const sumTime = document.getElementById('sum-time');
        if (sumTime) sumTime.textContent = formatTime(selectedTime);

        renderBookingSlotChips();
        document.getElementById('booking')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    });
  }

  refreshStripSlotsFn = refreshStripSlots;

  minusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentGuests > 1) {
      currentGuests--;
      guestVal.textContent = `${currentGuests} Guest${currentGuests > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
      refreshStripSlots();
    }
  });

  plusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentGuests < 10) {
      currentGuests++;
      guestVal.textContent = `${currentGuests} Guests`;
      refreshStripSlots();
    }
  });

  locSelect.addEventListener('change', refreshStripSlots);
  refreshStripSlots();
}

// ---- Card-based menu renderer (no dotted leaders) ----
function renderMenu(category = 'all') {
  const container = document.getElementById('menu-items-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const filtered = category === 'all' ? menuItems : menuItems.filter(item => item.category === category);

  container.innerHTML = filtered.map(item => {
    const isVeg = item.diet === 'veg' || item.category === 'veg';
    const dietClass = isVeg ? 'veg' : 'non-veg';

    const badgeHtml = item.badge === 'popular'
      ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-popular">Bestseller</span>`
      : item.badge === 'new'
        ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-new">New</span>`
        : item.badge === 'veg'
          ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-veg">Pure Veg</span>`
          : '';

    return `
      <article class="menu-item-block">
        <div class="menu-row">
          <div class="menu-title-wrap">
            <span class="diet-badge ${dietClass}" title="${isVeg ? 'Vegetarian' : 'Non-Vegetarian'}"></span>
            <h3 class="menu-name">${item.name}</h3>
          </div>
          <span class="menu-price">&#8377;${item.price}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="menu-item-desc">${item.description}</p>
        <div class="menu-item-tags">
          ${item.tags.map(t => `<span class="menu-tag-pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
          ${badgeHtml}
        </div>
      </article>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function initMenuFilters() {
  const tabs = document.getElementById('menu-category-tabs');
  tabs?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.chip');
    if (!btn) return;

    tabs.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    renderMenu(btn.dataset.cat);
  });
}

let bookingGuests = 2;

function setBookingGuests(num) {
  bookingGuests = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, num));
  const valEl = document.getElementById('book-guest-val');
  const labelEl = document.getElementById('book-guest-label');
  const summaryEl = document.getElementById('sum-guests');

  if (valEl) valEl.textContent = bookingGuests;
  if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = `${bookingGuests === 1 ? 'Guest' : 'Guests'} (${bookingGuests <= 2 ? '2-seater' : bookingGuests <= 4 ? '4-seater' : bookingGuests <= 6 ? '6-seater' : 'Large Table'})`;
  if (summaryEl) summaryEl.textContent = `${bookingGuests} ${bookingGuests === 1 ? 'Guest' : 'Guests'}`;

  renderBookingSlotChips();
}

function renderBookingSlotChips() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('book-location');
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('book-date');
  const zoneSelect = document.getElementById('book-zone');
  const chipsContainer = document.getElementById('time-slot-chips');
  const timeInput = document.getElementById('book-selected-time');

  if (!locSelect || !dateInput || !chipsContainer) return;

  const locId = locSelect.value;
  const dateStr = dateInput.value;
  const seating = zoneSelect ? zoneSelect.value : 'any';

  const slotData = getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locId, dateStr, bookingGuests, seating);
  const selectedTime = timeInput ? timeInput.value : '13:00';

  chipsContainer.innerHTML = slotData.map(s => {
    const isSelected = s.time === selectedTime;
    return `
      <div class="chip-slot ${s.status} ${isSelected ? 'active' : ''}" data-time="${s.time}">
        <span class="slot-time">${formatTime(s.time).replace(':00', '')}</span>
        <span class="slot-hint">${s.status === 'full' ? 'Full' : s.status === 'last_tables' ? 'Last 2' : 'Open'}</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  chipsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot:not(.full)').forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      chipsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      chip.classList.add('active');
      const chosen = chip.dataset.time;
      if (timeInput) timeInput.value = chosen;

      const sumTime = document.getElementById('sum-time');
      if (sumTime) sumTime.textContent = formatTime(chosen);
    });
  });
}

function initBookingFlow() {
  const form = document.getElementById('main-booking-form');
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('book-date');
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('book-location');
  const zoneSelect = document.getElementById('book-zone');
  const minusBtn = document.getElementById('book-guest-minus');
  const plusBtn = document.getElementById('book-guest-plus');

  const todayStr = getTodayIST();

  if (dateInput) {
    dateInput.min = todayStr;
    dateInput.value = todayStr;
  }

  minusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => setBookingGuests(bookingGuests - 1));
  plusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => setBookingGuests(bookingGuests + 1));

  locSelect?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumLoc = document.getElementById('sum-outlet');
    if (sumLoc) sumLoc.textContent = getLocationName(locSelect.value).split(',')[0];
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  dateInput?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumDate = document.getElementById('sum-date');
    if (sumDate) sumDate.textContent = formatDate(dateInput.value);
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  zoneSelect?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumZone = document.getElementById('sum-zone');
    if (sumZone) sumZone.textContent = zoneSelect.options[zoneSelect.selectedIndex].text;
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  renderBookingSlotChips();

  form?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const name = form.querySelector('#book-name').value.trim();
    const phone = form.querySelector('#book-phone').value.trim();
    const email = form.querySelector('#book-email').value.trim();
    const locationId = locSelect.value;
    const date = dateInput.value;
    const time = document.getElementById('book-selected-time').value;
    const seating = zoneSelect.value;
    const occasion = form.querySelector('#book-occasion').value;
    const notes = form.querySelector('#book-notes').value.trim();

    if (!name || name.length < 2) {
      showToast('Please enter your full name', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    if (!phone || !/^(\+91[\-\s]?)?[0]?[6789]\d{9}$/.test(phone.replace(/\s+/g, ''))) {
      showToast('Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const result = await createReservation({
      name,
      phone,
      email,
      locationId,
      date,
      time,
      guests: bookingGuests,
      seating,
      occasion,
      notes
    });

    if (!result.success) {
      showToast(result.message, 'error');
      return;
    }

    const reservation = result.reservation;
    reservation.dateFormatted = formatDate(reservation.date);
    reservation.timeFormatted = formatTime(reservation.time);

    const mount = document.getElementById('ticket-modal-mount');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('booking-modal-overlay');

    if (mount && overlay) {
      mount.innerHTML = renderThermalTicket(reservation);
      attachTicketListeners(reservation);

      document.getElementById('btn-ticket-done')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        overlay.classList.remove('open');
      });

      overlay.classList.add('open');
    }

    showToast(`Table ${reservation.tableLabel} confirmed (${reservation.code})`, 'success');
    form.reset();
    dateInput.value = todayStr;
    setBookingGuests(2);
    refreshStripSlotsFn();
  });
}

function initLookupSection() {
  const form = document.getElementById('lookup-form');
  const resultContainer = document.getElementById('lookup-result-container');

  if (!form || !resultContainer) return;

  async function runLookup() {
    const ref = document.getElementById('lookup-ref').value.trim();
    const phone4 = document.getElementById('lookup-phone4').value.trim();

    if (!ref || !phone4 || phone4.length !== 4) {
      showToast('Please enter your booking reference and last 4 digits of phone', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const result = await lookupReservation(ref, phone4);
    resultContainer.style.display = 'block';

    if (!result.success) {
      resultContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div style="background: rgba(214,59,39,0.1); border: 1.5px solid var(--ketchup); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1rem; color: var(--ketchup-dark); font-weight: 600;">
          ${result.message}
        </div>
      `;
      showToast(result.message, 'error');
      return;
    }

    const r = result.reservation;
    const isActive = r.status === 'confirmed' || r.status === 'seated';

    resultContainer.innerHTML = `
      <div style="background: var(--paper-deep); border: var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-xs);">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(28,23,19,0.25); padding-bottom: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--ketchup);">${escapeHtml(r.code)}</strong>
          <span class="status-pill ${r.status}">${escapeHtml(r.status.toUpperCase())}</span>
        </div>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
          <strong>Guest:</strong> ${escapeHtml(r.name)} · <strong>Party:</strong> ${r.guests} Guests
        </p>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
          <strong>Outlet:</strong> ${escapeHtml(r.locationName)} (Table ${escapeHtml(r.tableLabel || r.tableId)})
        </p>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 1rem;">
          <strong>Date &amp; Time:</strong> ${formatDate(r.date)} at ${formatTime(r.time)}
        </p>

        ${isActive ? `
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ketchup btn-sm" id="btn-cancel-reservation" data-code="${r.code}">
            Cancel Reservation
          </button>
        ` : `
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ketchup);">
            Status: ${r.status.toUpperCase()} — Table has been released.
          </div>
        `}
      </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('btn-cancel-reservation')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (confirm(`Cancel reservation ${r.code} for ${r.name}?`)) {
        const cancelRes = await cancelReservation(r.code, phone4, 'Cancelled by customer online');
        if (cancelRes.success) {
          showToast(`Reservation ${r.code} cancelled. Staff Portal updated.`, 'info');
          await runLookup();
          refreshStripSlotsFn();
          renderBookingSlotChips();
        } else {
          showToast(cancelRes.message, 'error');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    runLookup();
  });
}
```

```javascript
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
```
