  await seedDemoReservations();
  initClock();
  initFilters();
  initShortcuts();
  initWalkInModal();
  refreshDashboard();

  const liveBadge = document.getElementById('mgr-live-status');
  subscribeToLiveUpdates(
    () => {
      refreshDashboard();
    },
    (online) => {
      if (liveBadge) {
        liveBadge.textContent = online ? 'LIVE SYNC' : 'LOCAL MODE';
        liveBadge.classList.toggle('live', online);
        liveBadge.classList.toggle('reconnecting', !online);
      }
    }
  );

  setInterval(async () => {
    await syncReservationsFromServer();
    refreshDashboard();
  }, 10000);
});

function initStaffAuthGate() {
  const gate = document.getElementById('staff-auth-gate');
  const form = document.getElementById('staff-gate-form');
  const passInput = document.getElementById('staff-gate-pass');
  const errEl = document.getElementById('staff-gate-error');
  const autofillBtn = document.getElementById('btn-gate-autofill');

  if (sessionStorage.getItem('bf_staff_auth') === 'true') {
    gate?.classList.remove('open');
  } else {
    gate?.classList.add('open');
  }

  autofillBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (passInput) {
      passInput.value = 'burger123';
      passInput.focus();
    }
  });

  form?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const val = (passInput?.value || '').trim();
    if (['burger123', '1234', 'staff123', 'GoaBurgers2026!'].includes(val)) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('bf_staff_auth', 'true');
      gate?.classList.remove('open');
      refreshDashboard();
    } else if (errEl) {
      errEl.textContent = 'Incorrect passcode. Default passcode is burger123';
      errEl.style.display = 'block';
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-mgr-logout')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem('bf_staff_auth');
    gate?.classList.add('open');
  });
}

function initClock() {
  const clockEl = document.getElementById('mgr-live-clock');
  function updateTime() {
    if (clockEl) {
      const now = new Date();
      clockEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
    }
  }
  updateTime();
  setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
}

function initFilters() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('mgr-location-filter');
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('mgr-date-filter');
  const statusTabs = document.getElementById('mgr-status-filters');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('mgr-search');

  const todayStr = getTodayIST();
  currentDate = todayStr;
  if (dateInput) {
    dateInput.value = todayStr;
    dateInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      currentDate = e.target.value;
      refreshDashboard();
    });
  }

  locSelect?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    currentLocation = e.target.value;
    refreshDashboard();
  });

  statusTabs?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.status-filter-btn');
    if (!btn) return;

    statusTabs.querySelectorAll('.status-filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    currentStatus = btn.dataset.status;
    refreshDashboard();
  });

  let debounceTimer;
  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      searchQuery = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      refreshDashboard();
    }, 200);
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-refresh-dashboard')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    await syncReservationsFromServer();
    refreshDashboard();
    showManagerToast('Synced latest reservations', 'info');
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-export-csv')?.addEventListener('click', exportCSV);

  document.getElementById('btn-print-daysheet')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    renderPrintDaySheet();
    window.print();
  });
}

function initShortcuts() {
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.getElementById('mgr-search')?.focus();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay')?.classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
}

function refreshDashboard() {
  const allReservations = getAllReservations();
  let filtered = allReservations.filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate);

  updateCounts(filtered);

  if (currentStatus !== 'all') {
    filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.status === currentStatus);
  }

  if (searchQuery) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(r =>
      r.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) ||
      (r.code && r.code.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
      (r.id && r.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
      r.phone.includes(searchQuery)
    );
  }

  filtered.sort((a, b) => {
    const order = { seated: 0, confirmed: 1, completed: 2, 'no-show': 3, cancelled: 4 };
    const sa = order[a.status] ?? 5;
    const sb = order[b.status] ?? 5;
    if (sa !== sb) return sa - sb;
    return a.time.localeCompare(b.time);
  });

  renderTable(filtered);
  renderArrivingSoon(allReservations);
  renderFloorCanvas(allReservations);
  renderPrintDaySheet();
}

function updateCounts(reservations) {
  const total = reservations.filter(r => r.status !== 'cancelled' && r.status !== 'no-show').length;
  const confirmed = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'confirmed').length;
  const seated = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'seated').length;
  const completed = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'completed').length;
  const noshow = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'no-show').length;
  const cancelled = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'cancelled').length;
  const guests = reservations
    .filter(r => r.status !== 'cancelled' && r.status !== 'no-show')
    .reduce((sum, r) => sum + (parseInt(r.guests, 10) || 0), 0);

  document.getElementById('stat-active').textContent = total;
  document.getElementById('stat-confirmed').textContent = confirmed;
  document.getElementById('stat-seated').textContent = seated;
  document.getElementById('stat-guests').textContent = guests;
  document.getElementById('stat-completed').textContent = completed;
  document.getElementById('stat-noshow').textContent = cancelled + noshow;

  document.getElementById('count-all').textContent = reservations.length;
  document.getElementById('count-confirmed').textContent = confirmed;
  document.getElementById('count-seated').textContent = seated;
  document.getElementById('count-completed').textContent = completed;
  document.getElementById('count-noshow').textContent = noshow;
  document.getElementById('count-cancelled').textContent = cancelled;
}

function renderTable(reservations) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('mgr-table-body');
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('mgr-table-empty');
  const table = document.getElementById('mgr-reservations-table');

  if (!tbody) return;

  if (reservations.length === 0) {
    table.style.display = 'none';
    emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  table.style.display = '';
  emptyEl.style.display = 'none';

  tbody.innerHTML = reservations.map(r => {
    const code = r.code || r.id;
    let actionButtons = '';

    if (r.status === 'confirmed') {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-mustard btn-sm" data-action="seated" data-id="${code}">Seat</button>
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="no-show" data-id="${code}">No-Show</button>
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="cancelled" data-id="${code}">Cancel</button>
      `;
    } else if (r.status === 'seated') {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-sea btn-sm" data-action="completed" data-id="${code}">Complete</button>
      `;
    } else {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="confirmed" data-id="${code}">Restore</button>
      `;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td data-label="REF"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--ketchup);">${escapeHtml(code)}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="GUEST">
          <strong>${escapeHtml(r.name)}</strong><br/>
          <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-mono);">${escapeHtml(r.phone)}</span>
          ${r.notes ? `<div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--sea); margin-top: 2px;">Note: ${escapeHtml(r.notes)}</div>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td data-label="TIME"><span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700;">${formatTime(r.time)}</span></td>
        <td data-label="PAX"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.guests}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="TABLE"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.tableLabel || r.tableId}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="ZONE"><span style="font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.tableZone}</span></td>
        <td data-label="STATUS"><span class="status-pill ${r.status}">${r.status.toUpperCase()}</span></td>
        <td data-label="ACTIONS"><div class="table-action-group">${actionButtons}</div></td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const action = btn.dataset.action;
      const id = btn.dataset.id;
      const prevRes = getAllReservations().find(res => (res.code === id || res.id === id));
      const previousStatus = prevRes ? prevRes.status : 'confirmed';

      await updateReservationStatus(id, action);
      refreshDashboard();

      showManagerToast(
        `Reservation ${id} marked as ${action.toUpperCase()}`,
        'info',
        async () => {
          await updateReservationStatus(id, previousStatus);
          refreshDashboard();
          showManagerToast(`Restored ${id} to ${previousStatus.toUpperCase()}`, 'success');
        }
      );
    });
  });
}

function renderArrivingSoon(allReservations) {
  const container = document.getElementById('arriving-lane-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();

  const arriving = allReservations.filter(r => {
    if (r.locationId !== currentLocation || r.date !== currentDate || r.status !== 'confirmed') return false;
    const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
    const diff = (h * 60 + m) - currentMinutes;
    return diff >= -15 && diff <= 45;
  });

  if (arriving.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-soft);">No confirmed arrivals scheduled within the next 30 minutes.</span>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = arriving.map(r => `
    <div class="arriving-card">
      <div>
        <span class="arriving-time">${formatTime(r.time)}</span>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.84rem;">${escapeHtml(r.name)} (${r.guests} pax)</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-mono);">${escapeHtml(r.tableLabel || r.tableId)} · ${escapeHtml(r.tableZone.toUpperCase())}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-mustard btn-sm" data-arrive-seat="${r.code || r.id}">
        Seat Now
      </button>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  container.querySelectorAll('[data-arrive-seat]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const id = btn.dataset.arriveSeat;
      await updateReservationStatus(id, 'seated');
      refreshDashboard();
      showManagerToast(`Seated reservation ${id}`, 'success');
    });
  });
}

function renderFloorCanvas(allReservations) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('mgr-floor-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;

  const tables = locationTables[currentLocation];
  if (!tables) {
    canvas.innerHTML = '<p>No table map configured for this outlet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const todayStr = getTodayIST();
  const isToday = currentDate === todayStr;
  const now = new Date();
  const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  let html = '';

  const outletReservations = allReservations
    .filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate)
    .sort((a, b) => a.time.localeCompare(b.time));

  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const table of zoneTables) {
      const active = outletReservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
        if (['cancelled', 'completed', 'no-show'].includes(r.status)) return false;

        const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
        const startMin = h * 60 + m;
        const endMin = startMin + 90;

        if (r.status === 'seated') return true;
        if (isToday) {
          return startMin <= currentMinutes && currentMinutes < endMin;
        }
        return false;
      });

      const upcoming = outletReservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
        if (r.status !== 'confirmed') return false;

        if (isToday) {
          const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
          return (h * 60 + m) > currentMinutes;
        }
        return true;
      });

      let status = 'available';
      let guestName = '';
      let timerText = '';
      let isOvertime = false;

      if (active && active.status === 'seated') {
        status = 'occupied';
        guestName = active.name;

        const seatedTime = active.seatedAt ? new Date(active.seatedAt).getTime() : (now.getTime() - 20 * 60000);
        const elapsedMin = Math.max(1, Math.floor((now.getTime() - seatedTime) / 60000));
        timerText = `${elapsedMin}m / 90m`;

        if (elapsedMin > 90) {
          isOvertime = true;
          timerText = `OVERTIME (${elapsedMin}m)`;
        }
      } else if (active || upcoming) {
        status = 'reserved';
        const res = active || upcoming;
        guestName = `${formatTime(res.time)} · ${res.name}`;
      }

      const isRound = table.type === '2-seater';

      html += `
        <div class="floor-table-card ${status} ${isOvertime ? 'overtime' : ''} ${isRound ? 'shape-round' : ''}"
             data-table-id="${table.id}"
             data-table-type="${table.type}"
             data-table-zone="${zone}"
             data-table-capacity="${table.capacity}"
             data-status="${status}"
             data-res-id="${active ? (active.code || active.id) : (upcoming ? (upcoming.code || upcoming.id) : '')}">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%;">
            <span class="table-code">${table.id}</span>
            <span class="table-capacity">${table.capacity}P</span>
          </div>

          <div style="margin: 4px 0; width: 100%;">
            <span class="table-status-tag">${status.toUpperCase()}</span>
            ${guestName ? `<div class="table-guest-name">${guestName}</div>` : ''}
            ${timerText ? `<div class="table-turn-timer ${isOvertime ? 'warning' : ''}">${timerText}</div>` : ''}
          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--ink-soft); text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-mono);">
            ${zone}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
  }

  canvas.innerHTML = html;

  canvas.querySelectorAll('.floor-table-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const status = card.dataset.status;
      const tableId = card.dataset.tableId;
      const type = card.dataset.tableType;
      const zone = card.dataset.tableZone;
      const resId = card.dataset.resId;

      if (status === 'available') {
        openWalkInModal(tableId, type, zone);
      } else if (resId) {
        showManagerToast(`Table ${tableId} assigned to booking ${resId}`, 'info');
      }
    });
  });
}

let selectedWalkInTable = null;

function initWalkInModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-close-walkin');
  const form = document.getElementById('walkin-form');

  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => overlay.classList.remove('open'));
  overlay?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === overlay) overlay.classList.remove('open');
  });

  form?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedWalkInTable) return;

    const name = document.getElementById('walkin-name').value.trim() || 'Walk-in Guest';
    const guests = document.getElementById('walkin-guests').value;
    const phone = document.getElementById('walkin-phone').value.trim();

    await createWalkInReservation({
      locationId: currentLocation,
      tableId: selectedWalkInTable.id,
      tableType: selectedWalkInTable.type,
      tableZone: selectedWalkInTable.zone,
      guests,
      name,
      phone
    });

    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    refreshDashboard();
    showManagerToast(`Walk-in party seated at Table ${selectedWalkInTable.id}`, 'success');
  });
}

function openWalkInModal(tableId, type, zone) {
  selectedWalkInTable = { id: tableId, type, zone };
  const overlay = document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay');
  const title = document.getElementById('walkin-table-title');
  const desc = document.getElementById('walkin-table-desc');

  if (title) title.textContent = `Seat Walk-In at Table ${tableId}`;
  if (desc) desc.textContent = `${type} · ${zone.toUpperCase()} ZONE · Immediate 90-min turn`;

  overlay.classList.add('open');
}

function renderPrintDaySheet() {
  const mount = document.getElementById('print-daysheet-container');
  if (!mount) return;

  const locObj = locations.find(l => l.id === currentLocation) || locations[0];
  const dayRecords = getAllReservations()
    .filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate)
    .sort((a, b) => a.time.localeCompare(b.time));

  const activeRecords = dayRecords.filter(r => r.status !== 'cancelled' && r.status !== 'no-show');
  const totalCovers = activeRecords.reduce((s, r) => s + (parseInt(r.guests, 10) || 0), 0);

  const lunchCovers = activeRecords
    .filter(r => parseInt(r.time.split(':')[0], 10) < 17)
    .reduce((s, r) => s + (parseInt(r.guests, 10) || 0), 0);

  const dinnerCovers = totalCovers - lunchCovers;

  const specialBriefing = activeRecords.filter(
    r => r.guests >= 6 || (r.occasion && r.occasion !== '') || (r.notes && r.notes !== '')
  );

  const outletZones = locationTables[currentLocation] || {};
  const allOutletTables = [];
  for (const [z, list] of Object.entries(outletZones)) {
    for (const t of list) allOutletTables.push({ ...t, zone: z.toUpperCase() });
  }

  const printedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN', {
    dateStyle: 'medium',
    timeStyle: 'short'
  });

  mount.innerHTML = `
    <div class="daysheet-page">
      <header class="ds-header">
        <div>
          <div class="ds-kicker">THE BURGER FACTORY · DAILY HOST STAND & PRE-SHIFT BRIEFING SHEET</div>
          <h1 class="ds-title">${locObj.name.toUpperCase()} (${locObj.area.toUpperCase()}) — SERVICE MANIFEST</h1>
          <div class="ds-subtitle">${locObj.address} · Operating Hours: ${locObj.hours}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ds-meta-box">
          <div><strong>SERVICE DATE:</strong> ${formatDate(currentDate)}</div>
          <div><strong>PRINTED AT:</strong> ${printedAt}</div>
          <div><strong>DUTY MANAGER:</strong> ______________________</div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <table class="ds-summary-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>TOTAL BOOKINGS</th>
            <th>EXPECTED COVERS</th>
            <th>LUNCH COVERS (12:30-16:30)</th>
            <th>DINNER COVERS (17:00-22:00)</th>
            <th>CONFIRMED</th>
            <th>SEATED</th>
            <th>COMPLETED</th>
            <th>CANCELLED / NO-SHOW</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td>${activeRecords.length}</td>
            <td>${totalCovers} PAX</td>
            <td>${lunchCovers} PAX</td>
            <td>${dinnerCovers} PAX</td>
            <td>${dayRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'confirmed').length}</td>
            <td>${dayRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'seated').length}</td>
            <td>${dayRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'completed').length}</td>
            <td>${dayRecords.filter(r => ['cancelled', 'no-show'].includes(r.status)).length}</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div class="ds-section-heading">SECTION A — VIP, LARGE PARTIES (6+ PAX) & SPECIAL OCCASION BRIEFING</div>
      ${specialBriefing.length === 0 ? `
        <div class="ds-empty-box">No large groups (6+ pax) or special occasion requests logged for this date.</div>
      ` : `
        <table class="ds-manifest-table" style="margin-bottom: 14px;">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style="width: 10%;">TIME</th>
              <th style="width: 14%;">REF CODE</th>
              <th style="width: 22%;">GUEST NAME</th>
              <th style="width: 8%;">PAX</th>
              <th style="width: 14%;">TABLE / ZONE</th>
              <th style="width: 14%;">OCCASION</th>
              <th>KITCHEN / SETUP / DIETARY NOTES</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${specialBriefing.map(r => `
              <tr>
                <td><strong>${formatTime(r.time)}</strong></td>
                <td class="ds-mono">${r.code || r.id}</td>
                <td><strong>${r.name}</strong></td>
                <td><strong>${r.guests}</strong></td>
                <td class="ds-mono">${r.tableLabel || r.tableId} (${r.tableZone.toUpperCase()})</td>
                <td>${r.occasion ? r.occasion.toUpperCase() : '—'}</td>
                <td>${r.notes || 'Standard table setup'}</td>
              </tr>
            `).join('')}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      `}

      <div class="ds-section-heading">SECTION B — CHRONOLOGICAL RESERVATIONS RUN-SHEET (PODIUM CHECK-IN LOG)</div>
      <table class="ds-manifest-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width: 5%;">ARR</th>
            <th style="width: 10%;">SLOT TIME</th>
            <th style="width: 12%;">REF CODE</th>
            <th style="width: 22%;">GUEST NAME & PHONE</th>
            <th style="width: 6%;">PAX</th>
            <th style="width: 13%;">TABLE / ZONE</th>
            <th style="width: 11%;">STATUS</th>
            <th style="width: 13%;">NOTES / OCCASION</th>
            <th style="width: 8%;">TIME IN</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

          ${dayRecords.length === 0 ? `

              <td>${[r.occasion ? r.occasion.toUpperCase() : '', r.notes || ''].filter(Boolean).join(' — ') || '—'}</td>
              <td>${r.seatedAt ? new Date(r.seatedAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '____'}</td>
            </tr>
          `).join('')}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div class="ds-section-heading" style="margin-top: 14px;">SECTION C — FLOOR TABLE TURN & WALK-IN HANDWRITTEN SHEET</div>
      <table class="ds-manifest-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width: 12%;">TABLE ID</th>
            <th style="width: 12%;">ZONE</th>
            <th style="width: 10%;">CAPACITY</th>
            <th style="width: 22%;">TURN 1 (12:30 - 15:30)</th>
            <th style="width: 22%;">TURN 2 (18:30 - 20:30)</th>
            <th style="width: 22%;">TURN 3 (20:30 - CLOSE)</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${allOutletTables.map(t => {
            const tableBookings = activeRecords.filter(r => (r.tableLabel || r.tableId) === t.id);
            const t1 = tableBookings.find(r => parseInt(r.time.split(':')[0], 10) < 17);
            const t2 = tableBookings.find(r => {
              const h = parseInt(r.time.split(':')[0], 10);
              return h >= 17 && h < 20;
            });
            const t3 = tableBookings.find(r => parseInt(r.time.split(':')[0], 10) >= 20);

            return `
              <tr>
                <td class="ds-mono"><strong>${t.id}</strong></td>
                <td class="ds-mono">${t.zone}</td>
                <td>${t.capacity} Pax</td>
                <td>${t1 ? `${formatTime(t1.time)} ${escapeHtml(t1.name)} (${t1.guests}p)` : '__________________'}</td>
                <td>${t2 ? `${formatTime(t2.time)} ${escapeHtml(t2.name)} (${t2.guests}p)` : '__________________'}</td>
                <td>${t3 ? `${formatTime(t3.time)} ${escapeHtml(t3.name)} (${t3.guests}p)` : '__________________'}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <footer class="ds-footer">
        <div><strong>86'D / SOLD-OUT ITEMS TODAY:</strong> ___________________________________________________________</div>
        <div><strong>HOST / CLOSING MANAGER SIGN-OFF:</strong> ___________________________ <strong>DATE:</strong> ______________</div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  `;
}

function exportCSV() {
  const all = getAllReservations().filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate);
  if (all.length === 0) {
    showManagerToast('No reservations to export for this date.', 'warning');
    return;
  }

  const headers = ['Ref', 'Guest Name', 'Phone', 'Date', 'Time', 'Covers', 'Table', 'Zone', 'Status', 'Occasion', 'Notes'];
  const rows = all.map(r => [
    r.code || r.id,
    `"${r.name}"`,
    `"${r.phone}"`,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    r.guests,
    r.tableLabel || r.tableId,
    r.tableZone,
    r.status,
    `"${r.occasion || ''}"`,
    `"${(r.notes || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
  ]);

  const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `burger-factory-${currentLocation}-${currentDate}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showManagerToast('Exported CSV report', 'success');
}

import { downloadCalendarEvent } from './calendar.js';
import { escapeHtml } from './booking.js';

export function renderThermalTicket(reservation) {
  const {
    code,
    name,
    locationName,
    dateFormatted,
    timeFormatted,
    guests,
    tableLabel,
    tableZone,
    occasion
  } = reservation;

  const safeCode = escapeHtml(code);
  const safeName = escapeHtml(name);
  const safeLoc = escapeHtml(locationName);
  const safeTable = escapeHtml(tableLabel);
  const safeZone = escapeHtml(tableZone);

  const whatsappMessage = encodeURIComponent(
    `*The Burger Factory — Table Reservation*\n` +
    `Booking Ref: *${code}*\n` +
    `Outlet: ${locationName}\n` +
    `Date & Time: ${dateFormatted} at ${timeFormatted}\n` +
    `Guests: ${guests}\n` +
    `Table: ${tableLabel} (${tableZone})`
  );

  const whatsappUrl = `https://wa.me/?text=${whatsappMessage}`;

  return `
    <div class="thermal-ticket-wrapper">
      <article class="thermal-ticket" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="ticket-title">
        <header class="ticket-header">
          <span class="ticket-kicker">THE BURGER FACTORY · EST. 2015</span>
          <h2 id="ticket-title" class="ticket-outlet">${safeLoc.toUpperCase()}</h2>
          <p class="ticket-meta">CONFIRMED TABLE RESERVATION</p>
        </header>

        <div class="ticket-code-banner">
          <span class="ticket-code-label">BOOKING REFERENCE</span>
          <span class="ticket-code-val" id="ticket-code-text">${safeCode}</span>
        </div>

        <dl class="ticket-grid">
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>DATE</dt>
            <dd>${escapeHtml(dateFormatted)}</dd>
          </div>
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>TIME (90 MIN TURN)</dt>
            <dd>${escapeHtml(timeFormatted)}</dd>
          </div>
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>GUEST NAME</dt>
            <dd>${safeName}</dd>
          </div>
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>PARTY SIZE</dt>
            <dd>${guests} ${guests === 1 ? 'Guest' : 'Guests'}</dd>
          </div>
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>TABLE ALLOCATION</dt>
            <dd>${safeTable} (${safeZone.toUpperCase()})</dd>
          </div>
          <div class="ticket-field">
            <dt>STATUS</dt>
            <dd style="color: var(--leaf);">CONFIRMED</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>

        ${occasion ? `
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; background: rgba(28,23,19,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
            <strong>Occasion:</strong> ${escapeHtml(occasion.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + occasion.slice(1))}
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        <div class="ticket-perforation"></div>

        <footer class="ticket-footer">
          <p style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--ink-soft); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 1rem; text-align: center;">
            Please arrive within 15 minutes of your reservation slot. Use your Booking Reference and phone number below to check or cancel at any time.
          </p>
          <div class="ticket-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-mustard btn-sm" id="btn-copy-code" data-code="${code}">
              Copy Booking Ref (${code})
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-paper btn-sm" id="btn-download-ics">
              Add to Calendar (.ics)
            </button>
            <a href="${whatsappUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-sea btn-sm">
              Share via WhatsApp
            </a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" id="btn-ticket-done" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">
              Close Voucher
            </button>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </article>
    </div>
  `;
}

export function attachTicketListeners(reservation) {
  document.getElementById('btn-copy-code')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const code = e.currentTarget.dataset.code;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
      e.currentTarget.textContent = `Copied (${code})`;
      setTimeout(() => {
        e.currentTarget.textContent = `Copy Booking Ref (${code})`;
      }, 2500);
    }).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copy your Booking Reference:', code);
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-download-ics')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    downloadCalendarEvent(reservation);
  });
}

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { locationTables, locations, timeSlots } from './src/js/data.js';

const DATA_DIR = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'data');
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'reservations.json');
const TURN_MINUTES = 90;
const VALID_STATUSES = new Set(['confirmed', 'seated', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no-show']);
const BOOKING_CHARS = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';

function getISTDateString(offsetDays = 0) {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + offsetDays * 86400000);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' });
}

function timeToMinutes(time) {
  if (!time || typeof time !== 'string' || !time.includes(':')) return NaN;
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

function sanitizeText(str, maxLen = 200) {
  if (typeof str !== 'string') return '';
  return str.replace(/[<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, maxLen);
}

function generateServerCode(existingRecords) {
  const existingCodes = new Set(existingRecords.map(r => (r.code || r.id || '').toUpperCase()));
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50; attempt++) {
    let code = 'BF-';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      code += BOOKING_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CHARS.length));
    }
    if (!existingCodes.has(code)) return code;
  }
  return `BF-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-6)}`;
}

/**
 * Server-Side Atomic Best-Fit Table Allocator
 * Guarantees zero race-condition double-bookings under concurrent load!
 */
function allocateTableAtomic(records, locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref = 'any', requestedTableId = null, isWalkIn = false) {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) {
    return { available: false, error: 'Invalid outlet location' };
  }

  const reqMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);
  if (Number.isNaN(reqMinutes)) {
    return { available: false, error: 'Invalid time slot format' };
  }

  let allTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const t of zoneTables) {
      allTables.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
  }

  // If host/walk-in or probe requested a specific table, verify capacity & collision strictly
  if (requestedTableId) {
    const exactTable = allTables.find(t => t.id === requestedTableId);
    if (!exactTable) {
      return { available: false, error: `Table ${requestedTableId} does not exist at this outlet.` };
    }
    if (exactTable.capacity < guests) {
      return { available: false, error: `Table ${exactTable.id} capacity (${exactTable.capacity}) is smaller than party size (${guests}).` };
    }
    const hasCollision = records.some(r => {
      if (['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date || r.tableId !== exactTable.id) return false;
      const bMin = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(reqMinutes - bMin) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });
    if (hasCollision) {
      return { available: false, error: `Table ${exactTable.id} is already booked for this 90-minute window.` };
    }
    return { available: true, table: exactTable };
  }

  let candidateTables = allTables;
  if (seatingPref && seatingPref !== 'any') {
    const prefMap = {
      indoor: ['indoor'],
      outdoor: ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
      beachside: ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
      rooftop: ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
    };
    const allowedZones = prefMap[seatingPref] || [seatingPref];
    const filtered = candidateTables.filter(t => allowedZones.includes(t.zone));
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      candidateTables = filtered;
    }
  }

  candidateTables = candidateTables
    .filter(t => t.capacity >= guests)
    .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);

  if (candidateTables.length === 0) {
    return {
      available: false,
      error: `No single table accommodates ${guests} guests at this outlet.`
    };
  }

  for (const table of candidateTables) {
    const hasCollision = records.some(r => {
      if (['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date || r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
      const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(reqMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });

    if (!hasCollision) {
      return { available: true, table };
    }
  }

  return {
    available: false,
    error: 'All suitable tables are booked for this 90-minute window.'
  };
}

function readDb() {
  ensureDbFile();
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function writeDb(records) {
  ensureDbFile();
  const tmpFile = `${DB_FILE}.tmp`;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, JSON.stringify(records, null, 2), 'utf8');
  fs.renameSync(tmpFile, DB_FILE);
}

function burgerFactoryApiPlugin() {
  const sseClients = new Set();
  let writeLock = Promise.resolve();

  function withMutex(fn) {
    const next = writeLock.then(fn, fn);
    writeLock = next.catch(() => {});
    return next;
  }

  function broadcastSse(event, payload) {
    const msg = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`;
    for (const res of sseClients) {
      try {
        res.write(msg);
      } catch {
        sseClients.delete(res);
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    name: 'burger-factory-lan-api',
    configureServer(server) {
      ensureDbFile();

      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        if (!req.url || !req.url.startsWith('/api/v1')) {
          return next();
        }

        const urlObj = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost:3000');

        // SSE Real-Time Stream
        if (req.method === 'GET' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/events') {
          res.writeHead(200, {
            'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
            'Connection': 'keep-alive',
            'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
          });
          res.write(`event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })}\n\n`);
          sseClients.add(res);
          req.on('close', () => sseClients.delete(res));
          return;
        }

        // GET Reservations List
        if (req.method === 'GET' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
          const records = readDb();
          res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ reservations: records }));
          return;
        }

        // POST / PUT / PATCH mutations with serialized Mutex Queue
        if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method)) {
          let body = '';
          let bodyTooLarge = false;

          req.on('data', chunk => {
            body += chunk;
            if (body.length > 200000) { // Limit incoming JSON payload to 200 KB
              bodyTooLarge = true;
            }
          });

          req.on('end', () => {
            if (bodyTooLarge) {
              res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
              res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Payload size exceeds limit' }));
              return;
            }

            withMutex(async () => {
              try {
                let payload;
                try {
                  payload = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
                } catch {
                  res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Malformed JSON payload' }));
                  return;
                }

                const records = readDb();

                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                // POST /api/v1/reservations/reset (Simulation State Reset)
                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                if (req.method === 'POST' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations/reset') {
                  const newRecords = Array.isArray(payload.reservations) ? payload.reservations : [];
                  writeDb(newRecords);
                  broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
                    action: 'reset',
                    reservations: newRecords
                  });
                  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, count: newRecords.length }));
                  return;
                }

                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                // POST /api/v1/reservations (Atomic Booking Creation)
                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                if (req.method === 'POST' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
                  const raw = payload.reservation;
                  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Missing reservation object' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 1. Guest count validation
                  const guests = Number(raw.guests);
                  if (!Number.isInteger(guests) || guests < 1 || guests > 12) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Guests must be an integer between 1 and 12' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 2. Date validation (must not be in past in IST)
                  const dateStr = String(raw.date || '');
                  const todayStr = getISTDateString(0);
                  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateStr) || dateStr < todayStr) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid or past reservation date' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 3. Location validation
                  if (!raw.locationId || !locationTables[raw.locationId]) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid or unknown outlet location' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 4. Time format & slot validation
                  const isWalkIn = raw.status === 'seated';
                  const timeStr = String(raw.time || '');
                  if (!isWalkIn) {
                    if (!timeSlots.includes(timeStr)) {
                      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                      res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid reservation time slot' }));
                      return;
                    }
                  } else {
                    if (!/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(timeStr)) {
                      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                      res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid walk-in time format (expected HH:MM)' }));
                      return;
                    }
                    const [h, m] = timeStr.split(':').map(Number);
                    if (h < 0 || h > 23 || m < 0 || m > 59) {
                      res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                      res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Impossible walk-in clock time' }));
                      return;
                    }
                  }

                  // 5. Name validation
                  const cleanName = sanitizeText(raw.name, 80);
                  if (!raw.name || cleanName.length < 2) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Valid guest name required (minimum 2 characters)' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 6. Security & XSS protection: reject angle brackets
                  if (
                    /[<>]/.test(String(raw.name || '')) ||
                    /[<>]/.test(String(raw.notes || '')) ||
                    /[<>]/.test(String(raw.email || '')) ||
                    /[<>]/.test(String(raw.occasion || ''))
                  ) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'HTML tags and angle brackets are strictly prohibited in booking fields' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 7. Field length limits (notes <= 500 chars)
                  if (raw.notes && String(raw.notes).length > 500) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Notes field cannot exceed 500 characters' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 8. Phone number validation
                  const cleanPhone = String(raw.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
                  if (cleanPhone.length < 10) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Valid 10-digit phone number required' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // 9. Server-Side Atomic Table Allocation (Best-Fit, Collision-Free)
                  const alloc = allocateTableAtomic(
                    records,
                    raw.locationId,
                    dateStr,
                    timeStr,
                    guests,
                    raw.seating || 'any',
                    raw.tableId,
                    isWalkIn
                  );

                  if (!alloc.available) {
                    res.writeHead(409, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: alloc.error }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const locObj = locations.find(l => l.id === raw.locationId);
                  let code = String(raw.code || raw.id || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                  if (!/^BF-[0-9A-Z]{4,10}$/.test(code) || records.some(r => (r.code || r.id) === code)) {
                    code = generateServerCode(records);
                  }

                  const verifiedReservation = {
                    id: code,
                    code,
                    name: cleanName,
                    email: sanitizeText(raw.email || '', 120),
                    phone: sanitizeText(raw.phone || '', 30),
                    locationId: raw.locationId,
                    locationName: locObj ? `${locObj.name}, ${locObj.area}` : raw.locationId,
                    date: dateStr,
                    time: timeStr,
                    guests,
                    seating: raw.seating || 'any',
                    occasion: sanitizeText(raw.occasion || '', 40),
                    notes: sanitizeText(raw.notes || '', 300),
                    tableId: alloc.table.id,
                    tableLabel: alloc.table.id,
                    tableType: alloc.table.type,
                    tableZone: alloc.table.zone,
                    status: isWalkIn ? 'seated' : 'confirmed',
                    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    ...(isWalkIn ? { seatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {})
                  };

                  records.push(verifiedReservation);
                  writeDb(records);
                  broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
                    action: 'created',
                    reservation: verifiedReservation,
                    reservations: records
                  });

                  res.writeHead(201, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({
                    success: true,
                    reservation: verifiedReservation,
                    reservations: records
                  }));
                  return;
                }

                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                // PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status (State Machine Validation)
                // -----------------------------------------------------------
                if (req.method === 'PATCH' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations/status') {
                  const targetCode = String(payload.code || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                  const newStatus = String(payload.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                  if (!VALID_STATUSES.has(newStatus)) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: `Invalid status: ${newStatus}` }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const idx = records.findIndex(
                    r => (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode || (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode
                  );

                  if (idx === -1) {
                    res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Reservation not found' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const currentStatus = records[idx].status;

                  // Enforce terminal state rules
                  if (currentStatus === 'completed' && newStatus === 'seated') {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Cannot transition completed reservation back to seated' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  if (currentStatus === 'cancelled' && newStatus === 'seated') {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Cannot transition cancelled reservation directly to seated' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
                  records[idx].status = newStatus;
                  if (newStatus === 'seated' && !records[idx].seatedAt) records[idx].seatedAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'completed') records[idx].completedAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'no-show') records[idx].noShowAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'cancelled') {
                    records[idx].cancelledAt = nowIso;
                    if (payload.reason) records[idx].cancelReason = sanitizeText(payload.reason, 200);
                  }

                  writeDb(records);
                  broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
                    action: 'status_updated',
                    code: targetCode,
                    status: newStatus,
                    reservation: records[idx],
                    reservations: records
                  });

                  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, reservation: records[idx], reservations: records }));
                  return;
                }

                res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Endpoint not found' }));
              } catch (err) {
                res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Internal server error', detail: String(err.message || err) }));
              }
            });
          });
          return;
        }

        next();
      });
    }
  };
}

export default defineConfig({
  root: '.',
  publicDir: 'public',
  plugins: [burgerFactoryApiPlugin()],
  build: {
    outDir: 'dist',
    assetsDir: 'assets',
    rollupOptions: {
      input: {
        main: './index.html',
        manager: './manager.html'
      }
    }
  },
  server: {
    host: '0.0.0.0',
    port: 3000,
    open: false
  }
});

1. EXECUTIVE PROJECT OVERVIEW
================================================================================
"The Burger Factory" is a premium, modern web application designed for an iconic
gourmet burger brand originated in Anjuna, Goa, and expanded across 7 locations
(Anjuna, Morjim, Vagator, Nerul, Dona Paula, Panaji, and New Delhi).

The project solves the restaurant's #1 operational challenge: Long waiting lines
and table turn management during peak hours. It provides:
1. Customer Experience (index.html):
   - Immersive brand presentation with gourmet visuals, particle animations,
     animated stats counters, and interactive story/menu/locations/reviews sections.
   - Real-time online table booking system allowing guests to select outlet, date,
     time slot, party size (1-8+), seating zone (indoor, outdoor, beachside), and
     special occasions/requests.
   - Instant booking confirmation with human-readable Booking IDs (e.g., BF-XXXX)
     and self-service reservation tracking/cancellation.
2. Manager Operations Dashboard (manager.html):
   - Control panel for restaurant floor managers and hosts.
   - Date, outlet, and status filtering (Confirmed, Seated, Completed, Cancelled, No-Show).
   - Real-time search across guests, IDs, phone numbers, and emails.
   - Interactive Visual Floor Map showing physical tables by zone, colored by live
     occupancy status (Available, Reserved, Occupied).
   - Walk-In Seating capability directly by clicking on available tables on the floor map.
   - One-click status transitions (Confirmed -> Seated -> Completed).
   - Real-time key metrics computation (Total active, Seated, Confirmed, Guests, No-Shows).
   - CSV export for daily operations and auditing.

Currently, the application runs entirely on client-side vanilla JavaScript and Vite,
using the browser's `localStorage` as a mock persistence layer. It is built to be
upgraded into a production-grade full-stack system.

4.7 Reservation Object Data Model (Stored in localStorage key 'bf_reservations')
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeScript-equivalent Interface:
interface Reservation {
  id: string;               // Prefix "BF-" + 4 random uppercase alphanumeric chars (e.g. "BF-8KD2")
  name: string;             // Customer full name
  email: string;            // Customer email address
  phone: string;            // Customer phone number (e.g. "+91 98765 12345")
  locationId: string;       // Outlet identifier (e.g. "anjuna")
  locationName: string;     // Formatted name (e.g. "Anjuna, North Goa")
  date: string;             // ISO date "YYYY-MM-DD"
  time: string;             // 24h format "HH:MM" (e.g. "19:30")
  guests: number;           // Party size integer (1 to 8+)
  seating: string;          // "any" | "indoor" | "outdoor" | "beachside"
  occasion: string;         // "" | "birthday" | "anniversary" | "date" | "business" | "other"
  notes: string;            // Free-form dietary/setup requests
  tableId: string;          // Assigned table (e.g. "ANJ-O3")
  tableType: string;        // "2-seater" | "4-seater" | "6-seater" | "8-seater" | "10-seater"
  tableZone: string;        // "indoor" | "outdoor" | "beachside"
  status: ReservationStatus;// 'confirmed' | 'seated' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no-show'
  createdAt: string;        // ISO 8601 timestamp
  seatedAt?: string;        // ISO timestamp populated when marked as 'seated'
  completedAt?: string;     // ISO timestamp populated when marked as 'completed'
  cancelledAt?: string;     // ISO timestamp populated when cancelled
  noShowAt?: string;        // ISO timestamp populated when marked as 'no-show'
}

type ReservationStatus = 'confirmed' | 'seated' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'no-show';

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.1 src/js/data.js (Data Store & Mock Database)

Exports:

- `locations`: Array of 7 outlet descriptions with geo-coordinates, table counts, capacities, and Google Maps links.
- `galleryItems`: Array of 8 high-res burger and venue photos.
- `reviews`: Array of 6 verified diner reviews.
- `locationTables`: Deep object mapping each location to its physical tables by zone with capacities.
- `timeSlots`: Array of 20 30-minute booking intervals.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.2 src/js/booking.js (Booking Engine, Algorithms & Persistence)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dependencies: Imports `locationTables` and `locations` from `./data.js`.
Storage: Uses `localStorage.getItem('bf_reservations')` and `localStorage.setItem()`.

Internal Helper Functions:
- `generateBookingId()`: Returns formatted ID like 'BF-X7K9' picking 4 characters randomly from 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789' (avoids ambiguous characters 0/O, 1/I).
- `getReservations()`: Safely retrieves and JSON-parses reservations from localStorage. Returns empty array on JSON error.
- `saveReservations(reservations)`: Persists array of reservations to localStorage as JSON.
- `timeToMinutes(time)`: Converts "HH:MM" string to minutes from midnight (e.g., "13:30" -> 810).

Exported Functions:
- `formatTime(time24)`: Converts 24-hour "HH:MM" to 12-hour format with AM/PM (e.g., "13:30" -> "1:30 PM", "00:00" -> "12:00 AM").
- `formatDate(dateStr)`: Formats "YYYY-MM-DD" to Indian English locale string: "Weekday, Day Month Year" (e.g., "Friday, October 16, 2026").
- `getLocationName(locationId)`: Looks up location object by ID and returns "Name, Area" string.
- `checkAvailability(locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref)`:
  The core table assignment & collision detection algorithm:
  1. Validates location existence in `locationTables`.
  2. Aggregates all tables across zones into `allTables` array, attaching `.zone`.
  3. Filters by `seatingPref` (supports zone alias fallbacks, e.g., 'outdoor' includes 'beachside').
  4. Filters tables having `capacity >= guestCount`.
  5. Sorts tables in ascending order of capacity (`a.capacity - b.capacity`) to achieve "Best Fit" (allocates smallest possible table to preserve large tables).
  6. Handles large groups (>6 guests) with specific advisory if no single table fits.
  7. Time Slot Collision Window: Assumes each reservation occupies a table for 90 minutes. Checks active bookings (excluding 'cancelled' status) on the same date, location, and tableId. If `|requestedTime - bookedTime| < 90`, collision occurs.
  8. Returns `{ available: true, table, message }` or `{ available: false, table: null, message }`.
- `createReservation(bookingData)`:
  Invokes `checkAvailability()`. If available, constructs complete Reservation record, generates ID, assigns table, marks status as 'confirmed', appends to storage, and returns `{ success: true, reservation }`.
- `createWalkInReservation(walkInData)`:
  Designed for Floor Managers on the manager dashboard:
  Takes `{ locationId, tableId, tableType, tableZone, guests, name, phone, notes }`.
  Calculates current live local date and current live time ("HH:MM").
  Constructs reservation with status 'seated', sets `seatedAt` timestamp, saves to storage, and returns `{ success: true, reservation }`.
- `lookupReservation(bookingId)`:
  Case-insensitive search in storage for a reservation matching the given booking ID.
- `cancelReservation(bookingId)`:
  Finds booking by ID, sets `status = 'cancelled'`, sets `cancelledAt` ISO timestamp, and saves. Returns boolean.
- `getAllReservations()`:
  Returns all reservation records (unfiltered).
- `updateReservationStatus(bookingId, status)`:
  Updates reservation status ('confirmed', 'seated', 'completed', 'no-show', 'cancelled').
  Automatically adds contextual ISO timestamps: `seatedAt`, `completedAt`, or `noShowAt`.
- `getLocationStats(locationId, date)`:
  Calculates total tables, total seat capacity, reservation count, total guests, and estimated occupancy rate for a specific location on a specific date.
- `seedDemoReservations()`:
  If localStorage is empty, automatically pre-populates 6 realistic reservations spanning today and tomorrow with diverse statuses ('confirmed', 'seated', 'completed') across Anjuna, Morjim, Panaji, and Delhi.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.3 src/js/main.js (Customer Landing Page Controller & UI Interactions)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dependencies: Imports from `./data.js` and `./booking.js`.

Features & Functions:
- `showToast(message, type = 'info')`: Dynamic floating toast alerts with animations, supporting types 'success' (✅), 'error' (❌), 'info' (ℹ️), 'warning' (⚠️). Auto-dismisses in 3.5 seconds.
- `DOMContentLoaded` initialization pipeline:
  1. `seedDemoReservations()`
  2. `initPreloader()`: 1.5s animated burger stacking preloader with a 4s safety timeout.
  3. `initNavbar()`: Sticky navbar background blur on scroll (>50px), IntersectionObserver for active section link highlighting, and smooth-scrolling with an 80px offset for anchors.
  4. `initMobileMenu()`: Fullscreen drawer menu with hamburger toggle and overlay click-outside handling.
  5. `initScrollAnimations()`: Staggered reveal of `.animate-on-scroll` elements via IntersectionObserver.
  6. `initParticles()`: Generates 30 floating glowing embers/particles with random trajectories, warm colors (#F59E0B, #EF4444, #FBBF24, #F87171, #FB923C), sizes, and delays in the hero section.
  7. `initCounters()` & `animateCounter()`: Cubic ease-out number counter animation for hero stats: Locations (7), Rating (4.4★), and Happy Customers (50,000+).
  8. `renderMenu(filter)`: Dynamic HTML rendering of burger cards with category badges (Veg, Popular, New), prices, descriptions, and feature tags. Re-observes cards for scroll animations.
  9. `initMenuFilters()`: Tab filtering ('all', 'beef', 'chicken', 'veg', 'sides', 'shakes').
  10. `renderLocations()`: Renders interactive cards for all 7 branches with photo overlays, table counts, vibe description, Google Maps links, and deep-link "Book Here" button that auto-selects the outlet dropdown.
  11. `renderGallery()`: Renders 8 masonry-style image cards with hover zoom and captions.
  12. `renderReviews()`: Custom carousel slider for diner reviews with navigation arrows, pagination dots, 6-second auto-rotation, and hover pause.
  13. `setMinDate()`: Sets HTML5 date input `.min` attribute to current date (prevents booking dates in the past).
  14. `initBookingForm()`:
      - Validates required inputs: Full Name, Email (regex check), Phone, Location, Date, Time, Party Size.
      - Triggers CSS keyframe shake animation on validation errors.
      - Calls `createReservation()`.
      - Displays modal confirmation popup `#booking-modal` with booking details, Booking ID, and a "Copy Booking ID" clipboard button.
      - Displays celebratory toast notifications.
  15. `initCheckBooking()`:
      - Allows customers to type their Booking ID (e.g. BF-DM01) and click "Look Up".
      - Displays colored status indicator, table info, and guest count.
      - Provides an active "Cancel This Reservation" button (with confirmation modal) for confirmed bookings.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.4 src/js/manager.js (Manager Operations Dashboard & Floor Map)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dependencies: Imports from `./data.js` and `./booking.js`.

State Management:
- `currentLocation` (default: 'all')
- `currentDate` (default: today's ISO date string)
- `currentStatus` (default: 'all')
- `searchQuery` (default: '')

Functions & Workflows:
- Auto-refresh: Automatically calls `refreshDashboard()` every 30 seconds (`setInterval`).
- `initDate()`: Syncs date input with today's date, updates human-readable header date display.
- `initFilters()`: Binds change listeners on location select dropdown and status filter pill buttons.
- `initSearch()`: Debounced live text search (300ms) matching guest name, booking ID, phone number, or email.
- `initActions()`: Manual "Refresh Data" and "Export Today's Data" CSV buttons.
- `refreshDashboard()`:
  - Fetches all reservations via `getAllReservations()`.
  - Filters by selected date, selected location, selected status filter, and live text search query.
  - Sorts reservations hierarchically: 'confirmed' first, then 'seated', 'completed', 'no-show', 'cancelled', and breaks ties by reservation time.
  - Calls `updateStats()`, `renderTable()`, and `renderFloorMap()`.
- `updateStats(reservations, date, location)`:
  Calculates dynamic counts for: Total Active, Confirmed, Currently Seated, Total Guests, Cancelled, and No-Shows. Uses `animateStatValue()` for smooth counting numbers.
- `renderTable(reservations)`:
  Renders responsive table rows with guest contact info, party size, table & zone, and contextual action buttons:
  - For Confirmed: "Seat" (sets status to 'seated'), "No-Show", "Cancel", and "Details".
  - For Seated: "Complete" (sets status to 'completed') and "Details".
- `renderFloorMap()`:
  - Renders physical table cards for the chosen outlet grouped by zones.
  - Compares each table's active reservations against current live time:
    - If status === 'seated' -> Marks table as "Occupied" (Blue).
    - If time slot overlaps now or upcoming today -> Marks table as "Reserved" (Amber).
    - Otherwise -> Marks table as "Available" (Green).
  - Clicking on a Reserved/Occupied table opens the detailed Reservation Modal.
  - Clicking on an Available table triggers `showWalkInModal()`!
- `showWalkInModal(table, zone)`:
  Opens modal allowing the restaurant host to seat walk-in guests on the fly:
  - Shows table capacity, selects guest count, optional phone and notes.
  - Clicking "Seat Guest Now" invokes `createWalkInReservation()`, immediately occupies the table on the floor map, and adds the record to reservations.
- `showReservationDetail(bookingId)`:
  Comprehensive modal showing all metadata: booking ID, status badge, guest details, party size, table, occasion, notes, and exact timestamps (`createdAt`, `seatedAt`, `completedAt`, `cancelledAt`).
- `exportData()`:
  Generates a clean CSV file (`burger-factory-reservations-YYYY-MM-DD.csv`) with full booking records and downloads it directly via a dynamically generated Blob URL.

================================================================================
8. END-TO-END USER WORKFLOWS & ALGORITHMIC LOGIC
================================================================================

8.1 Customer Booking Flow:
1. Customer enters landing page, browses menu, locations, or reviews.
2. Clicks "Book a Table" (smooth scrolls to `#booking`).
3. Fills in form (Name, Email, Phone, Outlet, Date, Time Slot, Party Size, Seating Preference, Occasion, Notes).
4. Submits form:
   - Client validates fields. If empty or email invalid, triggers visual error highlight and CSS shake animation.
   - `checkAvailability()` is executed:
     - Pulls all tables at chosen outlet.
     - Filters by seating preference (indoor, outdoor, beachside).
     - Filters by capacity >= party size.
     - Sorts ascending by capacity to pick optimal fit table.
     - Iterates through candidate tables; checks 90-minute time collision window against existing reservations in `localStorage`.
   - If no tables fit, displays warning toast: "Sorry, all suitable tables are booked...".
   - If available, constructs reservation with unique ID (e.g. "BF-3M9K"), writes to `localStorage`, and presents confirmation modal with copyable ID.

8.2 Customer Reservation Lookup & Cancellation Flow:
1. Guest scrolls to `#check-booking` section.
2. Enters Booking ID into `#check-booking-id` and clicks "Look Up".
3. System queries `lookupReservation(id)` from `localStorage`.
4. If found, displays formatted card showing status, name, location, date, time, and assigned table.
5. If status is 'confirmed', renders "Cancel This Reservation" button.
6. Clicking cancel triggers confirmation prompt, updates status to 'cancelled' with ISO timestamp, and immediately refreshes display and stats.

8.3 Manager Operations & Status Mutation Flow:
1. Manager visits `/manager.html`.
2. Dashboard auto-loads today's date, initializes stats counters, reservations table, and visual floor map.
3. Manager can filter by location (e.g., Anjuna) to see outlet-specific data.
4. When guest arrives: Manager clicks "Seat" button -> Reservation status changes to 'seated', `seatedAt` timestamp recorded, floor map turns table Blue (Occupied).
5. When dining finishes: Manager clicks "Complete" -> Reservation marked 'completed', table on floor map turns Green (Available).
6. If guest does not arrive: Manager clicks "No-Show" -> Status marked 'no-show', table freed.
7. Background timer re-syncs dashboard every 30 seconds.

8.4 Walk-In Floor Plan Seating Flow:
1. Manager views the Visual Table Floor Map on `/manager.html`.
2. Available tables appear green with their ID, type, and zone.
3. Manager clicks an available table card -> triggers `showWalkInModal(table, zone)`.
4. Modal opens with guest count options up to table capacity, optional name/phone.
5. Manager clicks "Seat Guest Now" -> invokes `createWalkInReservation()`, creates record with status 'seated', and immediately turns the table blue on the map.

8.5 CSV Reporting & Analytics Export:
1. Manager clicks "Export Today's Data" button.
2. System extracts filtered reservations for current date and location.
3. Serializes records into RFC-compliant CSV format with escaped double quotes.
4. Creates a downloadable Blob and triggers download: `burger-factory-reservations-YYYY-MM-DD.csv`.

================================================================================
9. CURRENT TECHNICAL DEBT, LIMITATIONS & ARCHITECTURAL GAPS
================================================================================
While the frontend UI, design system, and client logic are fully functional and
feature-complete, the following architectural gaps exist for a production rollout:

1. Persistence & State Storage:
   - CURRENT: Uses browser `localStorage` (`bf_reservations`).
   - GAP: Data is isolated to a single browser. If a customer books from their phone,
     the manager cannot see it on their laptop! No database exists.
2. Authentication & Authorization:
   - CURRENT: Anyone who navigates to `/manager.html` has full access to view, edit,
     and cancel all bookings.
   - GAP: No authentication (JWT / session cookies), no role-based access control
     (Host, Floor Manager, Admin, Owner).
3. Backend Server & API Layer:
   - CURRENT: Static client-only application bundled by Vite.
   - GAP: No Node.js / Python / Go REST or GraphQL API backend; no server-side
     validation; no connection pooling.
4. Concurrency & Race Conditions:
   - CURRENT: Two customers booking the same table simultaneously in different browsers
     will both succeed locally because there is no centralized database transaction lock.
   - GAP: Need ACID transactions, row-level locking, or Redis distributed locks.
5. Real-Time Synchronization:
   - CURRENT: 30-second client-side polling interval (`setInterval`).
   - GAP: No WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) to push instant table status
     changes to the floor manager in real-time.
6. Notifications & Communications:
   - CURRENT: Toast message saying "SMS/Email reminder" will be sent, but no external
     communication service is connected.
   - GAP: Need Twilio / WhatsApp Business API / SendGrid integration for automated
     booking confirmation and reminder messages.
7. Online Payments / Booking Deposits:
   - CURRENT: Reservations are free with no deposit required.
   - GAP: For large groups (e.g. 6-8+ guests), restaurants usually require a table
     holding deposit via Razorpay or Stripe to prevent no-shows.
8. Menu Management:
   - CURRENT: Menu items, prices, and locations are hardcoded in `src/js/data.js`.
   - GAP: Manager cannot mark an item as "86'd" (sold out), change prices, or add
     daily specials without modifying source code.

```yaml
# ============================================
# THE BURGER FACTORY — PRODUCTION DOCKER COMPOSE
# PostgreSQL 16 (btree_gist) + Redis 7 + API + Caddy
# ============================================

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-burger}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-factory_secret_2026}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-burger_factory}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U burger -d burger_factory"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: 4000
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-burger}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-factory_secret_2026}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-burger_factory}?schema=public
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:-bf_super_secure_jwt_secret_key_2026_goa}
      COOKIE_SECRET: ${COOKIE_SECRET:-bf_cookie_signing_secret_key_32chars}
    ports:
      - "4000:4000"

  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    depends_on:
      - api

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
  caddy_data:
  caddy_config:
```

```markdown
# The Burger Factory — Workspace Guidelines

## Mandatory Chat History Preservation
Every single chat turn (user prompt and assistant output) in this project MUST be preserved in:
`d:/Burger_factory/PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt`

1. The `.agents/hooks.json` lifecycle hook triggers `node scripts/sync_chat_log.cjs` on `PostInvocation` and `Stop`.
2. Any assistant working in this workspace must keep `PROJECT_CHAT_LOG.txt` up-to-date with verbatim transcripts of all prompts, outputs, and actions taken.
```

# ============================================
# THE BURGER FACTORY — CADDY REVERSE PROXY
# Automatic HTTPS, Static Assets & SSE Buffering Off
# ============================================

{
  email admin@burgerfactory.in
}

:80 {
  # API & SSE endpoints (flush immediately for SSE)
  handle /api/* {
    reverse_proxy api:4000 {
      flush_interval -1
    }
  }

  # Health endpoint
  handle /health {
    reverse_proxy api:4000
  }

  # Static web assets
  handle {
    root * /srv/web
    file_server
    try_files {path} /index.html
  }

  encode zstd gzip
}

```typescript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — SHARED ZOD SCHEMAS
// ============================================

import { z } from 'zod';
import { TIME_SLOTS, ZONES, RESERVATION_STATUS } from './constants.js';

// Phone regex: E.164 format or Indian 10-digit mobile
export const phoneSchema = z.string()
  .trim()
  .refine(
    (val) => /^(\+91[\-\s]?)?[6789]\d{9}$/.test(val.replace(/\s+/g, '')),
    { message: 'Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian phone number (+91)' }
  );

// Date: YYYY-MM-DD
export const dateSchema = z.string()
  .regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, 'Date must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD');

// Time slot
export const timeSlotSchema = z.enum(TIME_SLOTS as unknown as [string, ...string[]]);

// Zone preference
export const zonePrefSchema = z.enum(['any', 'indoor', 'outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop']);

// Public Table Booking Request
export const createReservationSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Name must be at least 2 characters').max(60),
  email: z.string().trim().email('Invalid email address').optional().or(z.literal('')),
  phone: phoneSchema,
  locationId: z.string().min(1, 'Please select a location'),
  date: dateSchema,
  time: timeSlotSchema,
  guests: z.coerce.number().int().min(1, 'At least 1 guest required').max(12, 'Online bookings capped at 12 guests. For larger parties, please contact us directly.'),
  seating: zonePrefSchema.default('any'),
  occasion: z.enum(['', 'birthday', 'anniversary', 'date', 'business', 'other']).default(''),
  notes: z.string().max(300, 'Notes cannot exceed 300 characters').default('')
});

export type CreateReservationInput = z.infer<typeof createReservationSchema>;

// Live Availability Query
export const availabilityQuerySchema = z.object({
  locationId: z.string(),
  date: dateSchema,
  guests: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(12),
  seating: zonePrefSchema.optional().default('any')
});

export type AvailabilityQueryInput = z.infer<typeof availabilityQuerySchema>;

// Self-Service Lookup Request (Requires 4-digit phone validation to prevent credential guessing)
export const lookupReservationSchema = z.object({
  bookingCode: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().regex(/^(BF-)?[23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ]{4,6}$/, 'Invalid Booking Reference format'),
  phoneLast4: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{4}$/, 'Please enter the last 4 digits of your phone number for verification')
});

export type LookupReservationInput = z.infer<typeof lookupReservationSchema>;

// Self-Service Cancellation Request
export const cancelReservationSchema = z.object({
  bookingCode: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().regex(/^(BF-)?[23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ]{4,6}$/, 'Invalid Booking Reference format'),
  phoneLast4: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{4}$/, 'Please enter the last 4 digits of your phone number for verification'),
  reason: z.string().max(200).optional()
});

export type CancelReservationInput = z.infer<typeof cancelReservationSchema>;

// Walk-in Seating (Manager direct seat from floor map)
export const walkInReservationSchema = z.object({
  locationId: z.string().min(1),
  tableId: z.string().min(1),
  guests: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(16),
  name: z.string().trim().default('Walk-in Guest'),
  phone: z.string().trim().optional().default(''),
  notes: z.string().max(200).optional().default('Walk-in seated from floor map')
});

export type WalkInReservationInput = z.infer<typeof walkInReservationSchema>;

// Manager Status Update
export const updateReservationStatusSchema = z.object({
  status: z.enum([
    RESERVATION_STATUS.CONFIRMED,
    RESERVATION_STATUS.SEATED,
    RESERVATION_STATUS.COMPLETED,
    RESERVATION_STATUS.CANCELLED,
    RESERVATION_STATUS.NO_SHOW
  ])
});

export type UpdateReservationStatusInput = z.infer<typeof updateReservationStatusSchema>;

// Staff / Manager Login
export const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email('Invalid email address'),
  password: z.string().min(6, 'Password must be at least 6 characters')
});

export type LoginInput = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;
```

// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — SHARED TYPES
