# The Burger Factory — Complete Codebase Audit, Multi-Day Simulation Pipeline & Antigravity Master Prompt

This blueprint covers two major deliverables:
1. **A 7-Point Architectural & Codebase Audit** of your 73-file snapshot (`PROJECT_STATE_DUMP.txt`), detailing exact bugs found in `vite.config.js`, `src/js/booking.js`, `src/js/manager.js`, and `manager.html`, along with their fixes.
2. **A Full-Scale, Multi-Day, Multi-Customer Simulation & Chaos Testing Pipeline** (`scripts/run_simulation.mjs`) that simulates hundreds of concurrent customers, walk-in parties, host check-ins, table turns, and edge-case/chaos attacks across all **7 outlets** and **104 physical tables**, writing every detected failure and stack trace to `D:\Burger_factory\SIMULATION_ERROR_REPORT.txt`.

## Part 1: Codebase Audit & 7 Critical Improvements

| Issue ID | Severity | File(s) Affected | What Happens Under Real Load | Exact Engineering Fix |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ERR-CONC-001** | **CRITICAL** | `vite.config.js`, `src/js/booking.js` | **Concurrent Double-Booking Race Condition**: `POST /api/v1/reservations` blindly pushes `payload.reservation` into `data/reservations.json` without checking if the table is free on the server. When 10 customers book Anjuna at 19:30 simultaneously, their browsers all pick `ANJ-I1` from the same snapshot and the server saves all 10 to the same table. | Move Best-Fit table allocation (`allocateTableAtomic`) into `vite.config.js` behind an in-memory promise mutex (`withMutex`) and atomic temp-file rename (`reservations.json.tmp` -> `reservations.json`), returning `HTTP 409 Conflict` if a slot fills up mid-flight. |
| **ERR-VAL-001 / CAP-001** | **HIGH** | `vite.config.js` | **Zero Server-Side Input & Capacity Validation**: Direct `POST` requests bypass UI limits—allowing `guests: -5`, `guests: 999` on a 2-seater table, past dates (`1999-01-01`), or invalid times (`25:99`). | Enforce strict server-side validation on `locationId`, `date`, `time`, `guests` (`1..12`), `phone` (10-digit Indian mobile), and table capacity before writing to disk. |
| **ERR-FSM-001** | **HIGH** | `vite.config.js` | **Unvalidated Status Transitions**: `PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status` accepts any arbitrary string (e.g., `status: "hacked_status"`), corrupting dashboard KPI counters and filters. | Validate `status` against the allowed state machine set (`confirmed`, `seated`, `completed`, `cancelled`, `no-show`). |
| **ERR-SEC-001** | **HIGH** | `src/js/main.js`, `src/js/manager.js`, `src/js/thermalTicket.js`, `vite.config.js` | **Stored XSS Injection**: Guest `name` and `notes` are interpolated directly into `.innerHTML` templates without escaping. A booking with `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` executes script in the manager's browser when opening the Staff Portal. | Add `escapeHtml()` sanitization at both the API ingestion boundary (`vite.config.js`) and frontend DOM rendering (`main.js`, `manager.js`, `thermalTicket.js`). |
| **ERR-AUTH-001** | **MEDIUM** | `manager.html` (Line 30) | **Hardcoded Passcode in Password Input**: `<input type="password" id="staff-gate-pass" value="burger123">` pre-fills the password in the DOM so anyone can click "Unlock Staff Portal" without knowing the passcode. | Remove `value="burger123"` from `#staff-gate-pass` in `manager.html` so staff must enter the passcode (or use your dev shortcut). |
| **ERR-TZ-001** | **MEDIUM** | `src/js/booking.js`, `src/js/main.js`, `src/js/manager.js` | **UTC vs. IST Midnight Date Drift**: `new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]` uses UTC (5.5 hours behind IST). Between 12:00 AM and 5:30 AM IST, "today" resolves to yesterday's date. | Replace UTC `.toISOString().split('T')[0]` with a dedicated `getTodayIST()` helper (`new Date(Date.now() + 19800000).toISOString().split('T')[0]`). |
| **ERR-FLOOR-001 & WARN-SYNC-001** | **MEDIUM** | `src/js/manager.js`, `/apps/web/`, `/NEW/` | **Floor Map Future-Date Bug & Workspace Drift**: `renderFloorCanvas()` compares future/past date bookings against today's live wall-clock hour, and `.find()` on unsorted `upcoming` bookings shows a 21:00 booking before an 18:30 booking. Also, `/apps/web/index.html` is out of sync with root `/index.html`. | Sort `upcoming` reservations chronologically before `.find()`, handle future/past dates cleanly on the floor map, sync `/apps/web/` with root, and remove the redundant `/NEW/` folder. |

## Part 2: Complete Multi-Day, Multi-Customer Simulation Pipeline Architecture

To test your project under realistic restaurant conditions without corrupting your live reservations, the simulation pipeline (`scripts/run_simulation.mjs`) runs a **5-Stage Automated Stress & Chaos Harness**:

1. **Stage 0 — Snapshot &Backup**:
   - Backs up your existing `data/reservations.json` into memory (and restores it automatically at the end of the run unless you pass `--keep-data`).
2. **Stage 1 — Concurrent Peak-Hour Stampede (Race Condition & Lock Testing)**:
   - Fires **25 simultaneous `POST /api/v1/reservations` requests** via `Promise.all()` at the exact same millisecond for `Anjuna`, `today`, `19:30`, `2 guests`, `indoor` (where only **3 indoor 2-seater tables** exist: `ANJ-I1`, `ANJ-I2`, `ANJ-I3`, plus fallback to 4/6-seaters up to 9 indoor tables total).
   - Audits the database afterwards to verify that **zero physical tables** have overlapping bookings within the 90-minute turn window.
3. **Stage 2 — 7-Day, 7-Outlet Full Restaurant Lifecycle Simulation**:
   - Simulates **7 consecutive days** across all **7 outlets** (`anjuna`, `morjim`, `dona-paula`, `panaji`, `vagator`, `nerul`, `delhi`) and **20 daily time slots** (`12:30` to `22:00`).
   - Spawns **350+ virtual customer agents** in concurrent waves (Lunch rush `12:30–14:30` and Dinner rush `19:00–21:30`), plus **walk-in parties** seated directly from the floor map.
   - Simulates realistic guest & host actions:
     - **65%** arrive on time -> Host transitions `confirmed` -> `seated` -> `completed` (releasing the table for the next turn!).
     - **15%** self-cancel online -> Customer calls `PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status` (`cancelled`), freeing the table for another guest.
     - **10%** fail to arrive -> Host marks `no-show`, freeing the table.
     - **10%** remain `confirmed` for upcoming slots.
4. **Stage 3 — Chaos, Security & Boundary Fuzzing**:
   - Injects malformed and malicious payloads (`guests: -5`, `guests: 999`, `date: "1999-01-01"`, `time: "25:99"`, `status: "hacked_status"`, and `<script>alert("XSS")</script>` in guest names/notes) and verifies whether the server rejects or sanitizes them.
5. **Stage 4 — Database Invariant Audit & `SIMULATION_ERROR_REPORT.txt` Generation**:
   - Scans every reservation record in `data/reservations.json` for 90-minute overlap collisions, capacity violations, duplicate booking codes, and missing lifecycle timestamps (`seatedAt`, `completedAt`, `cancelledAt`, `noShowAt`).
   - Writes a structured, human-readable diagnostic log to `D:\Burger_factory\SIMULATION_ERROR_REPORT.txt` with exact reproduction payloads, root causes, and file/line fix instructions.

  daySummaries: []  // Per-day statistics
};

function logError(category, severity, code, summary, details, remediation) {
  telemetry.errors.push({
    index: telemetry.errors.length + 1,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    category,
    severity, // 'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM'
    code,
    summary,
    details,
    remediation
  });
}

function logWarning(code, summary, details) {
  telemetry.warnings.push({
    index: telemetry.warnings.length + 1,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    code,
    summary,
    details
  });
}

function randomItem(arr) {
  return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
}

function randomPhone() {
  const prefixes = ['98', '97', '99', '96', '91', '88', '87', '77'];
  const p = randomItem(prefixes);
  let rest = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) rest += Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
  return `+91 ${p}${rest.slice(0, 3)} ${rest.slice(3)}`;
}

function getLocalISODate(offsetDays = 0) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + offsetDays);
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}

function timeToMinutes(time) {
  if (!time || typeof time !== 'string' || !time.includes(':')) return NaN;
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

// ---------- HTTP Helper with Latency Tracking ----------
async function apiRequest(method, endpoint, body = null) {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  telemetry.totalHttpRequests++;
  try {
    const opts = {
      method,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    };
    if (body !== null) {
      opts.body = typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body);
    }
    const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, opts);
    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
    telemetry.latenciesMs.push(elapsed);

    let data = null;
    const text = await res.text();
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      data = { rawText: text };
    }
    return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, data, elapsed };
  } catch (err) {
    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
    telemetry.latenciesMs.push(elapsed);
    return { ok: false, status: 0, error: err.message, data: null, elapsed };
  }
}

// ---------- SSE Stream Listener ----------
function connectSseListener() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const url = new URL('/api/v1/events', BASE_URL);
    const req = http.get(url, (res) => {
      res.on('data', (chunk) => {
        const str = chunk.toString();
        const matches = str.match(/event:\s*(\S+)/g);
        if (matches) {
          telemetry.sseEventsReceived += matches.length;
        }
      });
      resolve({
        close: () => {
          try { req.destroy(); } catch {}
        }
      });
    });
    req.on('error', () => {
      resolve({ close: () => {} });
    });
  });
}

// ---------- Client-Mirror Availability Check (Simulating Browser Behaviour) ----------
function findBestTableClientSide(existingReservations, locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref = 'any') {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) return null;

  let allTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const t of zoneTables) {
      allTables.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
  }

  if (seatingPref && seatingPref !== 'any') {
    const prefMap = {
      indoor: ['indoor'],
      outdoor: ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
      beachside: ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
      rooftop: ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
    };
    const allowed = prefMap[seatingPref] || [seatingPref];
    const filtered = allTables.filter(t => allowed.includes(t.zone));
    if (filtered.length > 0) allTables = filtered;
  }

  allTables = allTables
    .filter(t => t.capacity >= guests)
    .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);

  const reqMin = timeToMinutes(time);

  for (const table of allTables) {
    const hasCollision = existingReservations.some(r => {
      if (['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date || r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
      const bMin = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(reqMin - bMin) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });
    if (!hasCollision) return table;
  }
  return null;
}

const BOOKING_CHARS = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
function genCode() {
  let id = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    id += BOOKING_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CHARS.length));
  }
  return id;
}

// ============================================================================
async function runSimulation() {
  console.log('============================================================================');
  console.log('  THE BURGER FACTORY — REAL-LIFE MULTI-DAY CONCURRENT SIMULATION');
  console.log('============================================================================');

  // 0. Check if server is reachable on BASE_URL
  const ping = await apiRequest('GET', '/api/v1/reservations');
  if (ping.status === 0) {
    console.error(`[!] Cannot reach server at ${BASE_URL}. Please start Vite first!`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // Backup existing reservations.json so simulation can optionally restore or inspect
  if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
    fs.copyFileSync(DB_FILE, BACKUP_DB_FILE);
    console.log(`[✓] Backed up existing database to data/reservations.backup.json`);
  }

  const sseClient = await connectSseListener();
  console.log(`[✓] Connected real-time SSE auditor to ${BASE_URL}/api/v1/events`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // PHASE 1: HIGH-CONCURRENCY PEAK-HOUR STAMPEDE (RACE CONDITION TEST)
  // Simulates 25 customers on their phones all clicking "Confirm Reservation"
  // at the EXACT SAME MILLISECOND for Anjuna at 19:30 (4 guests, outdoor).
  // Anjuna outdoor only has FOUR 4-seaters (ANJ-O3..O6), ONE 6-seater (ANJ-O7),
  // and TWO 8-seaters (ANJ-O8..O9) = 7 eligible tables total.
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[PHASE 1/4] Running High-Concurrency Peak-Hour Stampede (25 simultaneous customers)...');
  const stampedeDate = getLocalISODate(1);
  const snapshotBeforeStampede = (await apiRequest('GET', '/api/v1/reservations')).data?.reservations || [];

  const stampedePromises = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => {
    // All 25 clients read the same pre-stampede snapshot at t=0ms!
    const chosenTable = findBestTableClientSide(snapshotBeforeStampede, 'anjuna', stampedeDate, '19:30', 4, 'outdoor');
    const code = genCode();
    const payload = {
      reservation: {
        id: code,
        code,
        name: `Stampede Diner #${i + 1}`,
        email: `diner${i + 1}@example.com`,
        phone: randomPhone(),
        locationId: 'anjuna',
        locationName: 'Anjuna, North Goa',
        date: stampedeDate,
        time: '19:30',
        guests: 4,
        seating: 'outdoor',
        occasion: 'date',
        notes: 'Concurrent stampede test',
        tableId: chosenTable ? chosenTable.id : 'ANJ-O3',
        tableLabel: chosenTable ? chosenTable.id : 'ANJ-O3',
        tableType: chosenTable ? chosenTable.type : '4-seater',
        tableZone: chosenTable ? chosenTable.zone : 'outdoor',
        status: 'confirmed',
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    };
    telemetry.bookingsRequested++;
    return apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', payload);
  });

  const stampedeResults = await Promise.all(stampedePromises);
  const stampedeAccepted = stampedeResults.filter(r => r.ok && r.status === 201).length;
  telemetry.bookingsConfirmed += stampedeAccepted;
  telemetry.bookingsRejectedFull += (25 - stampedeAccepted);
  console.log(`  -> Stampede result: ${stampedeAccepted}/25 accepted, ${25 - stampedeAccepted}/25 rejected.`);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // PHASE 2: 7-DAY MULTI-OUTLET REALISTIC RESTAURANT SIMULATION
  // Simulates 7 consecutive days across all 7 outlets (Anjuna, Morjim,
  // Dona Paula, Panaji, Vagator, Nerul, New Delhi):
  //   - Online reservations across lunch & dinner waves
  //   - Walk-in parties seated at the host stand
  //   - Customer self-service cancellations (15%)
  //   - Host status transitions: Confirmed -> Seated -> Completed / No-Show
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[PHASE 2/4] Running 7-Day Multi-Outlet Operations Simulation (All 7 Outlets)...');

  for (let dayOffset = 0; dayOffset < 7; dayOffset++) {
    const simDate = getLocalISODate(dayOffset);
    const isWeekend = [0, 5, 6].includes(new Date(simDate + 'T00:00:00').getDay());
    const dailyMultiplier = isWeekend ? 1.4 : 1.0;

    let dayCreated = 0;
    let dayWalkIns = 0;
    let dayCancelled = 0;
    let daySeated = 0;
    let dayCompleted = 0;
    let dayNoShow = 0;

    for (const loc of locations) {
      const numCustomers = Math.round((8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)) * dailyMultiplier);
      const createdCodesForOutlet = [];

      // Wave of customers booking at this outlet on simDate
      for (let c = 0; c < numCustomers; c++) {
        telemetry.bookingsRequested++;
        const currentList = (await apiRequest('GET', '/api/v1/reservations')).data?.reservations || [];
        const guests = randomItem([2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 6, 8]);
        const slot = randomItem(timeSlots);
        const pref = randomItem(['any', 'indoor', 'outdoor', 'beachside']);

        const assignedTable = findBestTableClientSide(currentList, loc.id, simDate, slot, guests, pref);
        if (!assignedTable) {
          telemetry.bookingsRejectedFull++;
          continue;
        }

        const code = genCode();
        const phone = randomPhone();
        const resPayload = {
          reservation: {
            id: code,
            code,
            name: `${randomItem(FIRST_NAMES)} ${randomItem(LAST_NAMES)}`,
            email: '',
            phone,
            locationId: loc.id,
            locationName: `${loc.name}, ${loc.area}`,
            date: simDate,
            time: slot,
            guests,
            seating: pref,
            occasion: randomItem(OCCASIONS),
            notes: randomItem(NOTES_POOL),
            tableId: assignedTable.id,
            tableLabel: assignedTable.id,
            tableType: assignedTable.type,
            tableZone: assignedTable.zone,
            status: 'confirmed',
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }
        };

        const postRes = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', resPayload);
        if (postRes.ok) {
          telemetry.bookingsConfirmed++;
          dayCreated++;
          createdCodesForOutlet.push({ code, phone, slot, tableId: assignedTable.id });
        } else {
          telemetry.bookingsRejectedFull++;
        }
      }

      // Walk-In guests arriving directly at the host podium
      const walkInCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numCustomers * 0.2));
      for (let w = 0; w < walkInCount; w++) {
        const currentList = (await apiRequest('GET', '/api/v1/reservations')).data?.reservations || [];
        const slot = randomItem(['13:00', '14:00', '19:00', '20:30']);
        const assignedTable = findBestTableClientSide(currentList, loc.id, simDate, slot, 2, 'any');
        if (assignedTable) {
          const code = genCode();
          const walkInPayload = {
            reservation: {
              id: code,
              code,
              name: `Walk-In (${randomItem(FIRST_NAMES)})`,
              email: '',
              phone: randomPhone(),
              locationId: loc.id,
              locationName: `${loc.name}, ${loc.area}`,
              date: simDate,
              time: slot,
              guests: 2,
              seating: assignedTable.zone,
              occasion: '',
              notes: 'Walk-in seated from floor plan',
              tableId: assignedTable.id,
              tableLabel: assignedTable.id,
              tableType: assignedTable.type,
              tableZone: assignedTable.zone,
              status: 'seated',
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              seatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            }
          };
          const wRes = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', walkInPayload);
          if (wRes.ok) {
            telemetry.walkInsCreated++;
            dayWalkIns++;
          }
        }
      }

      // Simulate Customer Cancellations, Host Seating, Completions & No-Shows
      for (let i = 0; i < createdCodesForOutlet.length; i++) {
        const item = createdCodesForOutlet[i];
        const roll = Math.random();

        if (roll < 0.15) {
          // 15% Customer Self-Cancellation
          const r = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
            code: item.code,
            status: 'cancelled',
            reason: 'Customer cancelled via self-service lookup'
          });
          if (r.ok) {
            telemetry.cancellationsSucceeded++;
            telemetry.statusTransitions.cancelled++;
            dayCancelled++;
          }
        } else if (roll < 0.25) {
          // 10% No-Show
          const r = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
            code: item.code,
            status: 'no-show'
          });
          if (r.ok) {
            telemetry.statusTransitions['no-show']++;
            dayNoShow++;
          }
        } else if (roll < 0.75) {
          // 50% Seated -> Completed full turn
          const s1 = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
            code: item.code,
            status: 'seated'
          });
          if (s1.ok) {
            telemetry.statusTransitions.seated++;
            daySeated++;
          }
          const s2 = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
            code: item.code,
            status: 'completed'
          });
          if (s2.ok) {
            telemetry.statusTransitions.completed++;
            dayCompleted++;
          }
        } else {
          // Remaining 25% stay in 'seated' or 'confirmed' for active floor testing
          if (dayOffset === 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
            const s1 = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
              code: item.code,
              status: 'seated'
            });
            if (s1.ok) {
              telemetry.statusTransitions.seated++;
              daySeated++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    telemetry.daySummaries.push({
      date: simDate,
      isWeekend,
      created: dayCreated,
      walkIns: dayWalkIns,
      seated: daySeated,
      completed: dayCompleted,
      cancelled: dayCancelled,
      noShow: dayNoShow
    });
    console.log(`  -> Day ${dayOffset + 1} (${simDate}): +${dayCreated} booked, +${dayWalkIns} walk-ins, ${dayCompleted} completed, ${dayCancelled} cancelled, ${dayNoShow} no-shows`);
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // PHASE 3: CHAOS, SECURITY & FUZZING ATTACKS
  // Sends intentionally malformed, abusive, or edge-case payloads to test
  // whether the server validates inputs or corrupts the database!
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[PHASE 3/4] Running Chaos, Edge-Case & Security Fuzzing Suite...');

  // Chaos Test 1: Negative party size (-5 guests)
  telemetry.chaosTestsRun++;
  const chaosNegGuests = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', {
    reservation: {
      id: 'BF-CHAOS1',
      code: 'BF-CHAOS1',
      name: 'Chaos Negative Guests',
      phone: '+91 98765 00001',
      locationId: 'anjuna',
      date: getLocalISODate(2),
      time: '19:00',
      guests: -5,
      tableId: 'ANJ-I1',
      tableZone: 'indoor',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  });
  if (chaosNegGuests.ok) {
    logError(
      'INPUT_VALIDATION',
      'HIGH',
      'ERR-VAL-001',
      'Backend accepted a reservation with negative guest count (guests: -5)',
      `POST /api/v1/reservations returned HTTP ${chaosNegGuests.status} for payload with guests: -5.`,
      'Add server-side validation in vite.config.js to reject reservations where !Number.isInteger(guests) || guests < 1 || guests > 12.'
    );
  }

  // Chaos Test 2: Impossible party size (999 guests on a 2-seater table)
  telemetry.chaosTestsRun++;
  const chaosHugeGuests = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', {
    reservation: {
      id: 'BF-CHAOS2',
      code: 'BF-CHAOS2',
      name: 'Chaos 999 Guests',
      phone: '+91 98765 00002',
      locationId: 'anjuna',
      date: getLocalISODate(2),
      time: '19:30',
      guests: 999,
      tableId: 'ANJ-I1',
      tableZone: 'indoor',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  });
  if (chaosHugeGuests.ok) {
    logError(
      'CAPACITY_ENFORCEMENT',
      'HIGH',
      'ERR-CAP-001',
      'Backend accepted 999 guests onto 2-seater table ANJ-I1 without capacity verification',
      `POST /api/v1/reservations returned HTTP ${chaosHugeGuests.status} when assigning 999 guests to 2-seater table ANJ-I1.`,
      'Enforce server-side table lookup and capacity >= guests check inside POST /api/v1/reservations.'
    );
  }

  // Chaos Test 3: Invalid time slot ("25:99") and past date ("1999-01-01")
  telemetry.chaosTestsRun++;
  const chaosTime = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', {
    reservation: {
      id: 'BF-CHAOS3',
      code: 'BF-CHAOS3',
      name: 'Chaos Time Traveler',
      phone: '+91 98765 00003',
      locationId: 'morjim',
      date: '1999-01-01',
      time: '25:99',
      guests: 2,
      tableId: 'MOR-I1',
      tableZone: 'indoor',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  });
  if (chaosTime.ok) {
    logError(
      'TEMPORAL_VALIDATION',
      'MEDIUM',
      'ERR-VAL-002',
      'Backend accepted reservation for past year (1999-01-01) and impossible clock time (25:99)',
      `POST /api/v1/reservations returned HTTP ${chaosTime.status} for date="1999-01-01", time="25:99".`,
      'Validate date >= today and time in TIME_SLOTS on the server before writing to reservations.json.'
    );
  }

  // Chaos Test 4: XSS script injection in Guest Name / Notes
  telemetry.chaosTestsRun++;
  const xssRes = await apiRequest('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', {
    reservation: {
      id: 'BF-XSS999',
      code: 'BF-XSS999',
      name: '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>',
      phone: '+91 98765 00004',
      locationId: 'panaji',
      date: getLocalISODate(3),
      time: '14:00',
      guests: 2,
      notes: '<script>alert("hacked")</script>',
      tableId: 'PNJ-I1',
      tableZone: 'indoor',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  });
  if (xssRes.ok) {
    logError(
      'SECURITY_XSS',
      'CRITICAL',
      'ERR-SEC-001',
      'Stored XSS vulnerability: raw HTML/script tags accepted in guest name/notes and rendered via innerHTML',
      'POST /api/v1/reservations stored `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` verbatim, and manager.js / main.js inject `r.name` and `r.notes` directly into `innerHTML` without HTML escaping.',
      'Strip `<` and `>` characters on the server and add an `escapeHtml()` helper in main.js, manager.js, and thermalTicket.js.'
    );
  }

  // Chaos Test 5: Invalid status transition ("hacked_status")
  telemetry.chaosTestsRun++;
  const badStatusRes = await apiRequest('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', {
    code: 'BF-7K9M2W',
    status: 'hacked_status'
  });
  if (badStatusRes.ok) {
    logError(
      'STATE_MACHINE',
      'HIGH',
      'ERR-FSM-001',
      'Backend allowed arbitrary invalid reservation status ("hacked_status")',
      `PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status accepted status="hacked_status" with HTTP ${badStatusRes.status}.`,
      'Restrict status transitions in vite.config.js to ["confirmed", "seated", "completed", "cancelled", "no-show"].'
    );
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // PHASE 4: 10 STRICT INVARIANT AUDITS ON LIVE STATE & STATIC CODEBASE
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('\n[PHASE 4/4] Running 10 Strict Invariant Audits across Database & Codebase...');
  const finalFetch = await apiRequest('GET', '/api/v1/reservations');
  const allRecords = finalFetch.data?.reservations || [];

  // Audit 1: Double-Booking Collision Detection across all 7 days
  const activeRecords = allRecords.filter(r => ['confirmed', 'seated'].includes(r.status));
  const collisions = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < activeRecords.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < activeRecords.length; j++) {
      const a = activeRecords[i];
      const b = activeRecords[j];
      if (a.locationId === b.locationId && a.date === b.date && a.tableId === b.tableId) {
        const minA = timeToMinutes(a.time);
        const minB = timeToMinutes(b.time);
        if (!Number.isNaN(minA) && !Number.isNaN(minB) && Math.abs(minA - minB) < TURN_MINUTES) {
          collisions.push({
            locationId: a.locationId,
            date: a.date,
            tableId: a.tableId,
            bookingA: `${a.code} (${a.name} @ ${a.time}, ${a.status})`,
            bookingB: `${b.code} (${b.name} @ ${b.time}, ${b.status})`
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (collisions.length > 0) {
    logError(
      'CONCURRENCY_RACE_CONDITION',
      'CRITICAL',
      'ERR-CONC-001',
      `Detected ${collisions.length} overlapping double-bookings on the same physical table within a 90-minute window`,
      `Sample collisions:\n` + collisions.slice(0, 8).map(c =>
        `  - [${c.locationId.toUpperCase()} | ${c.date} | Table ${c.tableId}]: ${c.bookingA} OVERLAPS WITH ${c.bookingB}`
      ).join('\n'),
      'Move table availability & collision checking into vite.config.js POST /api/v1/reservations behind a serialized request queue so concurrent requests never allocate the same table.'
    );
  }

  // Audit 2: Static Codebase Divergence & Security Audit
  const mgrHtmlPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'manager.html');
  if (fs.existsSync(mgrHtmlPath)) {
    const mgrHtml = fs.readFileSync(mgrHtmlPath, 'utf8');
    if (mgrHtml.includes('id="staff-gate-pass" value="burger123"')) {
      logError(
        'AUTHENTICATION_BYPASS',
        'MEDIUM',
        'ERR-AUTH-001',
        'Staff Portal password input has value="burger123" pre-filled in manager.html HTML source',
        'In manager.html line 30, `<input type="password" id="staff-gate-pass" value="burger123">` pre-populates the password so any visitor can unlock the Staff Portal with a single click.',
        'Remove `value="burger123"` from `#staff-gate-pass` in manager.html (keep the Auto-Fill helper button for demo convenience).'
      );
    }
  }

  // Audit 3: UTC vs IST Date Bug in booking.js / manager.js / main.js
  const bookingJsPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'src', 'js', 'booking.js');
  if (fs.existsSync(bookingJsPath)) {
    const bookingJs = fs.readFileSync(bookingJsPath, 'utf8');
    if (bookingJs.includes("new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]")) {
      logError(
        'TIMEZONE_DRIFT',
        'MEDIUM',
        'ERR-TZ-001',
        'UTC vs. IST Date Mismatch between 12:00 AM and 5:30 AM Indian Standard Time',
        '`new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]` returns the UTC date, which lags 5.5 hours behind IST. Late-night bookings or walk-ins between midnight and 5:30 AM IST get stamped with yesterday\'s date.',
        'Use local date formatting (`new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" })`) instead of `.toISOString().split("T")[0]`.'
      );
    }
  }

  // Audit 4: Floor Map Future/Past Date Clock Bug in manager.js
  const managerJsPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'src', 'js', 'manager.js');
  if (fs.existsSync(managerJsPath)) {
    const managerJs = fs.readFileSync(managerJsPath, 'utf8');
    if (managerJs.includes('const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();') &&
        !managerJs.includes('currentDate === todayStr')) {
      logError(
        'FLOOR_MAP_LOGIC',
        'MEDIUM',
        'ERR-FLOOR-001',
        'Floor Plan compares future/past service dates against today\'s live wall-clock hour',
        'In src/js/manager.js `renderFloorCanvas()`, `upcoming` filters `r.time > currentMinutes` even when the manager is inspecting tomorrow\'s date—hiding tomorrow\'s morning/afternoon reservations on the floor plan if viewed in the evening!',
        'In `renderFloorCanvas()`, only compare against `currentMinutes` when `currentDate === todayStr`; for future dates, treat all confirmed bookings on that date as upcoming.'
      );
    }
  }

  // Audit 5: Duplicate Workspace Divergence (apps/web vs root)
  const webIndexHtml = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'apps', 'web', 'index.html');
  const rootIndexHtml = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'index.html');
  if (fs.existsSync(webIndexHtml) && fs.existsSync(rootIndexHtml)) {
    const wSize = fs.statSync(webIndexHtml).size;
    const rSize = fs.statSync(rootIndexHtml).size;
    if (wSize !== rSize) {
      logWarning(
        'WARN-SYNC-001',
        `Workspace divergence detected: /index.html (${rSize} B) differs from /apps/web/index.html (${wSize} B)`,
        'Keep /apps/web synchronized with root files or remove duplicate copies.'
      );
    }
  }

  sseClient.close();
  telemetry.endTime = new Date().toISOString();

  // Restore original clean database if desired (or keep clean valid records)
  if (fs.existsSync(BACKUP_DB_FILE)) {
    fs.copyFileSync(BACKUP_DB_FILE, DB_FILE);
    fs.unlinkSync(BACKUP_DB_FILE);
    console.log(`[✓] Restored clean reservations database from backup after simulation audit.`);
  }

  // Generate the comprehensive text report
  writeSimulationReport(allRecords.length, collisions.length);
}

function writeSimulationReport(totalRecordsInDb, collisionCount) {
  const sortedLat = [...telemetry.latenciesMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const p50 = sortedLat[Math.floor(sortedLat.length * 0.5)] || 0;
  const p95 = sortedLat[Math.floor(sortedLat.length * 0.95)] || 0;
  const p99 = sortedLat[Math.floor(sortedLat.length * 0.99)] || 0;

  let out = '';
  out += `================================================================================\n`;
  out += `THE BURGER FACTORY — REAL-LIFE MULTI-DAY & CONCURRENT SIMULATION REPORT\n`;
  out += `================================================================================\n`;
  out += `Generated At        : ${telemetry.endTime}\n`;
  out += `Target Endpoint     : ${BASE_URL}\n`;
  out += `Simulated Horizon   : 7 Full Service Days × 7 Outlets (104 Physical Tables)\n`;
  out += `Total HTTP Requests : ${telemetry.totalHttpRequests}\n`;
  out += `SSE Events Captured : ${telemetry.sseEventsReceived}\n`;
  out += `Latency Metrics     : p50 = ${p50.toFixed(2)} ms | p95 = ${p95.toFixed(2)} ms | p99 = ${p99.toFixed(2)} ms\n`;
  out += `Overall Verdict     : ${telemetry.errors.length === 0 ? 'PASS (ZERO ERRORS)' : `FAIL (${telemetry.errors.length} ERRORS DISCOVERED — SEE SECTION 3)`}\n`;
  out += `================================================================================\n\n`;

  out += `1. EXECUTIVE SIMULATION TELEMETRY\n`;
  out += `--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
  out += `- Online Bookings Requested   : ${telemetry.bookingsRequested}\n`;
  out += `- Online Bookings Confirmed   : ${telemetry.bookingsConfirmed}\n`;
  out += `- Rejected (No Table / Full)  : ${telemetry.bookingsRejectedFull}\n`;
  out += `- Walk-In Parties Seated      : ${telemetry.walkInsCreated}\n`;
  out += `- Customer Self-Cancellations : ${telemetry.cancellationsSucceeded}\n`;
  out += `- Host Seated Transitions     : ${telemetry.statusTransitions.seated}\n`;
  out += `- Host Completed Turns        : ${telemetry.statusTransitions.completed}\n`;
  out += `- Host No-Shows Marked        : ${telemetry.statusTransitions['no-show']}\n`;
  out += `- Chaos & Security Payloads   : ${telemetry.chaosTestsRun}\n`;
  out += `- Double-Booking Collisions   : ${collisionCount}\n\n`;

  out += `2. 7-DAY SERVICE BREAKDOWN ACROSS ALL 7 OUTLETS\n`;
  out += `--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
  out += `DATE         | DAY TYPE | BOOKED | WALK-INS | SEATED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | NO-SHOW\n`;
  out += `--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
  for (const d of telemetry.daySummaries) {
    out += `${d.date} | ${(d.isWeekend ? 'WEEKEND' : 'WEEKDAY').padEnd(8)} | ${String(d.created).padStart(6)} | ${String(d.walkIns).padStart(8)} | ${String(d.seated).padStart(6)} | ${String(d.completed).padStart(9)} | ${String(d.cancelled).padStart(9)} | ${String(d.noShow).padStart(7)}\n`;
  }
  out += `\n`;

  out += `3. ERRORS & VULNERABILITIES DISCOVERED (${telemetry.errors.length} TOTAL)\n`;
  out += `================================================================================\n`;
  if (telemetry.errors.length === 0) {
    out += `Zero errors! All concurrency, validation, security, and state-machine invariants passed.\n\n`;
  } else {
    for (const err of telemetry.errors) {
      out += `[ERROR #${err.index}] [${err.severity}] [${err.code}] (${err.category})\n`;
      out += `--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
      out += `Summary     : ${err.summary}\n`;
      out += `Diagnostic  :\n${err.details}\n`;
      out += `How to Fix  : ${err.remediation}\n\n`;
    }
  }

  out += `4. WARNINGS & CODE HYGIENE NOTES (${telemetry.warnings.length} TOTAL)\n`;
  out += `================================================================================\n`;
  if (telemetry.warnings.length === 0) {
    out += `Zero warnings.\n`;
  } else {
    for (const w of telemetry.warnings) {
      out += `[WARN #${w.index}] [${w.code}] ${w.summary}\n  -> ${w.details}\n\n`;
    }
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(REPORT_FILE, out, 'utf8');
  console.log('\n============================================================================');
  console.log(`  SIMULATION COMPLETE! Full diagnostic log saved to:`);
  console.log(`  ${REPORT_FILE}`);
  console.log(`  Errors Found: ${telemetry.errors.length} | Warnings: ${telemetry.warnings.length}`);
  console.log('============================================================================\n');
}

runSimulation().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Fatal Simulation Error:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

```javascript
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { locationTables, locations, timeSlots } from './src/js/data.js';

const DATA_DIR = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'data');
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'reservations.json');
const TURN_MINUTES = 90;
const VALID_STATUSES = new Set(['confirmed', 'seated', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no-show']);
const BOOKING_CHARS = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';

function getISTDateString(offsetDays = 0) {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + offsetDays * 86400000);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' });
}

function timeToMinutes(time) {
  if (!time || typeof time !== 'string' || !time.includes(':')) return NaN;
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

function sanitizeText(str, maxLen = 200) {
  if (typeof str !== 'string') return '';
  return str.replace(/[<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, maxLen);
}

function generateServerCode(existingRecords) {
  const existingCodes = new Set(existingRecords.map(r => (r.code || r.id || '').toUpperCase()));
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
    let code = 'BF-';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      code += BOOKING_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CHARS.length));
    }
    if (!existingCodes.has(code)) return code;
  }
  return `BF-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-6)}`;
}

/**
 * Server-Side Atomic Best-Fit Table Allocator
 * Prevents race-condition double-bookings when multiple customers book simultaneously!
 */
function allocateTableAtomic(records, locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref = 'any', requestedTableId = null) {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) {
    return { available: false, error: 'Invalid outlet location' };
  }

  const reqMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);
  if (Number.isNaN(reqMinutes)) {
    return { available: false, error: 'Invalid time slot format' };
  }

  let allTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const t of zoneTables) {
      allTables.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
  }

  // If walk-in requested a specific table, verify it first
  if (requestedTableId) {
    const exactTable = allTables.find(t => t.id === requestedTableId);
    if (exactTable && exactTable.capacity >= guests) {
      const hasCollision = records.some(r => {
        if (['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(r.status)) return false;
        if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date || r.tableId !== exactTable.id) return false;
        const bMin = timeToMinutes(r.time);
        return Math.abs(reqMinutes - bMin) < TURN_MINUTES;
      });
      if (!hasCollision) {
        return { available: true, table: exactTable };
      }
    }
  }

  if (seatingPref && seatingPref !== 'any') {
    const prefMap = {
      indoor: ['indoor'],
      outdoor: ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
      beachside: ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
      rooftop: ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
    };
    const allowedZones = prefMap[seatingPref] || [seatingPref];
    const filtered = allTables.filter(t => allowedZones.includes(t.zone));
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      allTables = filtered;
    }
  }

  allTables = allTables
    .filter(t => t.capacity >= guests)
    .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);

  if (allTables.length === 0) {
    return {
      available: false,
      error: `No single table accommodates ${guests} guests at this outlet.`
    };
  }

  for (const table of allTables) {
    const hasCollision = records.some(r => {
      if (['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date || r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
      const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(reqMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });

    if (!hasCollision) {
      return { available: true, table };
    }
  }

  return {
    available: false,
    error: 'All suitable tables are booked for this 90-minute window.'
  };
}

function readDb() {
  ensureDbFile();
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function writeDb(records) {
  ensureDbFile();
  const tmpFile = `${DB_FILE}.tmp`;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, JSON.stringify(records, null, 2), 'utf8');
  fs.renameSync(tmpFile, DB_FILE);
}

function burgerFactoryApiPlugin() {
  const sseClients = new Set();
  // Serialized mutex queue to guarantee zero race conditions on concurrent requests
  let writeLock = Promise.resolve();

  function withMutex(fn) {
    const next = writeLock.then(fn, fn);
    writeLock = next.catch(() => {});
    return next;
  }

  function broadcastSse(event, payload) {
    const msg = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`;
    for (const res of sseClients) {
      try {
        res.write(msg);
      } catch {
        sseClients.delete(res);
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    name: 'burger-factory-lan-api',
    configureServer(server) {
      ensureDbFile();

      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        if (!req.url || !req.url.startsWith('/api/v1')) {
          return next();
        }

        const urlObj = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost:3000');

        if (req.method === 'GET' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/events') {
          res.writeHead(200, {
            'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
            'Connection': 'keep-alive',
            'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
          });
          res.write(`event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })}\n\n`);
          sseClients.add(res);
          req.on('close', () => sseClients.delete(res));
          return;
        }

        if (req.method === 'GET' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
          const records = readDb();
          res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ reservations: records }));
          return;
        }

        if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method)) {
          let body = '';
          req.on('data', chunk => { body += chunk; });
          req.on('end', () => {
            withMutex(async () => {
              try {
                const payload = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
                const records = readDb();

                // ATOMIC SERVER-SIDE BOOKING CREATION WITH VALIDATION & COLLISION LOCK
                if (req.method === 'POST' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
                  const raw = payload.reservation;
                  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Missing reservation object' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const guests = Number(raw.guests);
                  if (!Number.isInteger(guests) || guests < 1 || guests > 12) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Guests must be an integer between 1 and 12' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const dateStr = String(raw.date || '');
                  const todayStr = getISTDateString(0);
                  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateStr) || dateStr < todayStr) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid or past reservation date' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const isWalkIn = raw.status === 'seated';
                  const timeStr = String(raw.time || '');
                  if (!isWalkIn && !timeSlots.includes(timeStr)) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid reservation time slot' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const cleanName = sanitizeText(raw.name, 80);
                  if (cleanName.length < 2) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Valid guest name required' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  // Server-side atomic table allocation (prevents concurrent double-booking!)
                  const alloc = allocateTableAtomic(
                    records,
                    raw.locationId,
                    dateStr,
                    timeStr,
                    guests,
                    raw.seating || 'any',
                    raw.tableId
                  );

                  if (!alloc.available) {
                    res.writeHead(409, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: alloc.error }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const locObj = locations.find(l => l.id === raw.locationId);
                  const code = generateServerCode(records);

                  const verifiedReservation = {
                    id: code,
                    code,
                    name: cleanName,
                    email: sanitizeText(raw.email || '', 120),
                    phone: sanitizeText(raw.phone || '', 30),
                    locationId: raw.locationId,
                    locationName: locObj ? `${locObj.name}, ${locObj.area}` : raw.locationId,
                    date: dateStr,
                    time: timeStr,
                    guests,
                    seating: raw.seating || 'any',
                    occasion: sanitizeText(raw.occasion || '', 40),
                    notes: sanitizeText(raw.notes || '', 300),
                    tableId: alloc.table.id,
                    tableLabel: alloc.table.id,
                    tableType: alloc.table.type,
                    tableZone: alloc.table.zone,
                    status: isWalkIn ? 'seated' : 'confirmed',
                    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    ...(isWalkIn ? { seatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {})
                  };

                  records.push(verifiedReservation);
                  writeDb(records);
                  broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
                    action: 'created',
                    reservation: verifiedReservation,
                    reservations: records
                  });

                  res.writeHead(201, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({
                    success: true,
                    reservation: verifiedReservation,
                    reservations: records
                  }));
                  return;
                }

                // STATUS TRANSITION & CANCELLATION ENDPOINT
                if (req.method === 'PATCH' && urlObj.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations/status') {
                  const targetCode = String(payload.code || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                  const newStatus = String(payload.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                  if (!VALID_STATUSES.has(newStatus)) {
                    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: `Invalid status: ${newStatus}` }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const idx = records.findIndex(
                    r => (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode || (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode
                  );

                  if (idx === -1) {
                    res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Reservation not found' }));
                    return;
                  }

                  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
                  records[idx].status = newStatus;
                  if (newStatus === 'seated') records[idx].seatedAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'completed') records[idx].completedAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'no-show') records[idx].noShowAt = nowIso;
                  if (newStatus === 'cancelled') {
                    records[idx].cancelledAt = nowIso;
                    if (payload.reason) records[idx].cancelReason = sanitizeText(payload.reason, 200);
                  }

                  writeDb(records);
                  broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
                    action: 'status_updated',
                    code: targetCode,
                    status: newStatus,
                    reservation: records[idx],
                    reservations: records
                  });

                  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                  res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, reservation: records[idx], reservations: records }));
                  return;
                }

                res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Endpoint not found' }));
              } catch {
                res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid request payload' }));
              }
            });
          });
          return;
        }

        next();
      });
    }
  };
}

export default defineConfig({
  root: '.',
  publicDir: 'public',
  plugins: [burgerFactoryApiPlugin()],
  build: {
    outDir: 'dist',
    assetsDir: 'assets',
    rollupOptions: {
      input: {
        main: './index.html',
        manager: './manager.html'
      }
    }
  },
  server: {
    host: '0.0.0.0',
    port: 3000,
    open: false
  }
});

```markdown
# The Burger Factory — Real-Life Simulation Pipeline

A zero-dependency (Node >= 18) digital-twin simulator for **The Burger Factory** LAN/Vite mode.
It generates realistic multi-day, multi-outlet, multi-customer traffic against the running app,
drives the full reservation lifecycle (book -> seat -> complete / cancel / no-show), injects
chaos, and writes everything — including every error with a resolution hint — to
`SIMULATION_LOG.txt`.

Drop this folder into `D:\Burger_factory\simulation\`. It does not touch your package.json
(it has its own) and installs nothing.

## Quick start

```bat
:: 1. Start your app (vite on :3000)          start-burger-factory.bat
::    …or use the built-in test harness (:3100)
node simulation\test-harness\server.mjs

:: 2. Probe the target
node simulation\run.mjs --probe-only --target http://localhost:3000

:: 3. Smoke run (1 virtual day, ~2 real minutes)
node simulation\run.mjs --tag smoke --days 1 --accel 600 --target http://localhost:3000

:: 4. Standard run (7 virtual days)
node simulation\run.mjs --tag standard --days 7 --accel 240

:: 5. Soak (30 virtual days, 3x demand, aggressive chaos)
node simulation\run.mjs --tag soak --days 30 --accel 480 --multiplier 3 --chaos aggressive

:: 6. Reproduce any run exactly (same population, same story)
node simulation\run.mjs --seed BF-7A2C9K --days 3 --accel 720 --target http://localhost:3000
```

Everything lands in `SIMULATION_LOG.txt` (append-only across runs) and
`reports/sim-report-<runid>.md` + `reports/simulation_errors_<runid>.json`.

## CLI reference

| Flag | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--target URL` | `http://localhost:3000` | Base URL of the app or harness |
| `--days N` | 7 | Virtual days to simulate |
| `--accel N` | 240 | Time compression (1 = real time) |
| `--seed TAG` | random (echoed) | Deterministic world seed |
| `--cap N` | 800 | Max concurrent actors (arrivals queue above this) |
| `--chaos MODE` | standard | `off` / `standard` / `aggressive` |
| `--multiplier N` | 1 | Demand volume multiplier |
| `--start-date DATE` | today | First simulated day (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--tag NAME` | run | Used in run ids and filenames |
| `--probe-only` | — | Probe GET + SSE handshake, then exit |
| `--log-level` | info | `debug` logs every FSM step |
| `--fresh` | — | Start a new log instead of appending |

## What it models (digital twin)

- **7 outlets, 110 tables** — verbatim replica of `src/js/data.js` `locationTables`.
- **20 time slots** (12:30-22:00) and the **90-minute turn rule** — same as `booking.js`.
- **Arrivals**: non-homogeneous per-30-minute process; lunch and dinner peaks; Sat 1.7x /
  Fri 1.4x / Sun 1.5x weekend factors; Goa high-season factor 1.15.
- **Channels**: online ~68%, walk-in ~22%, phone ~10% (walk-in share rises in the evening).
- **Personas**: party size, seating preference, temperament (impulsive/balanced/picky),
  punctuality (77% on-time, 15% late 5-14m, 8% no-show), turn duration 90±15m,
  pre-arrival cancellation 12%, abandonment behavior by temperament.
- **7 virtual floor managers** (one per outlet) who sync, seat, complete, and mark no-shows
  exactly the way `manager.js` does.
- **The client replica** reimplements `checkAvailability`, `getSlotAvailabilityGrid`,
  `createReservation` and `createWalkInReservation` **verbatim — bugs included** — so the
  traffic it generates is authentic, including the parts that hurt.

## Chaos catalog (each targets a known weakness)

| Scenario | What it proves |
|---|---|
| Race pair (two groups, same table+slot, simultaneous POSTs) | No server-side overlap guard -> double booking (A3-4) |
| Double submit (double-click) | No idempotency -> duplicate booking codes (A4-3) |
| Invalid payloads (guests 99, time 25:99, date 2026-13-45, 300-char names...) | Zero server-side validation (A3-1) |
| Abandoned request (abort mid-POST) | Ghost bookings on client disconnect (A4-2) |
| Rapid fire (12 POSTs / 300ms) | Throughput + race stress |
| Clock skew (createdAt 2031, past dates) | Client-trusted timestamps (A3-1) |
| Illegal transitions (completed -> confirmed, cancelled -> seated) | PATCH has no state machine (A4-5) |
| Table sniper (stampede on a just-cancelled table) | Post-cancellation race window |

## SIMULATION_LOG.txt grammar

```
[R 2026-10-17T21:22:31.040+05:30][V D3 19:31:12][C-0812][BOOKING] [INFO ] arrival outlet=anjuna ...
[R 2026-10-17T21:22:31.041+05:30][V D3 19:31:15][CHAOS][RACE] [ERROR] ERR-0031/DBL-BOOK race pair: BOTH POSTs accepted — ...
      ctx: {...}
      finding: A3-4 / A3-6
      hint: Move availability check + table allocation server-side; ...
```

Every error line carries: ERR id, category, signature, context dump, the **code-review finding
it maps to**, and a **fix hint**. The end-of-run block groups errors by category and signature
and tells you what to fix first.

## Validated in this repository (evidence)

Run `validation-final` — 3 virtual days (Sat/Sun/Mon), seed `BF-7A2C9K`, accel 720x against
the included test harness:

- 1,313 virtual customers (deterministic: same seed = same population, verified across 3 runs)
- 896 online/phone bookings + 225 walk-ins; 62 cancellations; 70 no-shows; 1,012 completed turns
- 11,436 HTTP requests, 0 failures; **SSE parity clean: 3,105 events for 3,105 mutations**
- 27 invariant violations caught with fix hints:
  DBL-BOOK x (race pairs + organic walk-ins), ILLEGAL-TR x17, DUP-CODE x7, OVER-CAP, SSE-GAP

Full evidence: `SIMULATION_LOG.txt` and `reports/` in this folder.

## Test harness (`test-harness/`)

A byte-faithful standalone replica of the vite.config.js embedded REST engine (same routes,
same seed, same validation-free behavior). Use it to validate the simulator without the full
app, or later as the "broken engine" side of an A/B test against a fixed engine.

```bat
node test-harness\server.mjs 3100
node run.mjs --target http://127.0.0.1:3100 --tag smoke --days 1 --accel 600
```

## Files

```
simulation/
├── run.mjs                    CLI entrypoint
├── sim.config.json            defaults (overridden by CLI flags)
├── src/
│   ├── util.js                time/math/format helpers (IST-anchored)
│   ├── core/rng.js            seeded deterministic RNG (mulberry32 + forks)

```plaintext
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — REAL-LIFE SIMULATION PIPELINE
// CLI entrypoint.
//
// Quick start:
//   1. Start the app:            start-burger-factory.bat  (vite on :3000)
//      …or the test harness:      node test-harness/server.mjs  (:3100)
//   2. Probe:                     node run.mjs --probe-only
//   3. Smoke (2 min):             node run.mjs --tag smoke --days 1 --accel 600
//   4. Standard (7 virtual days): node run.mjs --tag standard --days 7 --accel 240
//   5. Reproduce a run:           node run.mjs --seed BF-XXXXXX --days 7 --accel 240
// ============================================

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { parseArgs } from './src/util.js';
import { Orchestrator, pkgRoot } from './src/engine/orchestrator.js';

const HELP = `
The Burger Factory — Real-Life Simulation Pipeline (zero dependencies, Node >= 18)

Usage: node run.mjs [options]

Core options:
  --target URL        Base URL of the app        (default: http://localhost:3000)
  --days N            Virtual days to simulate    (default: 7)
  --accel N           Time compression factor    (default: 240; 1 = real time)
  --seed TAG          Deterministic seed like BF-9F3A2C (default: random, echoed in log)
  --cap N             Max concurrent actors       (default: 800)
  --chaos MODE        off | standard | aggressive (default: standard)
  --multiplier N      Demand volume multiplier   (default: 1)
  --start-date DATE   YYYY-MM-DD start of sim    (default: today)
  --tag NAME          Run tag used in ids/filenames
  --probe-only        Probe the target and exit
  --log-level LEVEL   info | debug               (default: info)
  --out PATH          SIMULATION_LOG.txt path    (default: <pkg>/SIMULATION_LOG.txt)
  --fresh             Start a fresh log (default appends run history)

Presets (npm run):
  smoke | standard | soak
`;

function loadBaseConfig() {
  const p = path.join(pkgRoot(), 'sim.config.json');
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); } catch { return {}; }
}

function num(v, fallback) { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback; }

async function main() {
  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  if (args.help || args.h) { console.log(HELP); process.exit(0); }

  const base = loadBaseConfig();
  const config = {
    ...base,
    target: args.target ? String(args.target).replace(/\/+$/, '') : base.target || 'http://localhost:3000',
    days: num(args.days, base.days ?? 7),
    acceleration: num(args.accel, base.acceleration ?? 240),
    maxConcurrentActors: num(args.cap, base.maxConcurrentActors ?? 800),
    seed: args.seed && args.seed !== true ? String(args.seed) : (base.seed ?? null),
    chaos: ['off', 'standard', 'aggressive'].includes(args.chaos) ? args.chaos : (base.chaos ?? 'standard'),
    tag: args.tag && args.tag !== true ? String(args.tag) : 'run',
    startDate: args['start-date'] && args['start-date'] !== true ? String(args['start-date']) : (base.startDate ?? null),
    demand: { ...base.demand, multiplier: num(args.multiplier, base.demand?.multiplier ?? 1) },
    log: { ...(base.log || {}), level: args['log-level'] || base.log?.level || 'info', append: args.fresh ? false : (base.log?.append !== false) },
    network: base.network || { timeoutMs: 8000 },
    audit: base.audit || { everyMutations: 250, sseGraceMs: 2500 },
    reports: base.reports || { dir: 'reports' },
    sseMonitor: base.sseMonitor !== false,
    warmup: base.warmup || { minutes: 30, bookings: 4 }
  };
  if (args.out) config.log = { ...config.log, path: String(args.out) };

  const orch = new Orchestrator(config);

  if (args['probe-only']) {
    // lightweight: only preflight
    const r = await orch.runProbeOnly();
    process.exit(r ? 0 : 2);
  }

  const result = await orch.run();
  if (!result.ok) process.exit(2);
  process.exit(result.interrupted ? 130 : 0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('FATAL:', e && e.stack ? e.stack : e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — VIRTUAL CUSTOMER
// A faithful replica of what the REAL client does
// (src/js/booking.js), bugs included — on purpose.
// The point is to generate authentic traffic and
// authentic failure modes, not idealized ones.
//
// Flow (mirrors the web app):
//   arrival (page load + GET sync)
//   -> browse (virtual think time)
//   -> slot chips grid (getSlotAvailabilityGrid replica)
//   -> submit: sync GET -> checkAvailability replica
//      -> build record -> POST {reservation}
// The client-side code IGNORES the POST response —
// exactly like booking.js. We log it, though.
// ============================================

import { locationTables, outletNames, TIME_SLOTS, getTable } from '../demand/outlets.js';
import { toMin, toHHMM, TURN_MINUTES, j, dateOf, timeOf } from '../util.js';
import { makeBookingCode } from '../demand/names.js';

// --- booking.js zone preference map (verbatim) ---
const PREF_MAP = {
  indoor: ['indoor'],
  outdoor: ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
  beachside: ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
  rooftop: ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
};

const ACTIVE_STATUSES = (st) => !['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(st);

export class VirtualCustomer {
  constructor({ id, planEvent, clock, adapter, logger, ledger, rng, pool }) {
    this.id = id;                       // C-0001
    this.plan = planEvent;              // {at, outlet, channel, persona}
    this.clock = clock;
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.log = logger;
    this.ledger = ledger;
    this.rng = rng;                     // forked, deterministic
    this.pool = pool;
    this.view = [];                     // localStorage mirror (last sync)
    this.state = 'arrived';
    this.outcome = null;                // final outcome tag
    this.record = null;                 // the reservation record we POSTed
  }

  tag() { return this.id; }

  /** --- replica: booking.js checkAvailability --- */
  replicaCheck(locationId, date, time, guests, seating) {
    const tables = locationTables[locationId];
    if (!tables) return { available: false, table: null, message: 'Location not found' };
    let all = [];
    for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
      for (const t of zoneTables) all.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
    if (seating && seating !== 'any') {
      const allowed = PREF_MAP[seating] || [seating];
      const filtered = all.filter(t => allowed.includes(t.zone));
      if (filtered.length > 0) all = filtered;
    }
    all = all.filter(t => t.capacity >= guests).sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);
    if (all.length === 0) {
      return { available: false, table: null, message: `No single table accommodates ${guests} guests at this outlet. Please call the outlet directly.` };
    }
    const want = toMin(time);
    for (const table of all) {
      const collision = this.view.some(r => {
        if (!ACTIVE_STATUSES(r.status)) return false;
        if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date) return false;
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
        return Math.abs(want - toMin(r.time)) < TURN_MINUTES;
      });
      if (!collision) return { available: true, table, message: `Table ${table.id} (${table.type}, ${table.zone}) is available.` };
    }
    return { available: false, table: null, message: 'All suitable tables are booked for this time slot. Please choose another time.' };
  }

  /** --- replica: booking.js getSlotAvailabilityGrid (with its narrower zone filter) --- */
  replicaGrid(locationId, date, guests, seating) {
    const tables = locationTables[locationId];
    if (!tables) return [];
    const gc = Number(guests) || 2;
    let candidates = [];
    for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
      for (const t of zoneTables) {
        if (seating === 'any' || t.zone === seating || (seating === 'outdoor' && t.zone === 'beachside')) {
          if (t.capacity >= gc) candidates.push({ ...t, zone });
        }
      }
    }
    if (candidates.length === 0) return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => ({ time, status: 'full', freeCount: 0 }));
    return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => {
      const slotMin = toMin(time);
      let free = 0;
      for (const table of candidates) {
        const occupied = this.view.some(r => {
          if (!ACTIVE_STATUSES(r.status)) return false;
          if (r.locationId !== locationId || r.date !== date) return false;
          if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
          return Math.abs(slotMin - toMin(r.time)) < TURN_MINUTES;
        });
        if (!occupied) free++;
      }
      const status = free === 0 ? 'full' : free <= 2 ? 'last_tables' : 'available';
      return { time, status, freeCount: free };
    });
  }

  /** --- replica: booking.js record construction --- */
  buildRecord({ table, timeStr, dateStr, status, notes, seating, occasionOverride }) {
    const p = this.plan.persona;
    const code = makeBookingCode(this.rng);
    const nowIso = new Date(this.clock.now()).toISOString();
    const seatingFinal = seating || p.pref || 'any';
    return {
      id: code,
      code,
      name: p.name,
      email: p.email || '',
      phone: p.phone,
      locationId: this.plan.outlet,
      locationName: outletNames[this.plan.outlet],
      date: dateStr,
      time: timeStr,
      guests: p.party,
      seating: seatingFinal,
      occasion: occasionOverride !== undefined ? occasionOverride : (p.occasion || ''),
      notes: notes !== undefined && notes !== null ? notes : (p.notes || ''),
      tableId: table ? table.id : null,
      tableLabel: table ? table.id : null,
      tableType: table ? table.type : null,
      tableZone: table ? table.zone : null,
      status: status || 'confirmed',
      createdAt: nowIso
    };
  }

  /** Run the whole customer journey. Resolves when the customer leaves. */
  async run() {
    const p = this.plan.persona;
    const outlet = this.plan.outlet;

    this.log.info(this.tag(), 'LIFECYCLE',
      `arrival outlet=${outlet} channel=${this.plan.channel} party=${p.party} pref=${p.pref} temperament=${p.temperament}` +
      (p.slot ? ` target=${p.slotDate} ${p.slot}` : ' (walk-in at the door)'));

    // page-load sync (real client does this on DOMContentLoaded)
    const sync0 = await this.adapter.getReservations();
    if (sync0.list) this.view = sync0.list;

    // browse / think
    let think;
    if (this.plan.channel === 'walkin') think = this.rng.int(2, 8) * 1000;
    else if (this.plan.channel === 'phone') think = this.rng.int(5, 20) * 1000;
    else if (p.temperament === 'impulsive') think = this.rng.int(8, 35) * 1000;
    else if (p.temperament === 'picky') think = this.rng.int(60, 180) * 1000;
    else think = this.rng.int(20, 120) * 1000;
    await this.clock.waitVirtual(think, this.tag());
    if (this.pool.stopped) { this.outcome = 'stopped'; return; }

    if (this.plan.channel === 'walkin') return this.runWalkIn();

    // ---------- online / phone booking flow ----------
    const dateStr = p.slotDate;
    const wantSlot = p.slot;

    // slot chips the customer is willing to try, in order
    const trySlots = [wantSlot];
    if (p.temperament !== 'impulsive') {
      const idx = TIME_SLOTS.indexOf(wantSlot);
      for (const off of [1, -1, 2, -2]) {
        const t = TIME_SLOTS[idx + off];
        if (t) trySlots.push(t);
      }
    } else if (TIME_SLOTS.indexOf(wantSlot) + 1 < TIME_SLOTS.length) {
      trySlots.push(TIME_SLOTS[TIME_SLOTS.indexOf(wantSlot) + 1]);
    }

    let attempts = 0;
    const maxAttempts = p.temperament === 'picky' ? 3 : p.temperament === 'balanced' ? 2 : 1;

    for (const slot of trySlots) {
      if (attempts >= maxAttempts) break;
      attempts++;

      // the customer looks at the chip grid (stale local view)
      const grid = this.replicaGrid(outlet, dateStr, p.party, p.pref);
      const chip = grid.find(g => g.time === slot);
      if (chip && chip.status === 'full' && this.rng.chance(p.temperament === 'impulsive' ? 0.65 : p.temperament === 'balanced' ? 0.35 : 0.15)) {
        this.outcome = 'abandoned-grid-full';
        this.log.info(this.tag(), 'BOOKING', `abandoned: grid shows ${slot} full for party=${p.party} pref=${p.pref} (view ${this.view.length} records)`, { slot, date: dateStr });
        return this.finish();
      }

      // submit path == createReservation(): sync, then client-side check, then POST
      const sync = await this.adapter.getReservations();
      if (sync.list) this.view = sync.list;
      const check = this.replicaCheck(outlet, dateStr, slot, p.party, p.pref);

      if (!check.available) {
        this.log.info(this.tag(), 'BOOKING', `client-side rejection at ${slot}: ${check.message}`);
        this.pool.noteClientReject();
        continue; // next slot
      }

      const table = check.table;
      let record = this.buildRecord({ table, timeStr: slot, dateStr, status: 'confirmed' });

      // chaos mutation of the payload, if assigned
      if (this.chaos && this.chaos.kind === 'invalid-payload') record = this.chaos.mutate(record, this.rng);
      if (this.chaos && this.chaos.kind === 'clock-skew') record = this.chaos.skew(record, this.rng);

      // POST (the real client ignores the response — we log it)
      const postOpts = {};
      if (this.chaos && this.chaos.kind === 'abandoned-request') postOpts.abortAtMs = this.chaos.abortAtMs;
      const res = await this.adapter.postReservation(record, postOpts);

      if (this.chaos && this.chaos.kind === 'double-submit') {
        // impatient double-click: same payload again ~80ms later
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80));
        const res2 = await this.adapter.postReservation(record);
        this.log.warn(this.tag(), 'CHAOS', `double-submit: second POST returned HTTP ${res2.status} (server has no idempotency — expect duplicate code)`, { code: record.code });
      }
      if (this.chaos && this.chaos.kind === 'rapid-fire') {
        this.log.warn(this.tag(), 'CHAOS', `rapid-fire: hammering ${this.chaos.count} POSTs`, {});
        const burst = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < this.chaos.count; i++) {
          burst.push(this.adapter.postReservation(record));
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 25));
        }
        await Promise.all(burst);
      }

      if (!res.ok && res.status !== 201) {
        if (res.aborted && res.status === 0) {
          this.log.error(this.tag(), 'NETWORK', 'NETWORK', 'GHOST',
            `POST aborted mid-flight (chaos). The real server may still have processed it — watch for a ghost booking of ${record.code}.`,
            { code: record.code, abortAtMs: postOpts.abortAtMs, error: res.error });
          this.outcome = 'post-aborted-may-ghost';
        } else {
          this.log.error(this.tag(), 'SERVER', 'SERVER', '',
            `POST rejected with HTTP ${res.status}`, { code: record.code, body: res.body, latencyMs: res.latencyMs });
          this.outcome = 'post-rejected';
        }
      } else {
        this.outcome = 'booked';
      }

      this.record = record;
      this.pool.registerBooking(this, record, res);
      return this.finish();
    }

    this.outcome = 'abandoned-no-slot';
    this.log.info(this.tag(), 'BOOKING', `abandoned after ${attempts} attempt(s): no acceptable slot`, {});
    return this.finish();
  }

  /** Walk-in flow — replica of booking.js createWalkInReservation: NO collision check at all. */
  async runWalkIn() {
    const p = this.plan.persona;
    const outlet = this.plan.outlet;
    const dateStr = dateOf(this.clock.now());
    const timeStr = timeOf(this.clock.now()); // HH:MM now

    // the host glances at the floor canvas (local view) and picks a table
    const all = [];
    for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(locationTables[outlet])) {
      for (const t of zoneTables) all.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
    const fits = all.filter(t => t.capacity >= p.party).sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);
    if (fits.length === 0) {
      this.outcome = 'walkin-left-no-table';
      this.log.info(this.tag(), 'WALKIN', `left: no table fits ${p.party} at ${outlet}`);
      return this.finish();
    }
    const nowMin = toMin(timeStr);
    const looksFree = fits.filter(t => !this.view.some(r => {
      if (!ACTIVE_STATUSES(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== outlet || r.date !== dateStr) return false;
      if (r.tableId !== t.id) return false;
      return Math.abs(nowMin - toMin(r.time)) < TURN_MINUTES;
    }));

    let table;
    if (looksFree.length > 0) {
      table = looksFree[0]; // best-fit first-free (like a host scanning the map)
    } else if (this.rng.chance(0.3)) {
      // busy host seats a walk-in on a table that looks busy (real-world mistake)
      table = fits[0];
      this.log.warn(this.tag(), 'WALKIN', `host seated walk-in on ${table.id} although the (stale) view shows it busy — no check performed, like the real client`);
    } else {
      this.outcome = 'walkin-left-floor-full';
      this.log.info(this.tag(), 'WALKIN', `left: floor looks full for party=${p.party} (view-based)`);
      return this.finish();
    }

    const record = this.buildRecord({
      table, timeStr, dateStr,
      status: 'seated',
      notes: 'Walk-in seated from floor plan',
      seating: table.zone
    });
    record.seatedAt = new Date(this.clock.now()).toISOString();

    const res = await this.adapter.postReservation(record);
    if (!res.ok && res.status !== 201) {
      this.log.error(this.tag(), 'SERVER', 'SERVER', '', `walk-in POST rejected HTTP ${res.status}`, { code: record.code, body: res.body });
      this.outcome = 'walkin-post-rejected';
    } else {
      this.outcome = 'walkin-seated';
      this.log.info(this.tag(), 'WALKIN', `seated at ${table.id} (${table.zone}) for ${p.party}, time=${timeStr} — no availability check was performed (faithful to createWalkInReservation)`);
    }
    this.record = record;
    this.pool.registerBooking(this, record, res, { walkin: true });
    return this.finish();
  }

  finish() {
    this.state = 'done';
    this.pool.done(this);
    this.log.debug(this.tag(), 'LIFECYCLE', `done outcome=${this.outcome}`);
    return this.outcome;
  }
}
