```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — VIRTUAL FLOOR MANAGER
// One per outlet. Mirrors manager.js behavior:
// refreshes the dashboard (GET), seats confirmed
// parties at their slot time (respecting persona
// punctuality), marks no-shows after the 15-minute
// grace, completes seated parties after their turn.
// Every action is a real PATCH against the server.
// ============================================

import { toMin, TURN_MINUTES, j, dateOf } from '../util.js';

const GRACE_MIN = 15;

export class VirtualManager {
  constructor({ outlet, clock, adapter, logger, ledger, rng, pool }) {
    this.outlet = outlet;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.log = logger;
    this.ledger = ledger;
    this.rng = rng;
    this.pool = pool;
    this.view = [];
    this.nextLoopAt = 0;         // virtual epoch of next loop iteration
    this.seatedByCode = new Set(); // codes this manager already seated
    this.noShowByCode = new Set();
    this.completedByCode = new Set();
    this.actions = 0;
    this.running = true;
  }

  actor() { return `MGR-${this.outlet}`; }

  /** Called from the engine tick loop. Non-blocking; returns true if it did work. */
  async tick() {
    if (!this.running) return false;
    const now = this.clock.now();
    if (now < this.nextLoopAt) return false;
    // schedule next loop: every 2-5 virtual minutes inside the service window
    this.nextLoopAt = now + this.rng.int(2, 5) * 60000;

    const dateStr = dateOf(now);
    const mins = toMin(this.clock.timeStr());

    // dashboard refresh (like refreshDashboard + syncReservationsFromServer)
    const sync = await this.adapter.getReservations();
    if (sync.list) this.view = sync.list;

    const todays = this.view.filter(r => r.locationId === this.outlet && r.date === dateStr);
    let did = false;

    for (const r of todays) {
      const code = r.code || r.id;
      const slotMin = toMin(r.time);
      const info = this.ledger.get(code);
      const persona = info?.persona || null;

      if (r.status === 'confirmed') {
        const isNoShowPersona = persona && persona.punctuality === 'no-show';
        // no-show decision (only once) — never for personas that will arrive
        if (isNoShowPersona && !this.noShowByCode.has(code) && mins >= slotMin + GRACE_MIN) {
          this.noShowByCode.add(code);
          const res = await this.adapter.patchStatus(code, 'no-show', 'Guest did not arrive within grace window');
          this.log.info(this.actor(), 'LIFECYCLE', `marked NO-SHOW ${code} (slot ${r.time}, grace ${GRACE_MIN}m passed)`, { http: res.status, latencyMs: res.latencyMs });
          this.pool.noteNoShow(); this.actions++;
          if (this.ledger.has(code)) this.ledger.get(code).statusVirtual = 'no-show';
          continue;
        }
        if (!persona && !this.noShowByCode.has(code) && mins >= slotMin + GRACE_MIN + 5) {
          // external record (pre-existing seed) that never showed up
          this.noShowByCode.add(code);
          await this.adapter.patchStatus(code, 'no-show', 'Guest did not arrive');
          this.log.info(this.actor(), 'LIFECYCLE', `marked NO-SHOW ${code} (external record)`);
          this.actions++;
          continue;
        }
        // seating decision (skip no-show personas entirely)
        if (!isNoShowPersona && !this.seatedByCode.has(code)) {
          let seatAt = slotMin;
          if (persona && persona.punctuality === 'late') seatAt = slotMin + persona.lateMin;
          if (mins >= seatAt && mins < 1440) {
            this.seatedByCode.add(code);
            const res = await this.adapter.patchStatus(code, 'seated');
            this.log.info(this.actor(), 'LIFECYCLE', `seated ${code} at ${this.clock.timeStr()} (slot ${r.time}${persona && persona.punctuality === 'late' ? `, arrived ${persona.lateMin}m late` : ''})`, { http: res.status, latencyMs: res.latencyMs });
            this.pool.noteSeated(); this.actions++;
            if (this.ledger.has(code)) {
              this.ledger.get(code).statusVirtual = 'seated';
              this.ledger.get(code).seatedAtVirt = this.clock.now();
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (r.status === 'seated') {
        if (!this.completedByCode.has(code)) {
          const seatedRef = info?.seatedAtVirt || (r.seatedAt ? Date.parse(r.seatedAt) : this.clock.now());
          const turn = persona?.turnMin || TURN_MINUTES;
          if (this.clock.now() >= seatedRef + turn * 60000) {
            this.completedByCode.add(code);
            const res = await this.adapter.patchStatus(code, 'completed');
            this.log.info(this.actor(), 'LIFECYCLE', `completed ${code} (turn ${turn}m done)`, { http: res.status, latencyMs: res.latencyMs });
            this.pool.noteCompleted(); this.actions++; did = true;
            if (this.ledger.has(code)) this.ledger.get(code).statusVirtual = 'completed';
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return did;
  }

  stop() { this.running = false; }
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — ACTOR POOL
// Spawns virtual customers from the demand plan,
// enforces the concurrency cap (queues arrivals),
// owns the ledger of successful bookings, schedules
// pre-arrival cancellations, and feeds the manager
// actors with per-outlet state.
// ============================================

import { VirtualCustomer } from './customer.js';
import { VirtualManager } from './manager.js';
import { locationTables, outletNames } from '../demand/outlets.js';

export class ActorPool {
  constructor({ clock, adapter, logger, worldRng, config, auditor, injector }) {
    this.clock = clock;
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.log = logger;
    this.worldRng = worldRng;
    this.config = config;
    this.auditor = auditor;
    this.injector = injector;

    this.active = new Set();      // in-flight VirtualCustomers
    this.finished = [];           // completed customers
    this.queue = [];              // plan events waiting for a free slot (cap)
    this.ledger = new Map();      // code -> entry (shared with auditor/managers)
    this.custSeq = 0;

    this.managers = new Map();    // outlet -> VirtualManager

    this.counters = {
      spawned: 0, booked: 0, walkinSeated: 0, abandoned: 0, clientRejects: 0,
      postRejected: 0, cancels: 0, noShows: 0, seated: 0, completed: 0, queueWaits: 0
    };
    this.dayCounters = this._freshDay();
    this.stopped = false;
    this._drainResolve = null;
  }

  _freshDay() {
    return { spawned: 0, booked: 0, walkinSeated: 0, abandoned: 0, cancels: 0, noShows: 0, seated: 0, completed: 0, queueWaits: 0 };
  }

  noteClientReject() { this.counters.clientRejects++; }
  noteNoShow() { this.counters.noShows++; this.dayCounters.noShows++; }
  noteSeated() { this.counters.seated++; this.dayCounters.seated++; }
  noteCompleted() { this.counters.completed++; this.dayCounters.completed++; }

  /** Engine calls this with every due plan event. */
  spawn(planEvent) {
    if (this.stopped) return;
    this.counters.spawned++;
    this.dayCounters.spawned++;

    if (this.active.size >= (this.config.maxConcurrentActors || 800)) {
      this.counters.queueWaits++;
      this.dayCounters.queueWaits++;
      if (this.counters.queueWaits % 50 === 1) {
        this.log.warn('POOL', 'ENGINE', `concurrency cap reached (${this.active.size}) — arrivals queueing (total waits ${this.counters.queueWaits})`);
      }
      this.queue.push(planEvent);
      return;
    }
    this._spawnNow(planEvent);
  }

  _spawnNow(planEvent) {
    this.custSeq++;
    const id = `C-${String(this.custSeq).padStart(4, '0')}`;
    const rng = this.worldRng.fork(`${planEvent.salt}:run`);
    const cust = new VirtualCustomer({
      id, planEvent, clock: this.clock, adapter: this.adapter,
      logger: this.log, ledger: this.ledger, rng, pool: this
    });
    if (this.injector) {
      const chaos = this.injector.assignSpawn(planEvent, id);
      if (chaos) cust.chaos = chaos;
    }
    this.active.add(cust);
    cust.run().catch((e) => {
      this.log.error(id, 'CLIENT', 'CLIENT', '', `customer flow crashed: ${e && e.stack ? e.stack.split('\n').slice(0, 3).join(' | ') : e}`, { outlet: planEvent.outlet });
      this.done(cust, 'crashed');
    });
  }

  /** Customer finished its journey. */
  done(customer, outcomeOverride) {
    if (!this.active.delete(customer)) return;
    customer.outcome = outcomeOverride || customer.outcome || 'done';
    this.finished.push(customer);
    if (customer.outcome === 'booked' || customer.outcome === 'walkin-seated') {
      if (customer.outcome === 'booked') { this.counters.booked++; this.dayCounters.booked++; }
      else { this.counters.walkinSeated++; this.dayCounters.walkinSeated++; }
    } else if (String(customer.outcome).startsWith('abandoned') || String(customer.outcome).startsWith('walkin-left')) {
      this.counters.abandoned++;
      this.dayCounters.abandoned++;
    } else if (customer.outcome === 'post-rejected' || customer.outcome === 'post-aborted-may-ghost' || customer.outcome === 'walkin-post-rejected') {
      this.counters.postRejected++;
    }
    if (this._drainResolve && this.active.size === 0 && this.queue.length === 0) {
      const r = this._drainResolve; this._drainResolve = null; r();
    }
  }

  /** Ledger entry after a POST (successful or not). Called by the customer. */
  registerBooking(customer, record, res, opts = {}) {
    const entry = {
      code: record.code,
      customerId: customer.id,
      outlet: record.locationId,
      date: record.date,
      time: record.time,
      tableId: record.tableId,
      party: record.guests,
      channel: customer.plan.channel,
      persona: customer.plan.persona,
      posted: true,
      postedOk: (res.ok || res.status === 201),
      postedAtStr: new Date(this.clock.now()).toISOString(),
      statusVirtual: record.status,
      cancelAt: null,
      cancelDone: false,
      reportedLost: false,
      seatedAtVirt: record.status === 'seated' ? this.clock.now() : null,
      walkin: !!opts.walkin
    };
    this.ledger.set(record.code, entry);
    if (this.auditor) this.auditor.onMutation();
    // schedule realistic pre-arrival cancellation (only clean bookings)
    if (entry.postedOk && entry.statusVirtual === 'confirmed' && entry.persona?.cancelAt) {
      const at = entry.persona.cancelAt;
      if (at > this.clock.now() && at < Date.parse(`${entry.date}T${entry.time}:00`) - 30 * 60000) {
        entry.cancelAt = at;
      }
    }
  }

  /** Engine tick: cancellations due now. */
  async checkDueCancels() {
    if (this.stopped) return;
    const now = this.clock.now();
    for (const entry of this.ledger.values()) {
      if (entry.cancelAt && !entry.cancelDone && entry.statusVirtual === 'confirmed' && now >= entry.cancelAt) {
        entry.cancelDone = true;
        const res = await this.adapter.patchStatus(entry.code, 'cancelled', 'Cancelled by customer online');
        if (res.ok) {
          entry.statusVirtual = 'cancelled';
          this.counters.cancels++;
          this.dayCounters.cancels++;
          this.log.info(entry.customerId, 'CANCEL', `self-cancelled ${entry.code} (${entry.outlet} ${entry.date} ${entry.time}, table ${entry.tableId})`, { http: res.status, latencyMs: res.latencyMs });
          if (this.auditor) this.auditor.onMutation();
          if (this.injector) this.injector.maybeSniper(entry);
        } else {
          this.log.error(entry.customerId, 'CANCEL', 'SERVER', '', `cancel PATCH failed for ${entry.code}`, { status: res.status, body: res.body });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /** Create the 7 floor managers. */
  createManagers() {
    for (const outlet of Object.keys(locationTables)) {
      const rng = this.worldRng.fork(`mgr:${outlet}`);
      this.managers.set(outlet, new VirtualManager({
        outlet, clock: this.clock, adapter: this.adapter,
        logger: this.log, ledger: this.ledger, rng, pool: this
      }));
    }
    return this.managers;
  }

  async tickManagers() {
    for (const mgr of this.managers.values()) {
      try { await mgr.tick(); } catch (e) {
        this.log.error(mgr.actor(), 'CLIENT', 'CLIENT', '', `manager loop error: ${e && e.message}`, { outlet: mgr.outlet });
      }
    }
  }

  resetDay() { this.dayCounters = this._freshDay(); }

  get stats() {
    return {
      ...this.counters,
      active: this.active.size,
      queued: this.queue.length,
      finished: this.finished.length,
      ledgerSize: this.ledger.size
    };
  }

  /** Wait for all in-flight customers (teardown). */
  drain(timeoutMs = 15000) {
    if (this.active.size === 0 && this.queue.length === 0) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this._drainResolve = resolve;
      setTimeout(resolve, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  stop() { this.stopped = true; for (const m of this.managers.values()) m.stop(); }
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — INVARIANT AUDITOR
// The simulation continuously re-reads the server's
// own data file (GET /api/v1/reservations) and checks
// invariants that MUST hold in a correct system:
//   1. no table double-booked (90-min turn rule)
//   2. booking codes unique
//   3. guests never exceed the table's capacity
//   4. status transitions follow the state machine
//   5. every successful POST survives on the server
//   6. online/phone records use real TIME_SLOTS
//   7. SSE broadcast parity with mutations
// Violations are logged as DATA/VALIDATION/SSE errors
// with the offending records attached — this is the
// "txt file that helps resolving the errors".
// ============================================

import { getTable, TIME_SLOTS, outletIds, tablesByOutlet } from '../demand/outlets.js';
import { toMin, TURN_MINUTES, j } from '../util.js';

const ACTIVE = (st) => !['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(st);
const WALKIN_NOTE = 'Walk-in seated from floor plan';

// Legal single-hop transitions (from -> allowed set)
const LEGAL = {
  confirmed: new Set(['seated', 'cancelled', 'no-show', 'confirmed']),
  seated: new Set(['completed', 'seated']),
  completed: new Set(['completed']),
  cancelled: new Set(['cancelled']),
  'no-show': new Set(['no-show'])
};

/**
 * Reachability closure: every status reachable from `from` through ANY
 * number of legal hops. Snapshots under-sample (a record can legally
 * pass confirmed->seated->completed between two audits), so a violation
 * is only real when the new status is NOT in the closure of the old one.
 */
const CLOSURE = {};
for (const key of Object.keys(LEGAL)) {
  const seen = new Set([key]);
  const queue = [key];
  while (queue.length) {
    const cur = queue.shift();
    for (const nxt of LEGAL[cur] || []) {
      if (!seen.has(nxt)) { seen.add(nxt); queue.push(nxt); }
    }
  }
  seen.delete(key);
  CLOSURE[key] = seen;
}

export class Auditor {
  constructor({ adapter, logger, clock, ledger, auditCfg }) {
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.log = logger;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ledger = ledger;               // Map code -> {posted, postedOk, channel, ...}
    this.cfg = auditCfg || {};
    this.mutations = 0;
    this.prevStatuses = new Map();      // code -> status at last audit
    this.baselineCodes = new Set();     // codes that existed before the run
    this._reported = new Set();         // dedupe of invariant violations
    this.violations = [];               // {kind, detail, atVirt}
    this.lastResult = null;
  }

  onMutation() {
    this.mutations++;
    const every = this.cfg.everyMutations || 250;
    if (this.mutations % every === 0) return this.audit(`rolling #${this.mutations}`);
    return null;
  }

  /** Full audit pass. Returns {records, active, newViolations}. */
  async audit(reason) {
    const { list, res } = await this.adapter.getReservations();
    if (list === null) {
      if (!this._reported.has('audit-get-fail')) {
        this._reported.add('audit-get-fail');
        this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'SERVER', '', `audit "${reason}" could not read server state`, { status: res.status, error: res.error });
      }
      return null;
    }
    let newViolations = 0;
    const seen = new Set();

    // ---- 1. double-booking (90-min rule, same outlet+date+table) ----
    const byTable = new Map(); // key -> [record]
    for (const r of list) {
      if (!ACTIVE(r.status)) continue;
      if (!r.tableId || !r.date || !r.time) continue;
      const key = `${r.locationId}|${r.date}|${r.tableId}`;
      if (!byTable.has(key)) byTable.set(key, []);
      byTable.get(key).push(r);
    }
    for (const [key, recs] of byTable) {
      for (let a = 0; a < recs.length; a++) {
        for (let b = a + 1; b < recs.length; b++) {
          const ra = recs[a], rb = recs[b];
          if (Math.abs(toMin(ra.time) - toMin(rb.time)) < TURN_MINUTES) {
            const sig = `dbl:${ra.code}|${rb.code}`;
            if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
              this._reported.add(sig);
              newViolations++;
              this.violations.push({ kind: 'double-book', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { table: key, a: pick(ra), b: pick(rb) } });
              this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'DATA', 'DBL-BOOK',
                `table ${key} double-booked: ${ra.code} (${ra.time}, ${ra.status}) overlaps ${rb.code} (${rb.time}, ${rb.status})`,
                { a: pick(ra), b: pick(rb), reason });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- 2. duplicate codes ----
    const codeCount = new Map();
    for (const r of list) {
      const c = r.code || r.id;
      if (!c) continue;
      codeCount.set(c, (codeCount.get(c) || 0) + 1);
    }
    for (const [code, n] of codeCount) {
      if (n > 1) {
        const sig = `dup:${code}`;
        if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
          this._reported.add(sig);
          newViolations++;
          this.violations.push({ kind: 'dup-code', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { code, count: n } });
          this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'DATA', 'DUP-CODE', `booking code ${code} exists on ${n} records`, { code, count: n, reason });
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- 3. capacity + 4. transitions + 6. slot sanity ----
    for (const r of list) {
      if (seen.has(r.code || r.id)) continue;
      seen.add(r.code || r.id);
      const table = getTable(r.locationId, r.tableId);
      const guests = Number(r.guests) || 0;

      if (table && guests > table.capacity) {
        const sig = `cap:${r.code || r.id}:${guests}`;
        if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
          this._reported.add(sig);
          newViolations++;
          this.violations.push({ kind: 'over-capacity', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { rec: pick(r), tableCap: table.capacity } });
          this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'VALIDATION', 'OVER-CAP',
            `record ${r.code || r.id} has ${guests} guests on table ${r.tableId} (capacity ${table.capacity})`,
            { rec: pick(r), reason });
        }
      }

      const isWalkin = String(r.notes || '').includes(WALKIN_NOTE) || r.status === 'seated' && !TIME_SLOTS.includes(r.time);
      if (!isWalkin && r.time && !TIME_SLOTS.includes(r.time)) {
        const sig = `slot:${r.code || r.id}:${r.time}`;
        if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
          this._reported.add(sig);
          newViolations++;
          this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'VALIDATION', '',
            `record ${r.code || r.id} time ${r.time} is outside the published slot grid (and is not a walk-in)`, { rec: pick(r), reason });
        }
      }

      // timestamps sanity: seated must carry seatedAt
      if (r.status === 'seated' && !r.seatedAt) {
        const sig = `ts:${r.code || r.id}`;
        if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
          this._reported.add(sig);
          newViolations++;
          this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'DATA', '', `seated record ${r.code || r.id} is missing seatedAt`, { rec: pick(r), reason });
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- 4b. transition legality vs previous snapshot (closure-aware) ----
    for (const r of list) {
      const code = r.code || r.id;
      const prev = this.prevStatuses.get(code);
      if (prev && prev !== r.status) {
        const reachable = CLOSURE[prev];
        if (reachable && !reachable.has(r.status)) {
          const sig = `tr:${code}:${prev}->${r.status}`;
          if (!this._reported.has(sig)) {
            this._reported.add(sig);
            newViolations++;
            this.violations.push({ kind: 'illegal-transition', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { code, from: prev, to: r.status } });
            this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'DATA', 'ILLEGAL-TR',
              `record ${code} transitioned ${prev} -> ${r.status} (not reachable through any legal path)`, { from: prev, to: r.status, reason });
          }
        }
      }
      this.prevStatuses.set(code, r.status);
    }

    // ---- 5. lost records: our successful POSTs that vanished ----
    for (const [code, info] of this.ledger) {
      if (!info.postedOk) continue;
      if (this.baselineCodes.has(code)) continue;
      const onServer = seen.has(code);
      if (!onServer && !info.reportedLost) {
        info.reportedLost = true;
        newViolations++;
        this.violations.push({ kind: 'lost-record', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { code } });
        this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'DATA', 'LOST-REC',
          `booking ${code} (POST accepted ${info.postedAtStr}) is no longer present on the server`, { code, outlet: info.outlet, reason });
      }
    }

    // ---- 7. SSE parity ----
    const parity = this.adapter.sseParity(this.cfg.sseGraceMs || 2500);
    if (parity.missing.length) {
      const isFinal = String(reason).includes('teardown');
      const sig = 'sse-parity';
      if (!this._reported.has(sig) || isFinal) {
        this._reported.add(sig);
        if (isFinal) newViolations++; // count the final gap as a real violation
        const byAction = {};
        for (const m of parity.missing) byAction[m.action] = (byAction[m.action] || 0) + 1;
        this.violations.push({ kind: 'sse-gap', atVirt: this.clock.now(), detail: { count: parity.missing.length, byAction } });
        this.log.error('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', 'SSE', 'SSE-GAP',
          `${parity.missing.length} accepted mutations never produced an SSE reservations:changed event`,
          { missing: parity.missing.slice(0, 15), byAction, expected: parity.expected, received: parity.received, reason });
      }
    }

    const active = list.filter(r => ACTIVE(r.status)).length;
    this.lastResult = { records: list.length, active, newViolations, reason };
    this.log.info('AUDIT', 'AUDIT', `audit "${reason}": ${list.length} records, ${active} active, ${newViolations} new violation(s), errors so far ${this.log.errorCount}`);
    return this.lastResult;
  }
}

function pick(r) {
  return {
    code: r.code || r.id, name: r.name, outlet: r.locationId, date: r.date, time: r.time,
    guests: r.guests, table: r.tableId, zone: r.tableZone, status: r.status,
    seatedAt: r.seatedAt || null, createdAt: r.createdAt || null, notes: r.notes || ''
  };
}

/** Ledger factory (owned by orchestrator, shared with auditor + managers). */
export function newLedger() {
  return new Map();
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — CHAOS INJECTOR
// Deliberate fault scenarios, each aimed at a known
// weakness of the current engine:
//   race pairs      -> no server-side overlap guard (A3-4)
//   double submit   -> no idempotency / dup codes   (A4-3)
//   invalid payload -> zero server-side validation  (A3-1)
//   abandon mid-req -> ghost bookings on disconnect (A4-2)
//   rapid fire      -> throughput & race stress
//   clock skew      -> client-trusted timestamps    (A3-1)
//   illegal trans.  -> no state machine on PATCH    (A4-5)
//   table sniper    -> post-cancellation stampede
// Modes: off | standard | aggressive (x3)
// ============================================

import { locationTables, TIME_SLOTS, getTable } from '../demand/outlets.js';
import { makeIdentity, makeBookingCode } from '../demand/names.js';
import { toMin, TURN_MINUTES, j, dateOf, istMidnight } from '../util.js';

const ACTIVE = (st) => !['cancelled', 'no-show', 'completed'].includes(st);

const RACE_OUTLETS = [['anjuna', 30], ['morjim', 20], ['delhi', 20], ['panaji', 12], ['vagator', 10], ['dona-paula', 5], ['nerul', 3]];
const RACE_SLOTS = ['13:00', '13:30', '19:00', '19:30', '20:00', '20:30'];

export class ChaosInjector {
  constructor({ mode = 'standard', worldRng, adapter, logger, clock, ledger }) {
    this.mode = mode;
    this.rng = worldRng.fork('chaos');
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.log = logger;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.ledger = ledger;
    this.pool = null;                  // set by orchestrator after pool exists
    this.scheduled = [];               // [{at, kind, arg}]
    this.dayPlanIndex = 0;
    this.counters = { racePairs: 0, raceBothAccepted: 0, illegalTransitions: 0, snipers: 0, attachCounts: {} };
    this._snipersToday = 0;
    this._firing = false;
  }

  get factor() { return this.mode === 'aggressive' ? 3 : this.mode === 'standard' ? 1 : 0; }

  /** Schedule the standalone scenarios for one virtual day. Accepts any ms within that day. */
  planDay(anyMsInDay) {
    if (this.factor === 0) return;
    const dayStart = istMidnight(anyMsInDay); // midnight IST anchor
    const n = 3 * this.factor;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const at = dayStart + (12 * 60 + 45) * 60000 + this.rng.int(0, (21 * 60 + 30) - (12 * 60 + 45)) * 60000;
      this.scheduled.push({ at, kind: 'racePair' });
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const at = dayStart + (13 * 60) * 60000 + this.rng.int(0, 8 * 60) * 60000;
      this.scheduled.push({ at, kind: 'illegalTransition' });
    }
    this.scheduled.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
  }

  /** Engine tick — fire due events. */
  tick(now) {
    if (this.factor === 0) return;
    while (this.scheduled.length && this.scheduled[0].at <= now) {
      const ev = this.scheduled.shift();
      if (ev.kind === 'racePair') this.racePair().catch(e => this.log.error('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', 'CLIENT', '', `racePair failed: ${e && e.message}`));
      if (ev.kind === 'illegalTransition') this.illegalTransition().catch(e => this.log.error('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', 'CLIENT', '', `illegalTransition failed: ${e && e.message}`));
    }
  }

  onNewDay() { this._snipersToday = 0; }

  /** Per-spawn attached chaos (returns assignment or null). */
  assignSpawn(planEvent, customerId) {
    if (this.factor === 0) return null;
    const r = this.rng.float();
    const s = this.factor; // 1 or 3
    // cumulative rates (standard, per spawn)
    const rates = [
      ['invalid-payload', 0.008 * s],
      ['abandoned-request', 0.010 * s],
      ['double-submit', 0.004 * s],
      ['rapid-fire', 0.002 * s],
      ['clock-skew', 0.003 * s]
    ];
    let acc = 0;
    for (const [kind, p] of rates) {
      acc += Math.min(p, 0.03);
      if (r < acc) {
        this.counters.attachCounts[kind] = (this.counters.attachCounts[kind] || 0) + 1;
        this.log.warn('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', `attached [${kind}] to ${customerId} (${planEvent.channel}, outlet ${planEvent.outlet})`);
        return this._makeAssignment(kind);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  _makeAssignment(kind) {
    const self = this;
    if (kind === 'invalid-payload') {
      return {
        kind,
        mutate(record, rng) {
          const variant = rng.int(0, 6);
          const v = [
            () => ({ ...record, guests: 99 }),
            () => ({ ...record, name: 'X'.repeat(300) }),
            () => ({ ...record, phone: 'not-a-phone-number' }),
            () => ({ ...record, time: '25:99' }),
            () => ({ ...record, date: '2026-13-45' }),
            () => ({ ...record, notes: 'N'.repeat(2000) }),
            () => { const c = { ...record }; delete c.name; return c; }
          ][variant];
          const m = v();
          self.log.warn('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', `invalid payload variant #${variant} (guests=${m.guests}, time=${m.time}, date=${m.date}, nameLen=${(m.name || '').length}) — expecting server validation to reject`);
          return m;
        }
      };
    }
    if (kind === 'abandoned-request') {
      return { kind, abortAtMs: 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 120) };
    }
    if (kind === 'double-submit') return { kind };
    if (kind === 'rapid-fire') return { kind, count: 12 };
    if (kind === 'clock-skew') {
      return {
        kind,
        skew(record, rng) {
          const variant = rng.int(0, 2);
          if (variant === 0) return { ...record, createdAt: '2031-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' };
          if (variant === 1) return { ...record, date: '2020-01-01' };
          return { ...record, time: '03:00' };
        }
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * RACE PAIR — the signature double-booking scenario.
   * Two groups sync at the same instant, both see the same
   * free table, both POST. The engine writes both.
   */
  async racePair(target = null) {
    this.counters.racePairs++;
    const outlet = target?.outlet || this.rng.weighted(RACE_OUTLETS);
    const slot = target?.slot || this.rng.pick(RACE_SLOTS);
    const date = target?.date || dateOf(this.clock.now() + this.rng.int(0, 1) * 86400000);
    const party = this.rng.pick([2, 4]);
    const pref = 'any';

    // both devices sync at the same moment — shared view
    const sync = await this.adapter.getReservations();
    if (!sync.list) { this.log.warn('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', 'race pair aborted: could not sync'); return; }
    const view = sync.list;

    // first-fit table pick (same logic as the client)
    const all = [];
    for (const [zone, tables] of Object.entries(locationTables[outlet] || {})) {
      for (const t of tables) all.push({ ...t, zone });
    }
    const fits = all.filter(t => t.capacity >= party).sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);
    const want = toMin(slot);
    const table = fits.find(t => !view.some(r => {
      if (!ACTIVE(r.status)) return false;
      if (r.locationId !== outlet || r.date !== date) return false;
      if (r.tableId !== t.id) return false;
      return Math.abs(want - toMin(r.time)) < TURN_MINUTES;
    }));
    if (!table) {
      this.log.info('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', `race pair skipped: no free table at ${outlet} ${date} ${slot} for party=${party}`);
      return;
    }

    const mk = (n) => {
      const code = makeBookingCode(this.rng);
      return {
        id: code, code, name: n.name, email: n.email || '', phone: n.phone,
        locationId: outlet, locationName: '', date, time: slot, guests: party,
        seating: pref, occasion: '', notes: 'Racing for the same table',
        tableId: table.id, tableLabel: table.id, tableType: table.type, tableZone: table.zone,
        status: 'confirmed', createdAt: new Date(this.clock.now()).toISOString()
      };
    };
    const idA = makeIdentity(this.rng), idB = makeIdentity(this.rng);
    const recA = mk(idA), recB = mk(idB);

    this.log.warn('CHAOS', 'RACE', `race pair armed: ${outlet} ${date} ${slot} table=${table.id} party=${party} — firing both POSTs ${'~'}simultaneously`, { a: recA.code, b: recB.code });

    const t0 = Date.now();
    const [resA, resB] = await Promise.all([
      this.adapter.postReservation(recA),
      new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20))).then(() => this.adapter.postReservation(recB))
    ]);

    const both = (resA.ok || resA.status === 201) && (resB.ok || resB.status === 201);
    if (both) {
      this.counters.raceBothAccepted++;
      this.log.error('CHAOS', 'RACE', 'RACE', 'DBL-BOOK',
        `race pair: BOTH POSTs accepted — ${recA.code} and ${recB.code} now hold the SAME table ${table.id} at ${slot}. Server performed no overlap check.`,
        { a: resA.status, b: resB.status, outlet, date, slot, table: table.id, realGapMs: Date.now() - t0 });
    } else {
      this.log.info('CHAOS', 'RACE', `race pair outcome: A=${resA.status} B=${resB.status} (a guard may exist)`, { outlet, slot, table: table.id });
    }

    // register both in the ledger so managers run their lifecycle
    if (this.pool) {
      const fakeA = { id: 'CHAOS-RP', plan: { channel: 'online', persona: { turnMin: 90, punctuality: 'on-time', lateMin: 0, cancelAt: null } } };
      const fakeB = { id: 'CHAOS-RP', plan: { channel: 'online', persona: { turnMin: 90, punctuality: 'on-time', lateMin: 0, cancelAt: null } } };
      if (resA.ok || resA.status === 201) this.pool.registerBooking(fakeA, recA, resA);
      if (resB.ok || resB.status === 201) this.pool.registerBooking(fakeB, recB, resB);
    }
  }

  /** ILLEGAL TRANSITION — the manager 'Restore' bug, driven directly. */
  async illegalTransition() {
    this.counters.illegalTransitions++;
    const { list } = await this.adapter.getReservations();
    if (!list) return;
    const pool = list.filter(r => ['completed', 'cancelled', 'no-show'].includes(r.status));
    if (pool.length === 0) { this.log.info('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', 'illegal transition skipped: no terminal records yet'); return; }
    const victim = this.rng.pick(pool);
    const to = this.rng.pick(['confirmed', 'seated', 'completed']);
    const res = await this.adapter.patchStatus(victim.code || victim.id, to, 'chaos: restore attempt');
    this.log.warn('CHAOS', 'CHAOS',
      `illegal transition attempt: ${victim.code || victim.id} ${victim.status} -> ${to} (server responded HTTP ${res.status}). A correct server must reject this.`,
      { from: victim.status, to, http: res.status });
    if (res.ok && victim.status !== to) {
      this.log.error('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', 'DATA', 'ILLEGAL-TR',
        `server ACCEPTED illegal transition ${victim.status} -> ${to} on ${victim.code || victim.id}. PATCH has no state machine (finding A4-5).`,
        { code: victim.code || victim.id, from: victim.status, to });
    }
  }

  /** TABLE SNIPER — stampede on a just-freed table. */
  maybeSniper(cancelledEntry) {
    if (this.factor === 0) return;
    if (this._snipersToday >= 2) return;
    if (!this.rng.chance(0.25)) return;
    this._snipersToday++;
    this.counters.snipers++;
    this.log.warn('CHAOS', 'CHAOS', `table sniper: two groups will race for just-freed ${cancelledEntry.tableId} at ${cancelledEntry.outlet} ${cancelledEntry.date} ${cancelledEntry.time}`);
    this.racePair({ outlet: cancelledEntry.outlet, slot: cancelledEntry.time, date: cancelledEntry.date }).catch(() => {});
  }

  describe() { return { mode: this.mode, ...this.counters }; }
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — VIRTUAL CLOCK
// Dual-time model:
//   * VIRTUAL time drives the story (arrivals, think
//     times, manager loops, service windows) at
//     `acceleration` x real time.
//   * REAL time is what the server experiences; every
//     HTTP round-trip is measured in real ms and
//     stamped into the log next to the virtual time.
// A response that arrives "late" in virtual terms is
// REAL server latency — that is the point.
// ============================================

import { istParts, dateOf, timeOf } from '../util.js';

const MIN_TICK = 50; // ms real per engine tick

export class SimClock {
  constructor({ startEpochMs, acceleration }) {
    this.startEpochMs = startEpochMs;      // virtual epoch of simulation start (11:30 IST anchor)
    this.acceleration = Math.max(1, acceleration);
    this._realStart = Date.now();
    this._waiters = [];                    // {deadline, resolve, tag}
    this._timer = null;
    this._stopped = false;
  }

  /** Current virtual epoch ms. */
  now() { return this.startEpochMs + (Date.now() - this._realStart) * this.acceleration; }

  /** Real ms elapsed since start. */
  realElapsed() { return Date.now() - this._realStart; }

  /** Virtual ms elapsed since start. */
  virtElapsed() { return this.now() - this.startEpochMs; }

  dayIndex() { return Math.floor(this.virtElapsed() / 86400000) + 1; }
  dateStr() { return dateOf(this.now()); }
  timeStr() { return timeOf(this.now()); }

  /** 'D2 19:04:37' for log lines. */
  stamp() {
    const p = istParts(this.now());
    return `D${this.dayIndex()} ${p.hh}:${p.mm}:${p.ss}`;
  }

  /** Wait `virtualMs` of simulated time. */
  waitVirtual(virtualMs, tag = '') {
    const deadline = this.now() + Math.max(0, virtualMs);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this._waiters.push({ deadline, resolve, tag });
      this._waiters.sort((a, b) => a.deadline - b.deadline);
    });
  }

  /** Engine tick pump. Resolves waiters whose deadline has passed. */
  _tick() {
    if (this._stopped) return;
    const now = this.now();
    while (this._waiters.length && this._waiters[0].deadline <= now) {
      this._waiters.shift().resolve();
    }
  }

  start() {
    if (this._timer) return;
    this._timer = setInterval(() => this._tick(), MIN_TICK);
  }

  stop() {
    this._stopped = true;
    if (this._timer) clearInterval(this._timer);
    const w = this._waiters; this._waiters = [];
    for (const x of w) x.resolve();
  }

  /** Epoch of the next 04:00 IST day-roll strictly after `afterMs` (virtual). */
  nextDayRollAfter(afterMs) {
    const ist = afterMs + 330 * 60000;      // IST frame
    const day = Math.floor(ist / 86400000);
    const next0400IstFrame = (day + 1) * 86400000 + 4 * 3600000; // next day 04:00
    return next0400IstFrame - 330 * 60000;
  }
}

/** Resolve config.startDate into an epoch. Default: today 11:30 IST (service opens 12:30). */
export function resolveStartEpoch(startDateRaw) {
  const todayIst = new Date(Date.now() + 330 * 60000);
  if (startDateRaw && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(startDateRaw))) {
    const [y, m, d] = String(startDateRaw).split('-').map(Number);
    return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, 6, 0, 0); // 06:00 UTC == 11:30 IST
  }
  return Date.UTC(todayIst.getUTCFullYear(), todayIst.getUTCMonth(), todayIst.getUTCDate(), 6, 0, 0);
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — SEEDED RNG (deterministic worlds)
// mulberry32 core + fork derivation.
// Same seed => same narrative (arrivals, personas,
// decisions). HTTP latency stays real-world.
// ============================================

function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/** Simple string hash for fork derivation. */
export function hashStr(s) {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

export class Rng {
  constructor(seed, tag = 'root') {
    this.seed = typeof seed === 'string' ? hashStr(seed) : (seed >>> 0);
    this.tag = tag;
    this._f = mulberry32(this.seed);
    this._calls = 0;
  }

  /** float [0,1) */
  float() { this._calls++; return this._f(); }

  /** int min..max inclusive */
  int(min, max) { return min + Math.floor(this.float() * (max - min + 1)); }

  /** true with probability p */
  chance(p) { return this.float() < p; }

  /** pick one element */
  pick(arr) { return arr[Math.floor(this.float() * arr.length)]; }

  /** pick from [[value, weight], ...] */
  weighted(pairs) {
    let total = 0;
    for (const p of pairs) total += p[1];
    let r = this.float() * total;
    for (const p of pairs) { r -= p[1]; if (r <= 0) return p[0]; }
    return pairs[pairs.length - 1][0];
  }

  /** approx normal, mean sd */
  gauss(mean = 0, sd = 1) {
    const u = 1 - this.float(), v = this.float();
    return mean + sd * Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  /** Fisher-Yates */
  shuffle(arr) {
    const a = [...arr];
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const k = Math.floor(this.float() * (i + 1));
      [a[i], a[k]] = [a[k], a[i]];
    }
    return a;
  }

  /** Derive an independent child rng — deterministic from (seed, tag, salt). */
  fork(salt) { return new Rng(hashStr(`${this.seed}:${this.tag}:${salt}`), `${this.tag}/${salt}`); }
}

/** Random 6-char seed like BF-9F3A2C */
export function randomSeedTag() {
  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) s += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
  return `BF-${s}`;
}
```

```javascript
// Non-homogeneous arrival process per outlet:
//   * 30-minute buckets across the 12:00-23:00 service window
//   * lunch / shoulder / dinner shape
//   * weekend + season multipliers (Goa high season default)
//   * channel mix (online / walk-in / phone)

const PARTY_WALKIN = [[1, 6], [2, 40], [3, 14], [4, 26], [5, 6], [6, 6], [7, 1], [8, 1]];

  default: [['any', 38], ['indoor', 20], ['outdoor', 22], ['beachside', 10], ['rooftop', 10]],
  morjim: [['any', 30], ['indoor', 12], ['outdoor', 22], ['beachside', 30], ['rooftop', 6]],
  delhi: [['any', 30], ['indoor', 22], ['outdoor', 16], ['beachside', 2], ['rooftop', 30]],
  panaji: [['any', 34], ['indoor', 40], ['outdoor', 18], ['beachside', 4], ['rooftop', 4]],

};

function dayFactorFor(weekday, weekendFactor) {
  // weekday: 0=Sun..6=Sat
  if (weekday === 6) return weekendFactor;        // Saturday peak
  if (weekday === 5) return weekendFactor * 0.82; // Friday
  if (weekday === 0) return weekendFactor * 0.88; // Sunday
  return 1.0;
}

export class DemandEngine {
  constructor(worldRng, config, clock) {
    this.rng = worldRng;
    this.config = config;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.plan = [];       // sorted [{at, outlet, channel, persona}]
  }

  /** Build the entire multi-day arrival plan (deterministic). */
  buildPlan() {
    const days = this.config.days;
    const startDay = this.clock.startEpochMs;
    const season = this.config.demand.seasonFactor ?? 1.15;
    const mult = this.config.demand.multiplier ?? 1;

    for (let d = 0; d < days; d++) {
      const dayStart = istMidnight(this.clock.startEpochMs) + d * 86400000; // midnight IST anchor
      const weekday = istParts(dayStart + 3600000).weekday; // mid-day, safe
      const dayFactor = dayFactorFor(weekday, this.config.demand.weekendFactor ?? 1.7);

      for (const outlet of outletIds) {
        const expected = OUTLET_BASE[outlet] * dayFactor * season * mult;
        // per-bucket poisson
        for (const b of BUCKETS) {
          const n = poisson(expected * b.share, this.rng);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const at = dayStart + b.from * 60000 + this.rng.int(0, 29) * 60000 + this.rng.int(0, 59) * 1000;
            const channel = this._channel(b, this.rng);
            const salt = `p:${d}:${outlet}:${b.from}:${i}`;
            const persona = this._persona(outlet, channel, at, salt, d, days);
            this.plan.push({ at, outlet, channel, persona, salt });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // warmup bookings: a handful of phone bookings minutes after open
    const warm = this.config.warmup || { minutes: 30, bookings: 4 };
    for (let i = 0; i < (warm.bookings ?? 4); i++) {
      const outlet = outletIds[i % outletIds.length];
      const at = this.clock.startEpochMs + this.rng.int(2, Math.max(3, warm.minutes ?? 30)) * 60000;
      const salt = `w:${i}`;
      const persona = this._persona(outlet, 'phone', at, salt, 0, days);
      this.plan.push({ at, outlet, channel: 'phone', persona, salt });
    }

    this.plan.sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at);
    return this.plan;
  }

  _channel(bucket, rng) {
    const r = rng.float();
    const phoneP = 0.09;
    if (r < phoneP) return 'phone';
    if (r < phoneP + bucket.walkin) return 'walkin';
    return 'online';
  }

  _persona(outlet, channel, atArrival, salt, dayIndex, totalDays) {
    const rng = this.rng.fork(salt);
    const identity = makeIdentity(rng);
    const party = channel === 'walkin' ? rng.weighted(PARTY_WALKIN) : rng.weighted(PARTY_ONLINE);
    const pref = rng.weighted(PREFS[outlet] || PREFS.default);
    const temperament = rng.weighted(TEMPERAMENTS);
    const punctRoll = rng.float();
    const punctuality = punctRoll < 0.08 ? 'no-show' : punctRoll < 0.23 ? 'late' : 'on-time';
    const lateMin = punctuality === 'late' ? rng.int(5, 14) : 0;
    const turnMin = clamp(Math.round(rng.gauss(TURN_MINUTES, 10)), 70, 115);

    const p = {
      ...identity, party, pref, temperament, punctuality, lateMin, turnMin,
      occasion: makeOccasion(rng), notes: makeNotes(rng),
      channel, outlet, salt
    };

    if (channel === 'walkin') {
      p.slot = null; p.slotDate = null; p.cancelAt = null;
      return p;
    }

    // ---- pick target slot/date ----
    const offWeights = [[0, 45], [1, 25], [2, 12], [3, 8], [4, 4], [5, 3], [6, 3]];
    let off = rng.weighted(offWeights);
    off = Math.min(off, totalDays - 1 - dayIndex);
    if (off < 0) off = 0;
    const slotIdx = rng.weighted(SLOT_W.map((w, i) => [i, w]));
    const slot = TIME_SLOTS[slotIdx];
    const slotDayStart = istMidnight(this.clock.startEpochMs) + (dayIndex + off) * 86400000; // midnight IST
    const slotEpoch = slotDayStart + toMin(slot) * 60000;

    // ---- lead time -> arrival ----
    let leadMin;
    if (off === 0) leadMin = rng.int(45, 360);
    else if (off === 1) leadMin = rng.int(20 * 60, 28 * 60);
    else leadMin = rng.int(44 * 60, Math.min(156 * 60, off * 1440 + 60));
    if (channel === 'phone' && off === 0 && rng.chance(0.6)) leadMin = rng.int(25, 120);

    let arrival = slotEpoch - leadMin * 60000;
    // clamp: nobody books before 10:45 local; keep inside sim window
    const dayOfArrival = Math.floor((arrival + 330 * 60000) / 86400000);
    const earliestOk = dayOfArrival * 86400000 - 330 * 60000 + (10 * 60 + 45) * 60000;
    if (arrival < earliestOk) arrival = earliestOk + rng.int(0, 90) * 60000;
    if (arrival < this.clock.startEpochMs + 60000) arrival = this.clock.startEpochMs + rng.int(1, 8) * 60000;
    if (arrival > slotEpoch - 30 * 60000) arrival = slotEpoch - 30 * 60000;
    p.at = arrival;

    p.slot = slot;
    p.slotDate = istParts(slotEpoch).date;
    p.slotEpoch = slotEpoch;

    // pre-arrival cancellation scheduling
    if (rng.chance(0.12)) {
      const lo = arrival + 5 * 60000;
      const hi = slotEpoch - 40 * 60000;
      p.cancelAt = hi > lo ? lo + rng.float() * (hi - lo) : null;
    } else p.cancelAt = null;

    return p;
  }

  /** Plan digest for the run header / report. */
  describe() {
    const byOutlet = {}; const byChannel = {}; const byDay = {};
    for (const e of this.plan) {
      byOutlet[e.outlet] = (byOutlet[e.outlet] || 0) + 1;
      byChannel[e.channel] = (byChannel[e.channel] || 0) + 1;
      const d = istParts(e.at).date;
      byDay[d] = (byDay[d] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return { total: this.plan.length, byOutlet, byChannel, byDay };
  }
}

export const CURVES_DOC = { OUTLET_BASE, BUCKETS, SLOT_W, TEMPERAMENTS, PARTY_ONLINE, PARTY_WALKIN, PREFS };
```

```javascript
/** Build a persona-sampled guest identity. */
export function makeIdentity(rng) {
  const first = rng.pick(FIRST);
  const last = rng.pick(LAST);
  const name = `${first} ${last}`;
  // Indian mobile: 9/8/7 leading digit, format like the app's seed data
  const lead = rng.pick(['9', '8', '7']);
  let rest = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) rest += rng.int(0, 9);
  const phone = `+91 ${lead}${rest.slice(0, 4)} ${rest.slice(4)}`;
  const email = rng.chance(0.45) ? '' : `${first.toLowerCase()}.${last.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '')}@${rng.pick(['gmail.com', 'outlook.com', 'yahoo.in', 'proton.me'])}`;
  return { name, phone, email };
}

export function makeNotes(rng) { return rng.chance(0.42) ? rng.pick(NOTES_POOL) : ''; }
export function makeOccasion(rng) { return rng.weighted(OCCASIONS); }

/** Booking code in the app's own format, generated CLIENT-side like booking.js does. */
export function makeBookingCode(rng) {
  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  let code = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) code += chars[Math.floor(rng.float() * chars.length)];
  return code;
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — ORCHESTRATOR
// The pipeline:
//   PREFLIGHT  probe server, snapshot baseline, start SSE
//   MAIN       virtual clock loop:
//                - spawn due arrivals (demand plan)
//                - managers drive the service lifecycle
//                - cancellations fire at their scheduled time
//                - chaos injector fires scheduled scenarios
//                - rolling invariant audits every N mutations
//   DAY ROLL   at 04:00 IST: audit + day summary + next-day chaos plan
//   TEARDOWN   drain actors, final audit, SSE parity, report, log footer
// ============================================

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { SimClock, resolveStartEpoch } from '../core/clock.js';
import { Rng, randomSeedTag } from '../core/rng.js';
import { SimLogger } from '../log/logger.js';
import { ServerAdapter, Metrics } from '../server/adapter.js';
import { Auditor } from '../audit/invariants.js';
import { ActorPool } from '../actors/pool.js';
import { ChaosInjector } from '../chaos/injector.js';
import { DemandEngine } from '../demand/curves.js';
import { ReportBuilder } from '../report/report.js';
import { fmtIST, j, istMidnight } from '../util.js';

const PKG_ROOT = path.dirname(path.dirname(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)))); // <pkg>/src/engine/orchestrator.js -> <pkg>
export function pkgRoot() { return PKG_ROOT; }

const ENGINE_TICK_MS = 100;

export class Orchestrator {
  constructor(config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.seed = config.seed || randomSeedTag();
    this.runId = `${(config.tag || 'run').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, '')}-${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:T]/g, '').slice(0, 14)}`;
    this.startReal = Date.now();
    this.interrupted = false;
    this.daySummaries = [];
    this._stopping = false;
    this._done = false;
  }

  /** Standalone preflight probe (--probe-only). Returns true when server is reachable. */
  async runProbeOnly() {
    const cfg = this.config;
    const clock = this.clock = new SimClock({ startEpochMs: resolveStartEpoch(cfg.startDate), acceleration: 1 });
    const logPath = path.isAbsolute(cfg.log.path) ? cfg.log.path : path.join(PKG_ROOT, cfg.log.path);
    this.logger = new SimLogger({ filePath: logPath, clock, level: 'info', append: true, runId: `${this.runId}-probe` });
    this.adapter = new ServerAdapter({ target: cfg.target, timeoutMs: cfg.network.timeoutMs, logger: this.logger, clock, metrics: this.metrics = new Metrics() });
    this.logger.section(`PROBE ONLY — ${cfg.target}`);
    const probe = await this.adapter.probe();
    if (probe.list === null) {
      this.logger.error('SYS', 'ENGINE', 'SERVER', '', `probe FAILED — ${cfg.target} is not answering (HTTP ${probe.res.status}, ${probe.res.error || 'no response'})`);
      console.error(`PROBE FAILED: ${cfg.target} is not answering. Start the app (start-burger-factory.bat) or the harness (node test-harness/server.mjs).`);
      return false;
    }
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', `probe OK — HTTP ${probe.res.status}, ${probe.list.length} reservation(s) on server, GET latency ${probe.res.latencyMs}ms`);
    console.log(`PROBE OK: ${probe.list.length} reservation(s), latency ${probe.res.latencyMs}ms`);
    const sseTest = await this.adapter.startSse();
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200));
    const ok = this.adapter.sse.connected;
    this.adapter.stopSse();
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'SSE', ok ? 'SSE handshake verified (event: connected received)' : 'SSE could NOT connect — check /api/v1/events');
    console.log(ok ? 'SSE: OK' : 'SSE: FAILED');
    return true;
  }

  async run() {
    const cfg = this.config;
    const clock = this.clock = new SimClock({
      startEpochMs: resolveStartEpoch(cfg.startDate),
      acceleration: cfg.acceleration
    });

    const logPath = path.isAbsolute(cfg.log.path) ? cfg.log.path : path.join(PKG_ROOT, cfg.log.path);
    this.logger = new SimLogger({
      filePath: logPath, clock, level: cfg.log.level || 'info',
      append: cfg.log.append !== false, runId: this.runId
    });

    this.logger.section(`RUN ${this.runId} — PREFLIGHT`);
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE',
      `boot: target=${cfg.target} days=${cfg.days} accel=${cfg.acceleration}x seed=${this.seed} chaos=${cfg.chaos} cap=${cfg.maxConcurrentActors}`,
      { startAt: fmtIST(clock.startEpochMs), log: logPath });

    const metrics = this.metrics = new Metrics();
    this.adapter = new ServerAdapter({ target: cfg.target, timeoutMs: cfg.network.timeoutMs, logger: this.logger, clock, metrics });

    // ---- PREFLIGHT: probe ----
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', `probing ${cfg.target} ...`);
    const probe = await this.adapter.probe();
    if (probe.list === null) {
      this.logger.error('SYS', 'ENGINE', 'SERVER', '', `PREFLIGHT FAILED — cannot read ${cfg.target}/api/v1/reservations`, { status: probe.res.status, error: probe.res.error });
      this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', 'hint: start the app first (start-burger-factory.bat) or point --target at the test harness (node test-harness/server.mjs).');
      return { ok: false, reason: 'probe' };
    }
    const baseline = probe.list;
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', `probe OK: HTTP ${probe.res.status}, ${baseline.length} existing reservation(s), GET latency ${probe.res.latencyMs}ms`);

    // ---- world ----
    this.worldRng = new Rng(this.seed, 'world');
    this.injector = new ChaosInjector({ mode: cfg.chaos, worldRng: this.worldRng, adapter: this.adapter, logger: this.logger, clock, ledger: null });
    this.pool = new ActorPool({ clock, adapter: this.adapter, logger: this.logger, worldRng: this.worldRng, config: cfg, auditor: null, injector: this.injector });
    this.injector.pool = this.pool;
    this.auditor = new Auditor({ adapter: this.adapter, logger: this.logger, clock, ledger: this.pool.ledger, auditCfg: cfg.audit });
    this.pool.auditor = this.auditor;

    for (const r of baseline) {
      const c = r.code || r.id;
      if (c) this.auditor.baselineCodes.add(c);
    }

    this.demand = new DemandEngine(this.worldRng, cfg, clock);
    const plan = this.demand.buildPlan();
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', `demand plan built: ${plan.length} arrivals across ${cfg.days} virtual day(s)`, this.demand.describe());

    this.pool.createManagers();
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', '7 floor managers online (one per outlet)');

    if (cfg.sseMonitor !== false) {
      await this.adapter.startSse();
      this.logger.info('SYS', 'SSE', 'SSE monitor attached to /api/v1/events (parity accounting on)');
    }

    this.injector.planDay(clock.startEpochMs); // day-1 scenarios

    // ---- MAIN LOOP ----
    this.logger.section(`RUN ${this.runId} — MAIN (D1..D${cfg.days})`);
    clock.start();

    this._endEpoch = istMidnight(clock.startEpochMs) + cfg.days * 86400000 - 60000; // 23:59 of last day
    this._nextRoll = clock.nextDayRollAfter(clock.startEpochMs);                    // 04:00 of D2
    this._planIdx = 0;
    this._lastProgress = 0;
    this._dayStartCounters = null;

    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      this._resolveMain = resolve;
      this._sigint = () => {
        if (this._stopping) return;
        this.interrupted = true;
        this.logger.warn('SYS', 'ENGINE', 'SIGINT — draining for graceful teardown ...');
        resolve();
      };
      process.once('SIGINT', this._sigint);
      this._engine = setInterval(() => this._tick(resolve), ENGINE_TICK_MS);
    });

    // ---- TEARDOWN ----
    await this.teardown();
    return { ok: true, interrupted: this.interrupted };
  }

  _tick(resolve) {
    const clock = this.clock;
    const now = clock.now();

    // spawn due arrivals
    while (this._planIdx < this.demand.plan.length && this.demand.plan[this._planIdx].at <= now) {
      if (this._stopping) break;
      this.pool.spawn(this.demand.plan[this._planIdx]);
      this._planIdx++;
    }

    // chaos scheduled events
    this.injector.tick(now);

    // due cancellations + managers (async, guarded)
    this.pool.checkDueCancels().catch(e => this.logger.error('POOL', 'CLIENT', 'CLIENT', '', `cancel loop: ${e && e.message}`));
    this.pool.tickManagers().catch(() => {});

    // day roll at 04:00
    if (now >= this._nextRoll && !this._rolling) {
      this._rolling = true;
      const finishedDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor((this._nextRoll - istMidnight(clock.startEpochMs)) / 86400000));
      const dayDate = new Date(istMidnight(clock.startEpochMs) + (finishedDay - 1) * 86400000 + 330 * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      this.daySummaries.push({ day: finishedDay, date: dayDate, counters: { ...this.pool.dayCounters } });
      this.logger.section(`DAY ROLL — end of D${finishedDay} (${dayDate})`);
      this.pool.resetDay();
      this.injector.onNewDay();
      this.injector.planDay(istMidnight(clock.startEpochMs) + finishedDay * 86400000);
      this._nextRoll += 86400000;
      this.auditor.audit(`day-roll D${finishedDay}`).finally(() => { this._rolling = false; });
    }

    // progress heartbeat (real 5s)
    if (Date.now() - this._lastProgress > 5000) {
      this._lastProgress = Date.now();
      const s = this.pool.stats;
      this.logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE',
        `progress V=${clock.stamp()} spawned=${s.spawned} active=${s.active} queued=${s.queued} booked=${s.booked} walkins=${s.walkinSeated} cancels=${s.cancels} errors=${this.logger.errorCount}`);
    }

    // end of run
    if ((now >= this._endEpoch || this.interrupted) && !this._stopping) {
      this._stopping = true;
      clearInterval(this._engine);
      process.removeListener('SIGINT', this._sigint);
      resolve();
    }
  }

  async teardown() {
    const { clock, logger, config } = this;
    logger.section(`RUN ${this.runId} — TEARDOWN`);
    this._stopping = true;
    this.pool.stopped = true; // no new spawns
    clock.stop();             // freeze virtual time so teardown logs stay inside the last service day
    logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', 'draining in-flight customers ...');
    await this.pool.drain(15000);
    for (const m of this.pool.managers.values()) m.stop();
    await this.auditor.audit('teardown-final');
    const parity = this.adapter.sseParity(config.audit.sseGraceMs || 2500);
    this.logger.info('SYS', 'SSE',
      parity.missing.length === 0
        ? `SSE parity clean: ${parity.received} events for ${parity.expected} mutations`
        : `SSE parity: ${parity.received} events / ${parity.expected} mutations — ${parity.missing.length} missing (see SSE-GAP error)`,
      parity.missing.length === 0 ? {} : { byAction: parity.missing.reduce((a, m) => { a[m.action] = (a[m.action] || 0) + 1; return a; }, {}) });
    this.adapter.stopSse();
    clock.stop();

    // final day summary for the (possibly incomplete) last day
    if (this.daySummaries.length < config.days && !this.interrupted) {
      const d = config.days;
      this.daySummaries.push({ day: d, date: clock.dateStr(), counters: { ...this.pool.dayCounters } });
    }

    // report
    this.reporter = new ReportBuilder({
      config, clock, logger, adapter: this.adapter, pool: this.pool,
      auditor: this.auditor, injector: this.injector, demand: this.demand,
      runId: this.runId, seed: this.seed, daySummaries: this.daySummaries
    });
    const { markdown, errorsJson } = this.reporter.build();

    const reportsDir = path.isAbsolute(config.reports.dir) ? config.reports.dir : path.join(PKG_ROOT, config.reports.dir);
    fs.mkdirSync(reportsDir, { recursive: true });
    const reportPath = path.join(reportsDir, `sim-report-${this.runId}.md`);
    fs.writeFileSync(reportPath, markdown, 'utf8');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(reportsDir, `simulation_errors_${this.runId}.json`), JSON.stringify(errorsJson, null, 2), 'utf8');

    logger.section(`RUN ${this.runId} — SUMMARY`);
    logger._write(this.reporter.logFooter({ interrupted: this.interrupted }));
    logger.info('SYS', 'ENGINE', `report: ${reportPath}`);
    logger._write(`${'='.repeat(100)}`);
    this._done = true;
    return reportPath;
  }
}
```

```javascript
export const CATEGORIES = {
  VALIDATION: {
    label: 'Payload validation',
    hint: 'The server accepted or rejected a payload in an unexpected way. The LAN REST engine performs zero server-side validation (finding A3-1); compare the accepted payload against packages/shared Zod schemas to see what SHOULD have been enforced.'
  },
  RACE: {
    label: 'Concurrency race',
    hint: 'Two actors converged on the same table/slot and both writes succeeded. Root cause is client-side availability checking with a trust-the-client POST (finding A3-4) and, in production mode, the missing btree_gist exclusion constraint (finding A3-6).'
  },
  DATA: {
    label: 'Data integrity',
    hint: 'An invariant audit found corrupted state: double-booked tables, duplicate codes, illegal status transitions, or records that vanished. Cross-reference the two audit snapshots around the first occurrence to find the mutation that caused it.'
  },
  NETWORK: {
    label: 'Network behavior',
    hint: 'A request was aborted or timed out. Note whether the server still processed it (the vite middleware keeps running after client disconnect — ghost bookings, finding A3-1/A4-2). If a POST was aborted but the record later appears, that is the ghost-booking signature.'
  },
  SERVER: {
    label: 'Server error',
    hint: 'A 5xx or malformed response body. In the current engine, business failures (no availability) also surface as 500s because there is no error handler (finding A4-7). Check the response body logged with the error.'
  },
  CLIENT: {
    label: 'Simulator fault',
    hint: 'The SIMULATOR produced an invalid request or inconsistent internal state. These should stay near zero — if they climb, the bug is in simulation/, not in the app. Report with the ERR id and the reproduce seed.'
  },
  SSE: {
    label: 'Realtime stream',
    hint: 'The SSE monitor detected missing reservations:changed events, an unstable stream, or broadcast gaps. The LAN engine has no heartbeat (finding A4-8); long idle gaps are expected under proxies but event parity violations are real.'
  }
};

/** Error signature registry: code -> finding cross-ref. Used in the end-of-run summary. */
export const SIGNATURES = {
  'DBL-BOOK':   { ref: 'A3-4 / A3-6', fix: 'Move availability check + table allocation server-side; add Postgres EXCLUDE constraint (gist) on (table_id, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at)) WHERE active; in LAN mode add a mutex + overlap re-check inside the write path.' },
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — EVENT & ERROR LOGGER
// Everything the simulation does is appended to
// SIMULATION_LOG.txt (chronological, dual-timestamped).
// Errors get ERR-#### ids, categories, context and a
// resolution hint. End-of-run: full error summary is
// appended to the same txt file.
// ============================================

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fmtIST, j } from '../util.js';
import { CATEGORIES, SIGNATURES } from './errors.js';

export class SimLogger {
  constructor({ filePath, clock, level = 'info', append = true, runId }) {
    this.filePath = filePath;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.level = level;
    this.lines = 0;
    this.errors = [];            // {id, category, signature, actor, message, context, atReal, atVirt, count}
    this._errCount = 0;
    this._byCat = {};
    this._bySig = {};
    this._runId = runId;
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
    const header =
      `\n${'='.repeat(100)}\n` +
      `THE BURGER FACTORY — SIMULATION RUN ${runId}\n` +
      `Started (real) : ${fmtIST(Date.now())}\n` +
      `Dual time      : [R] real clock | [V] virtual clock (D<n> = simulated day n)\n` +
      `Log grammar    : [R ts][V ts][ACTOR][CHANNEL][LEVEL] message | ctx | hint:…\n` +
      `${'='.repeat(100)}\n`;
    if (!append && fs.existsSync(filePath)) fs.writeFileSync(filePath, ''); // fresh log only when append=false
    // append mode keeps run history in one file (append=true default)
    fs.appendFileSync(filePath, header);
  }

  _base(actor, channel, levelTag) {
    return `[R ${fmtIST(Date.now())}][V ${this.clock.stamp()}][${actor}][${channel}] [${levelTag}]`;
  }

  info(actor, channel, msg, ctx) {
    this._write(this._base(actor, channel, 'INFO ') + ' ' + msg + (ctx ? ` | ${j(ctx)}` : ''));
  }

  warn(actor, channel, msg, ctx) {
    this._write(this._base(actor, channel, 'WARN ') + ' ' + msg + (ctx ? ` | ${j(ctx)}` : ''));
  }

  debug(actor, channel, msg, ctx) {
    if (this.level !== 'debug') return;
    this._write(this._base(actor, channel, 'DEBUG') + ' ' + msg + (ctx ? ` | ${j(ctx)}` : ''));
  }

  /**
   * Record an error. Returns the ERR id.
   * signature: one of SIGNATURES keys or '' (uncategorized)
   */
  error(actor, channel, category, signature, msg, ctx, hintOverride) {
    this._errCount += 1;
    const id = `ERR-${String(this._errCount).padStart(4, '0')}`;
    const cat = CATEGORIES[category] || { hint: 'Uncategorized.' };
    const sig = SIGNATURES[signature] || null;
    const hint = hintOverride || (sig ? sig.fix : cat.hint);

    const entry = {
      id, category, signature: signature || '—', actor, message: msg,
      context: ctx, atReal: Date.now(), atVirt: this.clock.now(), count: 1
    };
    const prev = this.errors.length ? this.errors[this.errors.length - 1] : null;
    this.errors.push(entry);
    this._byCat[category] = (this._byCat[category] || 0) + 1;
    if (signature) this._bySig[signature] = (this._bySig[signature] || 0) + 1;

    this._write(
      this._base(actor, channel, 'ERROR') +
      ` ${id}${signature ? '/' + signature : ''} ${msg}` +
      (ctx ? `\n      ctx: ${j(ctx, 700)}` : '') +
      (sig ? `\n      finding: ${sig.ref}` : '') +
      `\n      hint: ${hint}`
    );
    return id;
  }

  section(title) {
    this._write(`\n${'—'.repeat(98)}\n  ${title}\n${'—'.repeat(98)}`);
  }

  _write(line) {
    this.lines += 1;
    fs.appendFileSync(this.filePath, line + '\n');
  }

  /** Error digest for the end-of-run summary block (appended to the txt + returned). */
  errorSummaryBlock() {
    if (this.errors.length === 0) {
      return 'ERRORS: none recorded. Every invariant held for the entire run.';
    }
    const byCat = Object.entries(this._byCat).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const bySig = Object.entries(this._bySig).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    let s = 'ERROR SUMMARY (grouped by category → signature → suggested fix)\n';
    for (const [cat, n] of byCat) {
      s += `  ${CATEGORIES[cat]?.label || cat}: ${n}\n`;
    }
    s += '\n  Signatures (what to fix first):\n';
    if (bySig.length === 0) s += '    (no classified signatures — see raw errors above)\n';
    for (const [sig, n] of bySig) {
      const ref = SIGNATURES[sig];
      s += `    ${sig} ×${n} — finding ${ref ? ref.ref : '?'} — fix: ${ref ? ref.fix : 'n/a'}\n`;
    }
    return s;
  }

  get errorCount() { return this._errCount; }
}
```

// ============================================
// SIMULATION — REPORT BUILDER
// End-of-run analytics. Writes:
//   1. <reports>/sim-report-<runid>.md   (human report)
//   2. simulation_errors.json            (machine-readable error registry)
//   3. a summary block appended to SIMULATION_LOG.txt
// ============================================

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { percentile, fmtIST, j } from '../util.js';
import { TABLE_STATS } from '../demand/outlets.js';

export class ReportBuilder {
  constructor(ctx) { Object.assign(this, ctx); }

  build() {
    const { config, clock, logger, adapter, pool, auditor, injector, demand, runId, seed } = this;
    const m = adapter.metrics;
    const latencyRows = [];
    for (const [name, mm] of Object.entries(m.byEndpoint)) {
      const s = [...mm.samples].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      latencyRows.push({
        endpoint: name, count: mm.count,
        p50: percentile(s, 50), p95: percentile(s, 95), p99: percentile(s, 99),
        max: mm.max, errors: mm.errors
      });
    }
    latencyRows.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);

    const stats = pool.stats;
    const dd = demand.describe();
    const violations = auditor.violations || [];
    const byKind = {};
    for (const v of violations) byKind[v.kind] = (byKind[v.kind] || 0) + 1;

    const md = [];
    md.push(`# Simulation Report — ${runId}`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`| | |`);
    md.push(`|---|---|`);
    md.push(`| Target | ${config.target} |`);
    md.push(`| Seed | ${seed} (reproduce with --seed ${seed}) |`);

    md.push(`| Sim window | ${fmtIST(clock.startEpochMs)} → ${fmtIST(clock.startEpochMs + config.days * 86400000)} |`);
    md.push(`| Wall time | ${(clock.realElapsed() / 60000).toFixed(1)} min |`);
    md.push(`| Chaos | ${config.chaos} |`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Demand`);
    md.push(`Planned population: **${dd.total}** (${j(dd.byChannel)})`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`| Outlet | Planned | Tables | Seats |`);
    md.push(`|---|---|---|---|`);
    for (const [out, n] of Object.entries(dd.byOutlet).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) {
      md.push(`| ${out} | ${n} | ${TABLE_STATS.per[out].tables} | ${TABLE_STATS.per[out].seats} |`);
    }
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Outcomes`);
    md.push(`| Metric | Value |`);
    md.push(`|---|---|`);
    md.push(`| Spawned customers | ${stats.spawned} |`);
    md.push(`| Booked (online/phone) | ${stats.booked} |`);
    md.push(`| Walk-ins seated | ${stats.walkinSeated} |`);
    md.push(`| Abandoned | ${stats.abandoned} |`);
    md.push(`| Client-side rejections | ${stats.clientRejects} |`);
    md.push(`| POST rejected/aborted | ${stats.postRejected} |`);
    md.push(`| Cancellations | ${stats.cancels} |`);
    md.push(`| No-shows | ${stats.noShows} |`);
    md.push(`| Seated by managers | ${stats.seated} |`);
    md.push(`| Completed turns | ${stats.completed} |`);
    md.push(`| Peak in-flight HTTP | ${m.peakInFlight} |`);
    md.push(`| HTTP requests total | ${m.totalRequests} (${m.totalErrors} failed) |`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Server latency (real ms)`);
    md.push(`| Endpoint | n | p50 | p95 | p99 | max | errors |`);
    md.push(`|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|`);
    for (const r of latencyRows) md.push(`| ${r.endpoint} | ${r.count} | ${r.p50} | ${r.p95} | ${r.p99} | ${r.max} | ${r.errors} |`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Realtime (SSE)`);
    const sse = adapter.sse;
    md.push(`Events received: ${sse.events}; expected mutations: ${sse.expected.length}; reconnects: ${sse.reconnects}.`);
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Chaos`);
    md.push('```json');
    md.push(JSON.stringify(injector.describe(), null, 2));
    md.push('```');
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Invariant violations`);
    if (violations.length === 0) md.push('NONE — every invariant held for the entire run.');
    else {
      md.push(`Total distinct: ${violations.length}`);
      md.push('```json');
      md.push(JSON.stringify(byKind, null, 2));
      md.push('```');
    }
    md.push('');
    md.push(`## Per-day summary`);
    for (const d of (this.daySummaries || [])) {
      md.push(`- D${d.day} (${d.date}): spawned ${d.counters.spawned}, booked ${d.counters.booked}, walkins ${d.counters.walkinSeated}, cancelled ${d.counters.cancels}, no-shows ${d.counters.noShows}, seated ${d.counters.seated}, completed ${d.counters.completed}`);
    }

    md.push(`## Errors`);
    md.push('```');
    md.push(logger.errorSummaryBlock());

    // machine-readable sidecar
    const errorsJson = {
      runId, seed,
      configEcho: { target: config.target, days: config.days, acceleration: config.acceleration, chaos: config.chaos },
      errors: logger.errors.map(e => ({ id: e.id, category: e.category, signature: e.signature, actor: e.actor, message: e.message, atVirt: fmtIST(e.atVirt) })),
      violations
    };

    return { markdown: md.join('\n'), errorsJson, stats };
  }

  /** Text block appended to SIMULATION_LOG.txt at end of run. */
  logFooter({ interrupted }) {
    const stats = this.pool.stats;
    const m = this.adapter.metrics;
    const lines = [];
    lines.push('RUN SUMMARY');
    lines.push(`  spawned=${stats.spawned} booked=${stats.booked} walkins=${stats.walkinSeated} abandoned=${stats.abandoned} cancels=${stats.cancels} no-shows=${stats.noShows} seated=${stats.seated} completed=${stats.completed}`);

    lines.push(`  sse: events=${this.adapter.sse.events} expected=${this.adapter.sse.expected.length} reconnects=${this.adapter.sse.reconnects}`);
    lines.push(`  chaos: ${j(this.injector.describe())}`);
    lines.push(`  invariant violations: ${this.auditor.violations.length}`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(this.logger.errorSummaryBlock());
    lines.push(interrupted ? 'RUN TERMINATED EARLY (SIGINT) — partial results.' : 'RUN COMPLETED.');
    lines.push(`Reproduce: node run.mjs --seed ${this.seed} --days ${this.config.days} --accel ${this.config.acceleration} --chaos ${this.config.chaos} --target ${this.config.target}`);
    return lines.join('\n');
  }
}
