```javascript
// ============================================
// SIMULATION — SERVER ADAPTER
// Real HTTP against the running app (LAN/Vite mode).
// Measures real latency, tracks in-flight requests,
// keeps an SSE monitor with event parity accounting.
// Every call is logged through the SimLogger.
// ============================================

import { j } from '../util.js';

export class Metrics {
  constructor() {
    this.byEndpoint = {};         // name -> {count, samples[], errors, max}
    this.inFlight = 0;
    this.peakInFlight = 0;
    this.totalRequests = 0;
    this.totalErrors = 0;
  }
  record(name, latencyMs, ok) {
    const m = this.byEndpoint[name] || (this.byEndpoint[name] = { count: 0, samples: [], errors: 0, max: 0 });
    m.count++; m.samples.push(latencyMs); m.max = Math.max(m.max, latencyMs);
    this.totalRequests++;
    if (!ok) { m.errors++; this.totalErrors++; }
  }
  enter() { this.inFlight++; this.peakInFlight = Math.max(this.peakInFlight, this.inFlight); }
  exit() { this.inFlight = Math.max(0, this.inFlight - 1); }
}

export class ServerAdapter {
  constructor({ target, timeoutMs, logger, clock, metrics }) {
    this.target = String(target || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs || 8000;
    this.log = logger;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.metrics = metrics || new Metrics();

    // SSE monitor state
    this.sse = {
      connected: false, reconnects: 0, events: 0,
      received: [],           // {action, code, atReal}
      expected: [],           // {action, code, atReal} — registered on each mutation
      controller: null,
      monitorOn: false
    };
    this._sseAbort = null;
  }

  /** Core request. opts: {body, timeoutMs, abortAtMs (chaos), silent} */
  async request(method, path, opts = {}) {
    const url = `${this.target}${path}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let abortTimer = null, timeoutTimer = null, aborted = false;
    if (opts.abortAtMs) {
      abortTimer = setTimeout(() => { aborted = true; controller.abort('chaos:abandoned-request'); }, opts.abortAtMs);
    }
    const tLimit = opts.timeoutMs || this.timeoutMs;
    timeoutTimer = setTimeout(() => { aborted = true; controller.abort('timeout'); }, tLimit);
    const t0 = Date.now();
    this.metrics.enter();
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: opts.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
        body: opts.body ? JSON.stringify(opts.body) : undefined,
        signal: controller.signal,
        cache: 'no-store'
      });
      let body = null;
      const text = await res.text();
      try { body = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { body = { _raw: text ? text.slice(0, 200) : '' }; }
      const latency = Date.now() - t0;
      this.metrics.record(`HTTP ${method} ${path}`, latency, true);
      return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, body, latencyMs: latency, aborted: false };
    } catch (err) {
      const latency = Date.now() - t0;
      this.metrics.record(`HTTP ${method} ${path}`, latency, false);
      return { ok: false, status: 0, body: null, latencyMs: latency, aborted, error: String(err && err.message || err), url };
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(abortTimer); clearTimeout(timeoutTimer);
      this.metrics.exit();
    }
  }

  async getReservations() {
    const r = await this.request('GET', '/api/v1/reservations');
    if (r.ok && r.body && Array.isArray(r.body.reservations)) return { list: r.body.reservations, res: r };
    return { list: null, res: r };
  }

  async postReservation(reservation, opts = {}) {
    const r = await this.request('POST', '/api/v1/reservations', { body: { reservation }, ...opts });
    if (r.ok || r.status === 201) this.registerSse('created', reservation.code);
    return r;
  }

  async patchStatus(code, status, reason, opts = {}) {
    const r = await this.request('PATCH', '/api/v1/reservations/status', { body: { code, status, ...(reason ? { reason } : {}) }, ...opts });
    if (r.ok) this.registerSse('status_updated:' + status, code);
    return r;
  }

  async probe() {
    const r = await this.getReservations();
    return r;
  }

  // ---------- SSE monitoring ----------
  registerSse(action, code) {
    if (!this.sse.monitorOn) return;
    this.sse.expected.push({ action, code, atReal: Date.now() });
    if (this.sse.expected.length > 4000) this.sse.expected.splice(0, 2000);
  }

  async startSse() {
    if (this.sse.monitorOn) return;
    this.sse.monitorOn = true;
    this._sseLoop().catch(() => {});
  }

  async _sseLoop() {
    // auto-reconnect with backoff; counts reconnects and gaps
    while (this.sse.monitorOn) {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      this._sseAbort = controller;
      let lastFrameReal = Date.now();
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${this.target}/api/v1/events`, {
          signal: controller.signal,
          headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream' }
        });
        if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new Error(`SSE HTTP ${res.status}`);
        this.sse.connected = true;
        if (this.sse.reconnects > 0) {
          this.log.info('SSE', 'SSE', `stream re-established after ${Date.now() - lastFrameReal}ms gap`, { reconnects: this.sse.reconnects });
        }
        let buf = '';
        let eventName = '';
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
        for await (const chunk of res.body) {
          buf += decoder.decode(chunk, { stream: true });
          let idx;
          while ((idx = buf.indexOf('\n\n')) !== -1) {
            const frame = buf.slice(0, idx); buf = buf.slice(idx + 2);
            for (const line of frame.split('\n')) {
              if (line.startsWith('event:')) eventName = line.slice(6).trim();
              else if (line.startsWith('data:')) {
                const dataRaw = line.slice(5).trim();
                let data = null; try { data = JSON.parse(dataRaw); } catch { data = { _raw: dataRaw?.slice(0, 120) }; }
                this._onSseEvent(eventName || 'message', data);
              }
            }
            eventName = '';
          }
          lastFrameReal = Date.now();
        }
        throw new Error('SSE stream ended by server');
      } catch (e) {
        this.sse.connected = false;
        if (!this.sse.monitorOn) return;
        this.sse.reconnects++;
        this.log.warn('SSE', 'SSE', `stream down (${String(e && e.message || e).slice(0, 80)}) — reconnect #${this.sse.reconnects} in 1s`);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
      }
    }
  }

  _onSseEvent(type, data) {
    if (type === 'connected') { this.sse.connected = true; return; }
    if (type === 'reservations:changed') {
      this.sse.events++;
      const code = data?.reservation?.code || data?.code || null;
      const action = data?.action || 'unknown';
      this.sse.received.push({ action, code, atReal: Date.now() });
      if (this.sse.received.length > 4000) this.sse.received.splice(0, 2000);
    }
  }

  stopSse() {
    this.sse.monitorOn = false;
    if (this._sseAbort) this._sseAbort.abort('stop');
  }

  /**
   * Event parity: every successful mutation should produce exactly one
   * reservations:changed. Returns missing list (graceMs for stream lag).
   */
  sseParity(graceMs = 2500) {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - graceMs;
    const have = new Set(this.sse.received.filter(r => r.atReal <= cutoff).map(r => `${r.action}~${r.code}`));
    const missing = [];
    for (const e of this.sse.expected) {
      if (e.atReal > cutoff) continue;
      const key = e.action.includes(':') ? `${e.action.split(':')[0]}~${e.code}` : `${e.action}~${e.code}`;
      if (!have.has(key) && e.code) missing.push(e);
    }
    return { expected: this.sse.expected.length, received: this.sse.received.length, missing };
  }
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY SIMULATION — SHARED UTILITIES
// No dependencies. Node >= 18.
// ============================================

export const IST_OFFSET_MIN = 330; // +05:30 — the app serves Goa + New Delhi, both IST.

/** Format a wall-clock ms epoch as strict IST timestamp: 2026-10-18T14:02:11.482+05:30 */
export function fmtIST(ms) {
  const d = new Date(ms + IST_OFFSET_MIN * 60000);
  return (
    `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}` +
    `T${String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(d.getUTCMilliseconds()).padStart(3, '0')}+05:30`
  );
}

/** Compact clock string: 14:02:11 */
export function fmtClock(ms) {
  const d = new Date(ms + IST_OFFSET_MIN * 60000);
  const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${p(d.getUTCHours())}:${p(d.getUTCMinutes())}:${p(d.getUTCSeconds())}`;
}

/** Virtual-date parts in IST */
export function istParts(ms) {
  const d = new Date(ms + IST_OFFSET_MIN * 60000);
  return {
    date: `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    hh: String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0'),
    mm: String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'),
    ss: String(d.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0'),
    weekday: d.getUTCDay() // 0=Sun .. 6=Sat
  };
}

export function dateOf(ms) { return istParts(ms).date; }
export function timeOf(ms) { const p = istParts(ms); return `${p.hh}:${p.mm}`; }

/** 'HH:MM' -> minutes since midnight */
export function toMin(hhmm) {
  const [h, m] = String(hhmm).split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + (m || 0);
}

/** minutes since midnight -> 'HH:MM' */
export function toHHMM(min) {
  const m = ((Math.round(min) % 1440) + 1440) % 1440;
  return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export const TURN_MINUTES = 90; // matches src/js/booking.js TURN_MINUTES

/** Epoch of midnight IST of the day containing ms. All day-anchored math MUST use this. */
export function istMidnight(ms) {
  const shifted = ms + IST_OFFSET_MIN * 60000;
  return ms - (shifted - Math.floor(shifted / 86400000) * 86400000);
}

export function clamp(n, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n)); }

export function pct(n, total) { return total ? ((100 * n) / total).toFixed(1) + '%' : '0.0%'; }

/** Poisson sampler (Knuth) — used by the demand engine. */
export function poisson(lambda, rng) {
  if (lambda <= 0) return 0;
  if (lambda > 30) {
    // normal approximation for large rates
    return Math.max(0, Math.round(lambda + Math.sqrt(lambda) * rng.gauss()));
  }
  const L = Math.exp(-lambda);
  let k = 0, p = 1;
  do { k++; p *= rng.float(); } while (p > L && k < 10000);
  return k - 1;
}

/** Percentile from a sorted-ascending array. */
export function percentile(sorted, q) {
  if (!sorted.length) return 0;
  const idx = clamp(Math.ceil((q / 100) * sorted.length) - 1, 0, sorted.length - 1);
  return sorted[idx];
}

/** Stable compact JSON for log contexts. */
export function j(obj, maxLen = 420) {
  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return 'null';
  let s;
  try { s = JSON.stringify(obj); } catch { s = String(obj); }
  if (s.length > maxLen) s = s.slice(0, maxLen) + `…(+${s.length - maxLen}b)`;
  return s;
}

/** Minimal CLI parser: --key value | --flag (true) | --key=value */
export function parseArgs(argv) {
  const out = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i];
    if (!a.startsWith('--')) continue;
    const eq = a.indexOf('=');
    if (eq !== -1) { out[a.slice(2, eq)] = a.slice(eq + 1); continue; }
    const next = argv[i + 1];
    if (next !== undefined && !next.startsWith('--')) { out[a.slice(2)] = next; i++; }
    else out[a.slice(2)] = true;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```plaintext
// ============================================
// TEST HARNESS — STANDALONE REPLICA OF THE
// VITE EMBEDDED REST ENGINE (vite.config.js)
//
// This is the EXACT middleware logic from
// D:\Burger_factory\vite.config.js (burger-factory-lan-api
// plugin): same routes, same readDb/writeDb, same
// seed, same SSE broadcast — validation-free, the
// way the real engine is. It exists so the simulator
// can be validated WITHOUT the full app, and so you
// can later A/B the simulator against a FIXED engine.
//
// It is NOT a fix and adds no validation on purpose.
// Start: node test-harness/server.mjs [port]   (default 3100)
// ============================================

import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

// ---------- verbatim engine (from vite.config.js) ----------
function ensureDbFile() {

function readDb() {
  ensureDbFile();
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, 'utf8')); } catch { return []; }
}

function writeDb(records) {
  ensureDbFile();
  fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(records, null, 2), 'utf8');
}

const sseClients = new Set();
function broadcastSse(event, payload) {
  const msg = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`;
  for (const res of sseClients) {
    try { res.write(msg); } catch { sseClients.delete(res); }
  }
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`);

  if (!url.pathname.startsWith('/api/v1')) {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
    res.end(`<!doctype html><html><body style="font-family:monospace;background:#1c1713;color:#f5efe6;padding:2rem">
      <h1 style="color:#d63b27">Burger Factory — Test Harness</h1>
      <p>Verbatim replica of the vite.config.js embedded REST engine.</p>
      <p>Endpoints: GET /api/v1/reservations · POST /api/v1/reservations · PATCH /api/v1/reservations/status · GET /api/v1/events (SSE)</p>
      <p>DB file: ${DB_FILE}</p>
    </body></html>`);
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/v1/events') {
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
    });
    res.write(`event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })}\n\n`);
    sseClients.add(res);
    req.on('close', () => sseClients.delete(res));
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
    const records = readDb();
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ reservations: records }));
    return;
  }

  if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method)) {
    let body = '';
    req.on('data', chunk => { body += chunk; });
    req.on('end', () => {
      try {
        const payload = body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
        const records = readDb();

        if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations') {
          const newRes = payload.reservation;
          if (newRes) {
            records.push(newRes);
            writeDb(records);
            broadcastSse('reservations:changed', { action: 'created', reservation: newRes, reservations: records });
          }
          res.writeHead(201, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, reservations: records }));
          return;
        }

        if (req.method === 'PATCH' && url.pathname === '/api/v1/reservations/status') {
          const targetCode = (payload.code || '').toUpperCase().trim();
          const newStatus = payload.status;
          const idx = records.findIndex(r => (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode || (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === targetCode);
          if (idx === -1) {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Reservation not found' }));
            return;
          }
          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          records[idx].status = newStatus;
          if (newStatus === 'seated') records[idx].seatedAt = nowIso;
          if (newStatus === 'completed') records[idx].completedAt = nowIso;
          if (newStatus === 'no-show') records[idx].noShowAt = nowIso;
          if (newStatus === 'cancelled') {
            records[idx].cancelledAt = nowIso;
            if (payload.reason) records[idx].cancelReason = payload.reason;
          }
          writeDb(records);
          broadcastSse('reservations:changed', {
            action: 'status_updated', code: targetCode, status: newStatus,
            reservation: records[idx], reservations: records
          });
          res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, reservation: records[idx], reservations: records }));
          return;
        }

        res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Endpoint not found' }));
      } catch {
        res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid request payload' }));
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Endpoint not found' }));
});

server.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () => {
  ensureDbFile();
  console.log(`[harness] Burger Factory engine replica on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`[harness] DB: ${DB_FILE}`);
  console.log(`[harness] Point the simulator at it: node run.mjs --target http://127.0.0.1:${PORT} --tag smoke`);
});
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — SHARED LAN + SSE BOOKING ENGINE
// Synchronizes Customer Portal & Staff Portal across Phone + PC
// ============================================

import { locationTables, locations } from './data.js';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'bf_reservations';
const BOOKING_CHARS = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
const TURN_MINUTES = 90;

const syncChannel = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined'
  ? new BroadcastChannel('bf_reservations_sync')
  : null;

export const TIME_SLOTS = [
  '12:30', '13:00', '13:30', '14:00', '14:30',
  '15:00', '15:30', '16:00', '16:30', '17:00',
  '17:30', '18:00', '18:30', '19:00', '19:30',
  '20:00', '20:30', '21:00', '21:30', '22:00'
];

export function generateBookingCode() {
  let id = 'BF-';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    id += BOOKING_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * BOOKING_CHARS.length));
  }
  return id;
}

export function getReservations() {
  try {
    const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveReservationsLocal(reservations) {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(reservations));
}

export async function syncReservationsFromServer() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (Array.isArray(data.reservations)) {
        saveReservationsLocal(data.reservations);
        return data.reservations;
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return getReservations();
}

export function subscribeToLiveUpdates(onUpdate, onConnectionChange = null) {
  try {
    const es = new EventSource('/api/v1/events');
    es.addEventListener('connected', () => {
      if (onConnectionChange) onConnectionChange(true);
    });
    es.addEventListener('reservations:changed', (e) => {
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(e.data);
        if (Array.isArray(payload.reservations)) {
          saveReservationsLocal(payload.reservations);
        }
      } catch {}
      onUpdate();
    });
    es.onerror = () => {
      if (onConnectionChange) onConnectionChange(false);
    };
  } catch {}

  if (syncChannel) {
    syncChannel.onmessage = () => {
      syncReservationsFromServer().then(() => onUpdate());
    };
  }

  window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
    if (e.key === STORAGE_KEY) {
      onUpdate();
    }
  });
}

function notifyPeers() {
  if (syncChannel) {
    try {
      syncChannel.postMessage({ updatedAt: Date.now() });
    } catch {}
  }
}

export function timeToMinutes(time) {
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

export function formatTime(time24) {
  if (!time24) return '';
  const [h, m] = time24.split(':').map(Number);
  const period = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const hour12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return `${hour12}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')} ${period}`;
}

export function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const date = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
}

export function getLocationName(locationId) {
  const loc = locations.find(l => l.id === locationId);
  return loc ? `${loc.name}, ${loc.area}` : locationId;
}

export function checkAvailability(locationId, date, time, guests, seatingPref = 'any') {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) {
    return { available: false, table: null, message: 'Location not found' };
  }

  const guestCount = parseInt(guests, 10);
  const reservations = getReservations();

  let allTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const table of zoneTables) {
      allTables.push({ ...table, zone });
    }
  }

  if (seatingPref && seatingPref !== 'any') {
    const prefMap = {
      'indoor': ['indoor'],
      'outdoor': ['outdoor', 'beachside', 'rooftop'],
      'beachside': ['beachside', 'outdoor'],
      'rooftop': ['rooftop', 'outdoor']
    };
    const allowedZones = prefMap[seatingPref] || [seatingPref];
    const filtered = allTables.filter(t => allowedZones.includes(t.zone));
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      allTables = filtered;
    }
  }

  allTables = allTables
    .filter(t => t.capacity >= guestCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);

  if (allTables.length === 0) {
    return {
      available: false,
      table: null,
      message: `No single table accommodates ${guestCount} guests at this outlet. Please call the outlet directly.`
    };
  }

  const requestedTimeMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);

  for (const table of allTables) {
    const hasCollision = reservations.some(r => {
      if (r.status === 'cancelled' || r.status === 'no-show' || r.status === 'completed') return false;
      if (r.locationId !== locationId) return false;
      if (r.date !== date) return false;
      if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;

      const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
      return Math.abs(requestedTimeMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
    });

    if (!hasCollision) {
      return {
        available: true,
        table,
        message: `Table ${table.id} (${table.type}, ${table.zone}) is available.`
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    available: false,
    table: null,
    message: 'All suitable tables are booked for this time slot. Please choose another time.'
  };
}

export function getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locationId, date, guests, seatingPref = 'any') {
  const tables = locationTables[locationId];
  if (!tables) return [];

  const guestCount = parseInt(guests, 10) || 2;
  const reservations = getReservations();

  let candidateTables = [];
  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const t of zoneTables) {
      if (seatingPref === 'any' || t.zone === seatingPref || (seatingPref === 'outdoor' && t.zone === 'beachside')) {
        if (t.capacity >= guestCount) {
          candidateTables.push({ ...t, zone });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (candidateTables.length === 0) {
    return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => ({ time, status: 'full', availableCount: 0 }));
  }

  return TIME_SLOTS.map(time => {
    const slotMinutes = timeToMinutes(time);
    let freeCount = 0;

    for (const table of candidateTables) {
      const isOccupied = reservations.some(r => {
        if (r.status === 'cancelled' || r.status === 'no-show' || r.status === 'completed') return false;
        if (r.locationId !== locationId) return false;
        if (r.date !== date) return false;
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;

        const bookedMinutes = timeToMinutes(r.time);
        return Math.abs(slotMinutes - bookedMinutes) < TURN_MINUTES;
      });

      if (!isOccupied) freeCount++;
    }

    let status = 'available';
    if (freeCount === 0) status = 'full';
    else if (freeCount <= 2) status = 'last_tables';

    return { time, status, availableCount: freeCount };
  });
}

export function getTodayIST() {
  return new Date(Date.now() + 5.5 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

export function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (str == null) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

export async function createReservation(bookingData) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const { locationId, date, time, guests, seating, name, email, phone, occasion, notes } = bookingData;
  const availability = checkAvailability(locationId, date, time, guests, seating);
  if (!availability.available) {
    return { success: false, message: availability.message };
  }

  const unifiedCode = generateBookingCode();

  const candidateReservation = {
    id: unifiedCode,
    code: unifiedCode,
    name: name.trim(),
    email: email ? email.trim() : '',
    phone: phone.trim(),
    locationId,
    locationName: getLocationName(locationId),
    date,
    time,
    guests: parseInt(guests, 10),
    seating: seating || 'any',
    occasion: occasion || '',
    notes: notes || '',
    tableId: availability.table.id,
    tableLabel: availability.table.id,
    tableType: availability.table.type,
    tableZone: availability.table.zone,
    status: 'confirmed',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reservation: candidateReservation })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'All suitable tables are booked for this time slot.' };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const finalReservation = data.reservation || candidateReservation;

    const reservations = getReservations();
    const existingIdx = reservations.findIndex(r => r.code === finalReservation.code || r.id === finalReservation.id);
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      reservations[existingIdx] = finalReservation;
    } else {
      reservations.push(finalReservation);
    }
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: finalReservation };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed. Please try again.' };
  }
}

export async function createWalkInReservation(walkInData) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const { locationId, tableId, tableType, tableZone, guests, name, phone, notes } = walkInData;
  const now = new Date();
  const dateStr = getTodayIST();
  const hh = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const min = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const timeStr = `${hh}:${min}`;

  const unifiedCode = generateBookingCode();

  const candidateReservation = {
    id: unifiedCode,
    code: unifiedCode,
    name: name || 'Walk-in Guest',
    email: '',
    phone: phone || '',
    locationId,
    locationName: getLocationName(locationId),
    date: dateStr,
    time: timeStr,
    guests: parseInt(guests, 10) || 2,
    seating: (tableZone || 'indoor').toLowerCase(),
    occasion: '',
    notes: notes || 'Walk-in seated from floor plan',
    tableId,
    tableLabel: tableId,
    tableType: tableType || 'Table',
    tableZone: tableZone || 'indoor',
    status: 'seated',
    createdAt: now.toISOString(),
    seatedAt: now.toISOString()
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reservation: candidateReservation })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'Walk-in could not be seated on this table' };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const finalReservation = data.reservation || candidateReservation;

    const reservations = getReservations();
    const existingIdx = reservations.findIndex(r => r.code === finalReservation.code || r.id === finalReservation.id);
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      reservations[existingIdx] = finalReservation;
    } else {
      reservations.push(finalReservation);
    }
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: finalReservation };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed. Please try again.' };
  }
}

export async function lookupReservation(bookingCode, phoneLast4) {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const cleanCode = bookingCode.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();

  const found = reservations.find(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );
  if (!found) {
    return { success: false, message: `No reservation found with reference ${cleanCode}` };
  }

  const cleanPhone = (found.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const last4 = cleanPhone.slice(-4);

  if (phoneLast4 && last4 && last4 !== phoneLast4.trim()) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Phone verification failed: last 4 digits do not match this booking.'
    };
  }

  return { success: true, reservation: found };
}

export async function cancelReservation(bookingCode, phoneLast4, reason = 'Cancelled by guest') {
  await syncReservationsFromServer();

  const cleanCode = bookingCode.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();
  const idx = reservations.findIndex(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );

  if (idx === -1) {
    return { success: false, message: `Reservation ${cleanCode} not found` };
  }

  const cleanPhone = (reservations[idx].phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const last4 = cleanPhone.slice(-4);

  if (phoneLast4 && last4 && last4 !== phoneLast4.trim()) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Phone verification failed: last 4 digits do not match this booking.'
    };
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: cleanCode, status: 'cancelled', reason })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return { success: false, message: errData.message || errData.error || 'Cancellation failed on server' };
    }

    reservations[idx].status = 'cancelled';
    reservations[idx].cancelledAt = new Date().toISOString();
    reservations[idx].cancelReason = reason;
    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();

    return { success: true, reservation: reservations[idx] };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Network connection failed during cancellation' };
  }
}

export async function updateReservationStatus(bookingId, status) {
  const cleanCode = bookingId.toUpperCase().trim();
  const reservations = getReservations();
  const idx = reservations.findIndex(
    r => (r.id || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode || (r.code || '').toUpperCase() === cleanCode
  );
  if (idx === -1) return false;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/reservations/status', {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ code: cleanCode, status })
    });

    if (!res.ok) return false;

    reservations[idx].status = status;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (status === 'seated') reservations[idx].seatedAt = now;
    else if (status === 'completed') reservations[idx].completedAt = now;
    else if (status === 'no-show') reservations[idx].noShowAt = now;
    else if (status === 'cancelled') reservations[idx].cancelledAt = now;

    saveReservationsLocal(reservations);
    notifyPeers();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function getAllReservations() {
  return getReservations();
}

  await syncReservationsFromServer();
}
```

```javascript
// ============================================
// THE BURGER FACTORY — ICS CALENDAR GENERATOR
// ============================================

/**
 * Generates an .ics iCalendar file and triggers instant browser download.
 */
export function downloadCalendarEvent(reservation) {
  const { code, locationName, date, time, guests } = reservation;
  
  // Format date and time for ICS (UTC or local formatted as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS)
  const [year, month, day] = date.split('-');
  const [hour, min] = time.split(':');
  
  const startDate = `${year}${month}${day}T${hour}${min}00`;
  
  // Add 90 minutes for end time
  const startObj = new Date(`${date}T${time}:00`);
  const endObj = new Date(startObj.getTime() + 90 * 60 * 1000);
  const endYear = endObj.getFullYear();
  const endMonth = String(endObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const endDay = String(endObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endHour = String(endObj.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endMin = String(endObj.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const endDate = `${endYear}${endMonth}${endDay}T${endHour}${endMin}00`;

  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//The Burger Factory//Table Booking//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
    `UID:BF-${code}-${nowStr}@burgerfactory.in`,
    `DTSTAMP:${nowStr}`,
    `DTSTART:${startDate}`,
    `DTEND:${endDate}`,
    `SUMMARY:Burger Factory Booking (${code}) - ${locationName}`,
    `DESCRIPTION:Reservation for ${guests} guests at The Burger Factory (${locationName}).\\nBooking Reference: ${code}\\nPlease arrive 10-15 mins early.`,
    `LOCATION:The Burger Factory, ${locationName}`,
    'STATUS:CONFIRMED',
    'END:VEVENT',
    'END:VCALENDAR'
  ].join('\r\n');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.setAttribute('download', `Burger-Factory-Reservation-${code}.ics`);
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```

```javascript
// FILE: /src/js/main.js
import { menuItems, locations, reviews, burgerJokes } from './data.js';
import {
  seedDemoReservations,
  subscribeToLiveUpdates,

  createReservation,
  lookupReservation,
  cancelReservation,
  formatDate,
  formatTime,
  getLocationName,
  getTodayIST,
  escapeHtml

import { renderThermalTicket, attachTicketListeners } from './thermalTicket.js';

export function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
  if (!container) {
    container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'toast-container';
    document.body.appendChild(container);
  }

  const labels = {
    success: 'OK',
    error: 'ERR',
    info: 'INFO',
    warning: 'NOTE'
  };

  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px;">${labels[type] || 'INFO'}</span>
    <span>${message}</span>
  `;

  container.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('toast-show'));

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove('toast-show');
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
  }, 3500);
}

let refreshStripSlotsFn = () => {};

// ---- Burger Jokes Rotator ----
function initRandomBurgerJoke() {
  const headlineEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-headline');
  const punchlineEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-punchline');
  const authorEl = document.getElementById('hero-joke-author');
  const shuffleBtn = document.getElementById('btn-shuffle-joke');

  if (!headlineEl || !punchlineEl || !authorEl) return;

  let lastIndex = -1;

  function pickJoke() {
    let idx;
    do {
      idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * burgerJokes.length);
    } while (idx === lastIndex && burgerJokes.length > 1);
    lastIndex = idx;
    return burgerJokes[idx];
  }

  function displayJoke(joke) {
    headlineEl.style.opacity = '0';
    punchlineEl.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      headlineEl.textContent = `"${joke.headline}"`;
      punchlineEl.textContent = joke.punchline;
      authorEl.textContent = `BOARD NOTE · ${joke.author.toUpperCase()}`;
      headlineEl.style.opacity = '1';
      punchlineEl.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 180);
  }

  // Show initial joke
  displayJoke(pickJoke());

  shuffleBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    displayJoke(pickJoke());
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {

function initNavbar() {
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
  const mobileClose = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-close');

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    navbar?.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 30);
  }, { passive: true });

  hamburger?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu?.classList.toggle('open');
  });

  mobileClose?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open');
  });

  mobileMenu?.querySelector('.mobile-menu-overlay')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open'));
  });

  // Also close mobile menu when mobile bottom bar links are tapped
  document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-bottom-bar a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => mobileMenu?.classList.remove('open'));
  });

  initNavActiveTracking();
}

function initNavActiveTracking() {
  const sectionIds = ['hero', 'about', 'menu', 'locations', 'reviews', 'lookup-section'];
  const sections = sectionIds
    .map(id => ({ id, el: document.getElementById(id) }))
    .filter(s => s.el !== null);

  const desktopLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link[href^="#"]');
  const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link[href^="#"]');

  function setActiveLink(activeId) {
    desktopLinks.forEach(link => {
      const target = link.getAttribute('href')?.replace('#', '');
      link.classList.toggle('active', target === activeId);
    });
    mobileLinks.forEach(link => {
      const target = link.getAttribute('href')?.replace('#', '');
      link.classList.toggle('active', target === activeId);
    });
  }

  let isScrolling = false;
  function handleScroll() {
    const scrollPos = window.scrollY;
    const headerOffset = 160;

    let currentId = 'hero';
    for (const { id, el } of sections) {
      const top = el.offsetTop - headerOffset;
      if (scrollPos >= top) {
        currentId = id;
      }
    }
    setActiveLink(currentId);
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!isScrolling) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        handleScroll();
        isScrolling = false;
      });
      isScrolling = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });
}

function initHeroAvailabilityStrip() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('strip-location');
  const minusBtn = document.getElementById('strip-guest-minus');
  const plusBtn = document.getElementById('strip-guest-plus');
  const guestVal = document.getElementById('strip-guest-val');
  const slotsContainer = document.getElementById('strip-slots-container');

  if (!locSelect || !slotsContainer) return;

  let currentGuests = 2;
  const todayStr = getTodayIST();

  function refreshStripSlots() {
    const locId = locSelect.value;
    const slots = getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locId, todayStr, currentGuests, 'any');
    const displaySlots = slots.slice(0, 8);

    slotsContainer.innerHTML = displaySlots.map(s => `
      <div class="chip-slot ${s.status}" data-time="${s.time}">
        <span class="slot-time">${formatTime(s.time).replace(':00', '')}</span>
        <span class="slot-hint">${s.status === 'full' ? 'Full' : s.status === 'last_tables' ? 'Last 2' : 'Open'}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    slotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot:not(.full)').forEach(chip => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const selectedTime = chip.dataset.time;
        const bookLoc = document.getElementById('book-location');
        if (bookLoc) bookLoc.value = locId;

        setBookingGuests(currentGuests);

        const timeInput = document.getElementById('book-selected-time');
        if (timeInput) timeInput.value = selectedTime;

        const sumOutlet = document.getElementById('sum-outlet');
        if (sumOutlet) sumOutlet.textContent = getLocationName(locId).split(',')[0];
        const sumTime = document.getElementById('sum-time');
        if (sumTime) sumTime.textContent = formatTime(selectedTime);

        renderBookingSlotChips();
        document.getElementById('booking')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    });
  }

  refreshStripSlotsFn = refreshStripSlots;

  minusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentGuests > 1) {
      currentGuests--;
      guestVal.textContent = `${currentGuests} Guest${currentGuests > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
      refreshStripSlots();
    }
  });

  plusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentGuests < 10) {
      currentGuests++;
      guestVal.textContent = `${currentGuests} Guests`;
      refreshStripSlots();
    }
  });

  locSelect.addEventListener('change', refreshStripSlots);
  refreshStripSlots();
}

// ---- Card-based menu renderer (no dotted leaders) ----
function renderMenu(category = 'all') {
  const container = document.getElementById('menu-items-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const filtered = category === 'all' ? menuItems : menuItems.filter(item => item.category === category);

  container.innerHTML = filtered.map(item => {
    const isVeg = item.diet === 'veg' || item.category === 'veg';
    const dietClass = isVeg ? 'veg' : 'non-veg';

    const badgeHtml = item.badge === 'popular'
      ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-popular">Bestseller</span>`
      : item.badge === 'new'
        ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-new">New</span>`
        : item.badge === 'veg'
          ? `<span class="menu-tag-pill menu-badge-veg">Pure Veg</span>`
          : '';

    return `
      <article class="menu-item-block">
        <div class="menu-row">
          <div class="menu-title-wrap">
            <span class="diet-badge ${dietClass}" title="${isVeg ? 'Vegetarian' : 'Non-Vegetarian'}"></span>
            <h3 class="menu-name">${item.name}</h3>
          </div>
          <span class="menu-price">&#8377;${item.price}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="menu-item-desc">${item.description}</p>
        <div class="menu-item-tags">
          ${item.tags.map(t => `<span class="menu-tag-pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
          ${badgeHtml}
        </div>
      </article>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function initMenuFilters() {
  const tabs = document.getElementById('menu-category-tabs');
  tabs?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.chip');
    if (!btn) return;

    tabs.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    renderMenu(btn.dataset.cat);
  });
}

function renderLocations() {
  const container = document.getElementById('locations-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const flagship = locations.find(l => l.id === 'anjuna');
  const others = locations.filter(l => l.id !== 'anjuna');

  const flagshipHtml = `
    <div class="location-flagship-card">
      <img 
        src="${flagship.image}" 
        alt="The Burger Factory ${flagship.name}" 
        class="location-flagship-img"
        loading="lazy" 
        width="600" 
        height="338"
      />
      <div class="location-flagship-body">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
          <div>

let bookingGuests = 2;

function setBookingGuests(num) {
  bookingGuests = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, num));
  const valEl = document.getElementById('book-guest-val');
  const labelEl = document.getElementById('book-guest-label');
  const summaryEl = document.getElementById('sum-guests');

  if (valEl) valEl.textContent = bookingGuests;
  if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = `${bookingGuests === 1 ? 'Guest' : 'Guests'} (${bookingGuests <= 2 ? '2-seater' : bookingGuests <= 4 ? '4-seater' : bookingGuests <= 6 ? '6-seater' : 'Large Table'})`;
  if (summaryEl) summaryEl.textContent = `${bookingGuests} ${bookingGuests === 1 ? 'Guest' : 'Guests'}`;

  renderBookingSlotChips();
}

function renderBookingSlotChips() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('book-location');
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('book-date');
  const zoneSelect = document.getElementById('book-zone');
  const chipsContainer = document.getElementById('time-slot-chips');
  const timeInput = document.getElementById('book-selected-time');

  if (!locSelect || !dateInput || !chipsContainer) return;

  const locId = locSelect.value;
  const dateStr = dateInput.value;
  const seating = zoneSelect ? zoneSelect.value : 'any';

  const slotData = getSlotAvailabilityGrid(locId, dateStr, bookingGuests, seating);
  const selectedTime = timeInput ? timeInput.value : '13:00';

  chipsContainer.innerHTML = slotData.map(s => {
    const isSelected = s.time === selectedTime;
    return `
      <div class="chip-slot ${s.status} ${isSelected ? 'active' : ''}" data-time="${s.time}">
        <span class="slot-time">${formatTime(s.time).replace(':00', '')}</span>
        <span class="slot-hint">${s.status === 'full' ? 'Full' : s.status === 'last_tables' ? 'Last 2' : 'Open'}</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  chipsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot:not(.full)').forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      chipsContainer.querySelectorAll('.chip-slot').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      chip.classList.add('active');
      const chosen = chip.dataset.time;
      if (timeInput) timeInput.value = chosen;

      const sumTime = document.getElementById('sum-time');
      if (sumTime) sumTime.textContent = formatTime(chosen);
    });
  });
}

function initBookingFlow() {
  const form = document.getElementById('main-booking-form');
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('book-date');
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('book-location');
  const zoneSelect = document.getElementById('book-zone');
  const minusBtn = document.getElementById('book-guest-minus');
  const plusBtn = document.getElementById('book-guest-plus');

  const todayStr = getTodayIST();

  if (dateInput) {
    dateInput.min = todayStr;
    dateInput.value = todayStr;
  }

  minusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => setBookingGuests(bookingGuests - 1));
  plusBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => setBookingGuests(bookingGuests + 1));

  locSelect?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumLoc = document.getElementById('sum-outlet');
    if (sumLoc) sumLoc.textContent = getLocationName(locSelect.value).split(',')[0];
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  dateInput?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumDate = document.getElementById('sum-date');
    if (sumDate) sumDate.textContent = formatDate(dateInput.value);
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  zoneSelect?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const sumZone = document.getElementById('sum-zone');
    if (sumZone) sumZone.textContent = zoneSelect.options[zoneSelect.selectedIndex].text;
    renderBookingSlotChips();
  });

  renderBookingSlotChips();

  form?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const name = form.querySelector('#book-name').value.trim();
    const phone = form.querySelector('#book-phone').value.trim();
    const email = form.querySelector('#book-email').value.trim();
    const locationId = locSelect.value;
    const date = dateInput.value;
    const time = document.getElementById('book-selected-time').value;
    const seating = zoneSelect.value;
    const occasion = form.querySelector('#book-occasion').value;
    const notes = form.querySelector('#book-notes').value.trim();

    if (!name || name.length < 2) {
      showToast('Please enter your full name', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    if (!phone || !/^(\+91[\-\s]?)?[0]?[6789]\d{9}$/.test(phone.replace(/\s+/g, ''))) {
      showToast('Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const result = await createReservation({
      name,
      phone,
      email,
      locationId,
      date,
      time,
      guests: bookingGuests,
      seating,
      occasion,
      notes
    });

    if (!result.success) {
      showToast(result.message, 'error');
      return;
    }

    const reservation = result.reservation;
    reservation.dateFormatted = formatDate(reservation.date);
    reservation.timeFormatted = formatTime(reservation.time);

    const mount = document.getElementById('ticket-modal-mount');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('booking-modal-overlay');

    if (mount && overlay) {
      mount.innerHTML = renderThermalTicket(reservation);
      attachTicketListeners(reservation);

      document.getElementById('btn-ticket-done')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        overlay.classList.remove('open');
      });

      overlay.classList.add('open');
    }

    showToast(`Table ${reservation.tableLabel} confirmed (${reservation.code})`, 'success');
    form.reset();
    dateInput.value = todayStr;
    setBookingGuests(2);
    refreshStripSlotsFn();
  });
}

function initLookupSection() {
  const form = document.getElementById('lookup-form');
  const resultContainer = document.getElementById('lookup-result-container');

  if (!form || !resultContainer) return;

  async function runLookup() {
    const ref = document.getElementById('lookup-ref').value.trim();
    const phone4 = document.getElementById('lookup-phone4').value.trim();

    if (!ref || !phone4 || phone4.length !== 4) {
      showToast('Please enter your booking reference and last 4 digits of phone', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const result = await lookupReservation(ref, phone4);
    resultContainer.style.display = 'block';

    if (!result.success) {
      resultContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div style="background: rgba(214,59,39,0.1); border: 1.5px solid var(--ketchup); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1rem; color: var(--ketchup-dark); font-weight: 600;">
          ${result.message}
        </div>
      `;
      showToast(result.message, 'error');
      return;
    }

    const r = result.reservation;
    const isActive = r.status === 'confirmed' || r.status === 'seated';

    resultContainer.innerHTML = `
      <div style="background: var(--paper-deep); border: var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-xs);">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(28,23,19,0.25); padding-bottom: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--ketchup);">${escapeHtml(r.code)}</strong>
          <span class="status-pill ${r.status}">${escapeHtml(r.status.toUpperCase())}</span>
        </div>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
          <strong>Guest:</strong> ${escapeHtml(r.name)} · <strong>Party:</strong> ${r.guests} Guests
        </p>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
          <strong>Outlet:</strong> ${escapeHtml(r.locationName)} (Table ${escapeHtml(r.tableLabel || r.tableId)})
        </p>
        <p style="font-size: var(--step--1); margin-bottom: 1rem;">
          <strong>Date &amp; Time:</strong> ${formatDate(r.date)} at ${formatTime(r.time)}
        </p>

        ${isActive ? `
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ketchup btn-sm" id="btn-cancel-reservation" data-code="${r.code}">
            Cancel Reservation
          </button>
        ` : `
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ketchup);">
            Status: ${r.status.toUpperCase()} — Table has been released.
          </div>
        `}
      </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('btn-cancel-reservation')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (confirm(`Cancel reservation ${r.code} for ${r.name}?`)) {
        const cancelRes = await cancelReservation(r.code, phone4, 'Cancelled by customer online');
        if (cancelRes.success) {
          showToast(`Reservation ${r.code} cancelled. Staff Portal updated.`, 'info');
          await runLookup();
          refreshStripSlotsFn();
          renderBookingSlotChips();
        } else {
          showToast(cancelRes.message, 'error');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    runLookup();
  });
}
```

```javascript
function showManagerToast(message, type = 'info', undoCallback = null) {
  let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
  if (!container) {
    container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'toast-container';
    document.body.appendChild(container);
  }

  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <span>${message}</span>
    ${undoCallback ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" id="toast-undo-btn" style="padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.72rem; margin-left: 0.5rem;">Undo</button>` : ''}
  `;

  container.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('toast-show'));

  if (undoCallback) {
    toast.querySelector('#toast-undo-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      undoCallback();
      toast.remove();
    });
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove('toast-show');
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
  }, 4000);
}

function initStaffAuthGate() {
  const gate = document.getElementById('staff-auth-gate');
  const form = document.getElementById('staff-gate-form');
  const passInput = document.getElementById('staff-gate-pass');

    e.preventDefault();
    const val = (passInput?.value || '').trim();
    if (['burger123', '1234', 'staff123', 'GoaBurgers2026!'].includes(val)) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('bf_staff_auth', 'true');
      gate?.classList.remove('open');
      refreshDashboard();

function initFilters() {
  const locSelect = document.getElementById('mgr-location-filter');

  });

function initShortcuts() {
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.getElementById('mgr-search')?.focus();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay')?.classList.remove('open');

function refreshDashboard() {
  const allReservations = getAllReservations();
  let filtered = allReservations.filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate);

  updateCounts(filtered);

  if (currentStatus !== 'all') {
    filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.status === currentStatus);
  }

  if (searchQuery) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(r =>
      r.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) ||
      (r.code && r.code.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
      (r.id && r.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) ||
      r.phone.includes(searchQuery)
    );
  }

  filtered.sort((a, b) => {
    const order = { seated: 0, confirmed: 1, completed: 2, 'no-show': 3, cancelled: 4 };
    const sa = order[a.status] ?? 5;
    const sb = order[b.status] ?? 5;
    if (sa !== sb) return sa - sb;
    return a.time.localeCompare(b.time);
  });

  renderTable(filtered);
  renderArrivingSoon(allReservations);
  renderFloorCanvas(allReservations);
  renderPrintDaySheet();
}

function updateCounts(reservations) {
  const total = reservations.filter(r => r.status !== 'cancelled' && r.status !== 'no-show').length;
  const confirmed = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'confirmed').length;
  const seated = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'seated').length;
  const completed = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'completed').length;
  const noshow = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'no-show').length;
  const cancelled = reservations.filter(r => r.status === 'cancelled').length;
  const guests = reservations
    .filter(r => r.status !== 'cancelled' && r.status !== 'no-show')
    .reduce((sum, r) => sum + (parseInt(r.guests, 10) || 0), 0);

  document.getElementById('stat-active').textContent = total;
  document.getElementById('stat-confirmed').textContent = confirmed;
  document.getElementById('stat-seated').textContent = seated;
  document.getElementById('stat-guests').textContent = guests;
  document.getElementById('stat-completed').textContent = completed;
  document.getElementById('stat-noshow').textContent = cancelled + noshow;

  document.getElementById('count-all').textContent = reservations.length;
  document.getElementById('count-confirmed').textContent = confirmed;
  document.getElementById('count-seated').textContent = seated;
  document.getElementById('count-completed').textContent = completed;
  document.getElementById('count-noshow').textContent = noshow;
  document.getElementById('count-cancelled').textContent = cancelled;
}

function renderTable(reservations) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('mgr-table-body');
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('mgr-table-empty');
  const table = document.getElementById('mgr-reservations-table');

  if (!tbody) return;

  if (reservations.length === 0) {
    table.style.display = 'none';
    emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  table.style.display = '';
  emptyEl.style.display = 'none';

  tbody.innerHTML = reservations.map(r => {
    const code = r.code || r.id;
    let actionButtons = '';

    if (r.status === 'confirmed') {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-mustard btn-sm" data-action="seated" data-id="${code}">Seat</button>
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="no-show" data-id="${code}">No-Show</button>
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="cancelled" data-id="${code}">Cancel</button>
      `;
    } else if (r.status === 'seated') {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-sea btn-sm" data-action="completed" data-id="${code}">Complete</button>
      `;
    } else {
      actionButtons = `
        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="confirmed" data-id="${code}">Restore</button>
      `;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td data-label="REF"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--ketchup);">${escapeHtml(code)}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="GUEST">
          <strong>${escapeHtml(r.name)}</strong><br/>
          <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-mono);">${escapeHtml(r.phone)}</span>
          ${r.notes ? `<div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--sea); margin-top: 2px;">Note: ${escapeHtml(r.notes)}</div>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td data-label="TIME"><span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700;">${formatTime(r.time)}</span></td>
        <td data-label="PAX"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.guests}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="TABLE"><strong style="font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.tableLabel || r.tableId}</strong></td>
        <td data-label="ZONE"><span style="font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-mono);">${r.tableZone}</span></td>
        <td data-label="STATUS"><span class="status-pill ${r.status}">${r.status.toUpperCase()}</span></td>
        <td data-label="ACTIONS"><div class="table-action-group">${actionButtons}</div></td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const action = btn.dataset.action;
      const id = btn.dataset.id;
      const prevRes = getAllReservations().find(res => (res.code === id || res.id === id));
      const previousStatus = prevRes ? prevRes.status : 'confirmed';

      await updateReservationStatus(id, action);
      refreshDashboard();

      showManagerToast(
        `Reservation ${id} marked as ${action.toUpperCase()}`,
        'info',
        async () => {
          await updateReservationStatus(id, previousStatus);
          refreshDashboard();
          showManagerToast(`Restored ${id} to ${previousStatus.toUpperCase()}`, 'success');
        }
      );
    });
  });
}

function renderArrivingSoon(allReservations) {
  const container = document.getElementById('arriving-lane-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();

  const arriving = allReservations.filter(r => {
    if (r.locationId !== currentLocation || r.date !== currentDate || r.status !== 'confirmed') return false;
    const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
    const diff = (h * 60 + m) - currentMinutes;
    return diff >= -15 && diff <= 45;
  });

  if (arriving.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-soft);">No confirmed arrivals scheduled within the next 30 minutes.</span>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = arriving.map(r => `
    <div class="arriving-card">
      <div>
        <span class="arriving-time">${formatTime(r.time)}</span>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.84rem;">${escapeHtml(r.name)} (${r.guests} pax)</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-mono);">${escapeHtml(r.tableLabel || r.tableId)} · ${escapeHtml(r.tableZone.toUpperCase())}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-mustard btn-sm" data-arrive-seat="${r.code || r.id}">
        Seat Now
      </button>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  container.querySelectorAll('[data-arrive-seat]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const id = btn.dataset.arriveSeat;
      await updateReservationStatus(id, 'seated');
      refreshDashboard();
      showManagerToast(`Seated reservation ${id}`, 'success');
    });
  });
}

function renderFloorCanvas(allReservations) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('mgr-floor-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;

  const tables = locationTables[currentLocation];
  if (!tables) {
    canvas.innerHTML = '<p>No table map configured for this outlet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const todayStr = getTodayIST();
  const isToday = currentDate === todayStr;
  const now = new Date();
  const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  let html = '';

  const outletReservations = allReservations
    .filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate)
    .sort((a, b) => a.time.localeCompare(b.time));

  for (const [zone, zoneTables] of Object.entries(tables)) {
    for (const table of zoneTables) {
      const active = outletReservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
        if (['cancelled', 'completed', 'no-show'].includes(r.status)) return false;

        const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
        const startMin = h * 60 + m;
        const endMin = startMin + 90;

        if (r.status === 'seated') return true;
        if (isToday) {
          return startMin <= currentMinutes && currentMinutes < endMin;
        }
        return false;
      });

      const upcoming = outletReservations.find(r => {
        if (r.tableId !== table.id) return false;
        if (r.status !== 'confirmed') return false;

        if (isToday) {
          const [h, m] = r.time.split(':').map(Number);
          return (h * 60 + m) > currentMinutes;
        }
        return true;
      });

      let status = 'available';
      let guestName = '';
      let timerText = '';
      let isOvertime = false;

      if (active && active.status === 'seated') {
        status = 'occupied';
        guestName = active.name;

        const seatedTime = active.seatedAt ? new Date(active.seatedAt).getTime() : (now.getTime() - 20 * 60000);
        const elapsedMin = Math.max(1, Math.floor((now.getTime() - seatedTime) / 60000));
        timerText = `${elapsedMin}m / 90m`;

        if (elapsedMin > 90) {
          isOvertime = true;
          timerText = `OVERTIME (${elapsedMin}m)`;
        }
      } else if (active || upcoming) {
        status = 'reserved';
        const res = active || upcoming;
        guestName = `${formatTime(res.time)} · ${res.name}`;
      }

      const isRound = table.type === '2-seater';

      html += `
        <div class="floor-table-card ${status} ${isOvertime ? 'overtime' : ''} ${isRound ? 'shape-round' : ''}"
             data-table-id="${table.id}"
             data-table-type="${table.type}"
             data-table-zone="${zone}"
             data-table-capacity="${table.capacity}"
             data-status="${status}"
             data-res-id="${active ? (active.code || active.id) : (upcoming ? (upcoming.code || upcoming.id) : '')}">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%;">
            <span class="table-code">${table.id}</span>
            <span class="table-capacity">${table.capacity}P</span>
          </div>

          <div style="margin: 4px 0; width: 100%;">
            <span class="table-status-tag">${status.toUpperCase()}</span>
            ${guestName ? `<div class="table-guest-name">${guestName}</div>` : ''}
            ${timerText ? `<div class="table-turn-timer ${isOvertime ? 'warning' : ''}">${timerText}</div>` : ''}
          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--ink-soft); text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-mono);">
            ${zone}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
  }

  canvas.innerHTML = html;

  canvas.querySelectorAll('.floor-table-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const status = card.dataset.status;
      const tableId = card.dataset.tableId;
      const type = card.dataset.tableType;
      const zone = card.dataset.tableZone;
      const resId = card.dataset.resId;

      if (status === 'available') {
        openWalkInModal(tableId, type, zone);
      } else if (resId) {
        showManagerToast(`Table ${tableId} assigned to booking ${resId}`, 'info');
      }
    });
  });
}

let selectedWalkInTable = null;

function initWalkInModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-close-walkin');
  const form = document.getElementById('walkin-form');

  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => overlay.classList.remove('open'));
  overlay?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === overlay) overlay.classList.remove('open');
  });

  form?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedWalkInTable) return;

    const name = document.getElementById('walkin-name').value.trim() || 'Walk-in Guest';
    const guests = document.getElementById('walkin-guests').value;
    const phone = document.getElementById('walkin-phone').value.trim();

    await createWalkInReservation({
      locationId: currentLocation,
      tableId: selectedWalkInTable.id,
      tableType: selectedWalkInTable.type,
      tableZone: selectedWalkInTable.zone,
      guests,
      name,
      phone
    });

    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    refreshDashboard();
    showManagerToast(`Walk-in party seated at Table ${selectedWalkInTable.id}`, 'success');
  });
}

function openWalkInModal(tableId, type, zone) {
  selectedWalkInTable = { id: tableId, type, zone };
  const overlay = document.getElementById('walkin-modal-overlay');
  const title = document.getElementById('walkin-table-title');
  const desc = document.getElementById('walkin-table-desc');

  if (title) title.textContent = `Seat Walk-In at Table ${tableId}`;
  if (desc) desc.textContent = `${type} · ${zone.toUpperCase()} ZONE · Immediate 90-min turn`;

  overlay.classList.add('open');
}

  const totalCovers = activeRecords.reduce((s, r) => s + (parseInt(r.guests, 10) || 0), 0);

    dateStyle: 'medium',

function exportCSV() {
  const all = getAllReservations().filter(r => r.locationId === currentLocation && r.date === currentDate);
  if (all.length === 0) {
    showManagerToast('No reservations to export for this date.', 'warning');
    return;
  }

  const headers = ['Ref', 'Guest Name', 'Phone', 'Date', 'Time', 'Covers', 'Table', 'Zone', 'Status', 'Occasion', 'Notes'];
  const rows = all.map(r => [
    r.code || r.id,
    `"${r.name}"`,
    `"${r.phone}"`,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    r.guests,
    r.tableLabel || r.tableId,
    r.tableZone,
    r.status,
    `"${r.occasion || ''}"`,
    `"${(r.notes || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
  ]);

  const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `burger-factory-${currentLocation}-${currentDate}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showManagerToast('Exported CSV report', 'success');
}
```

```javascript
export function renderThermalTicket(reservation) {

              Share via WhatsApp
            </a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" id="btn-ticket-done" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">
              Close Voucher
            </button>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </article>
    </div>

export function attachTicketListeners(reservation) {
  document.getElementById('btn-copy-code')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const code = e.currentTarget.dataset.code;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
      e.currentTarget.textContent = `Copied (${code})`;
      setTimeout(() => {
        e.currentTarget.textContent = `Copy Booking Ref (${code})`;
      }, 2500);
    }).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copy your Booking Reference:', code);
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-download-ics')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    downloadCalendarEvent(reservation);
  });
}
```

```bat
@echo off
title The Burger Factory - Local & Wi-Fi Network Server
color 0E
cls

echo ============================================================================
echo   THE BURGER FACTORY -- FULL-STACK LAN SERVER LAUNCHER
echo ============================================================================
echo.

cd /d "%~dp0"

:: Detect primary Wi-Fi / LAN IPv4 Address using PowerShell
for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%a in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceAlias -notmatch 'Loopback|vEthernet|WSL|Bluetooth' -and $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^169\.254' } | Select-Object -First 1).IPAddress"`) do (
    set LAN_IP=%%a
)

if "%LAN_IP%"=="" set LAN_IP=localhost

echo   [NETWORK READY] Connect your Phone to the same Wi-Fi network!
echo.
echo   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo   OPEN ON THIS PC (Customer Portal) : http://localhost:3000
echo   OPEN ON THIS PC (Staff Portal)    : http://localhost:3000/manager.html
echo   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo   OPEN ON YOUR PHONE (Customer)     : http://%LAN_IP%:3000
echo   OPEN ON YOUR PHONE (Staff Portal) : http://%LAN_IP%:3000/manager.html
echo   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo   STAFF PORTAL PASSCODE             : burger123
echo   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo.
echo   Starting Vite + Built-in Real-Time API Server on 0.0.0.0:3000...
echo.

start "" "http://localhost:3000"
call npx vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
pause
```

FILE [106/108]: /structure.txt
